name.en: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
name.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಕಿಸಾನ್ ಸಮ್ಮಾನ್ ನಿಧಿ (ಪಿಎಂ-ಕಿಸಾನ್)
name.hi: प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि (पीएम-किसान)

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI

summary.en: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 to all eligible landholding farmer families.
summary.kn: ಅರ್ಹ ಭೂಮಾಲೀಕ ರೈತ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ₹6,000 ಆದಾಯ ಬೆಂಬಲವನ್ನು ಮೂರು ಸಮಾನ ಕಂತುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ (ತಲಾ ₹2,000) ಡಿಬಿಟಿ ಮೂಲಕ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ನೀಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: पात्र भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 की प्रत्यक्ष आय सहायता तीन समान किस्तों (प्रत्येक ₹2,000) में प्रदान की जाती है।

description.en: PM-KISAN is a central sector scheme with 100% funding from Government of India. Under the scheme, income support of ₹6,000/- per year in three equal instalments each of ₹2,000/- is transferred directly into the bank accounts of landholding farmer families, subject to specified exclusions.
description.kn: ಪಿಎಂ-ಕಿಸಾನ್ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಯೋಜನೆಯಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಭೂಮಾಲೀಕ ರೈತ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹6,000 (ಮೂರು ಕಂತುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಲಾ ₹2,000) ನೇರ ಜಮೆ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
description.hi: पीएम-किसान केंद्र सरकार की 100% वित्तपोषित योजना है जिसके तहत भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को वार्षिक ₹6,000 तीन किस्तों में बैंक खाते में दिए जाते हैं।

benefit.description: ₹6,000 per year, paid in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 every 4 months via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

eligibility_criteria: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land recorded in State land records (Bhoomi / RTC in Karnataka)
Mandatory Aadhaar-linked active bank account and completed e-KYC on PM-KISAN portal
Family comprises husband, wife, and minor children owning cultivable agricultural land

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must belong to a landholding farmer family with cultivable land recorded in land records.
Applicant must possess an active Aadhaar-seeded bank account for DBT transfers.

exclusions.description: Institutional landholders are completely excluded.
Farmer families where any member is a constitutional post holder, serving/retired government employee (Group A/B/C), income tax payer, or professional (Doctor, Engineer, CA, Lawyer) are excluded.

schemes.income_criteria: Excludes individuals who paid income tax in the last assessment year.
schemes.age_criteria: 18 years and above (represented by the head or adult member of the farmer family).
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Cultivating agricultural landholder; excludes institutional and corporate owners.
schemes.land_criteria: Must hold cultivable land in state records (Bhoomi / RTC). No maximum ceiling since 2019 expansion.

required_documents.note: Karnataka Bhoomi RTC showing cultivable land parcel in applicant's name.

process: Verify cultivable landownership in Karnataka Bhoomi portal.
Register on PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or via Village BangaloreOne / GramaOne centre.
Complete mandatory e-KYC via OTP, facial recognition, or biometric CSC device.
Track status on PM-KISAN portal using Aadhaar number.
important_current_notes: e-KYC is mandatory for all registered PM-KISAN beneficiaries.
Land seeding with state Bhoomi portal is strictly enforced in Karnataka.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round on official portal
schemes.geographic_applicability: All India (Active across all 31 Karnataka districts)

name.en: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
name.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಫಸಲ್ ಬಿಮಾ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಪಿಎಂಎಫ್‌ಬಿವೈ)
name.hi: प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (पीएमएफबीवाई)

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI

summary.en: Comprehensive crop insurance covering non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest at nominal premium rates (1.5% Rabi, 2% Kharif, 5% Commercial).
summary.kn: ಬಿತ್ತನೆಯಿಂದ ಕೊಯ್ಲಿನ ನಂತರದವರೆಗೆ ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ ವಿಕೋಪಗಳಿಂದ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಬೆಳೆ ನಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೆ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ದರದಲ್ಲಿ (ಖಾರೀಫ್ 2%, ರಬಿ 1.5%) ಸಮಗ್ರ ಬೆಳೆ ವಿಮೆ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ.
summary.hi: बुवाई पूर्व से कटाई पश्चात तक प्राकृतिक आपदाओं से फसल नुकसान पर न्यूनतम प्रीमियम (खरीफ 2%, रबी 1.5%) पर व्यापक फसल बीमा सुरक्षा।

description.en: PMFBY provides comprehensive insurance coverage and financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage arising out of unforeseen events such as drought, flood, pests, and unseasonal weather.
description.kn: ಬರಗಾಲ, ಪ್ರವಾಹ, ಕೀಟಬಾಧೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಅಕಾಲಿಕ ಮಳೆಯಿಂದ ಬೆಳೆ ನಷ್ಟ ಅನುಭವಿಸುವ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಪರಿಹಾರ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಕೇಂದ್ರ-ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಸಮಗ್ರ ಬೆಳೆ ವಿಮಾ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: सूखा, बाढ़, कीट प्रकोप या बेमौसम बारिश से फसल नष्ट होने की स्थिति में किसानों को त्वरित वित्तीय मुआवजा देने वाली फसल बीमा योजना।

benefit.description: Sum insured up to cost of cultivation for notified crops. Farmers pay only 2% premium for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops; remainder subsidized equally by Central and State Governments.

eligibility_criteria: All farmers cultivating notified crops in notified areas/panchayats in Karnataka
Includes loanee farmers and non-loanee owner cultivators or recorded tenant/sharecropper farmers
Enrolment must occur before the notified seasonal cut-off date (Samrakshane portal in Karnataka)

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must have insurable interest in cultivable agricultural land growing notified crop.

exclusions.description: Losses arising out of war, nuclear risks, malicious damage, or preventable farmer negligence are excluded.

schemes.income_criteria: No income ceiling. All farmer categories eligible.
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Cultivator of notified seasonal food/oilseed crops.
schemes.land_criteria: Land ownership or lawful tenancy certificate for the insured plot.

required_documents.note: Current season crop sowing record or self-declaration.
Active bank account for claim settlement.
Issued by Village Administrative Officer / Gram Panchayat if RTC crop entry is pending.

process: Check Karnataka district season crop notification on Samrakshane portal (samrakshane.karnataka.gov.in).
Apply online via PMFBY portal, CSC, Samrakshane centre, or designated bank branch.
Pay the subsidised farmer share of premium (1.5% - 2%) before the seasonal deadline.
Intimate localized crop loss within 72 hours via Crop Insurance App in case of localized calamity.

important_dates.kharif_cut_off: Typically July 31 for major Kharif crops (per Karnataka notification)
important_dates.rabi_cut_off: Typically December 31 for major Rabi crops

important_current_notes: Karnataka operates Samrakshane portal synchronized with the central PMFBY portal.
Cut-off dates depend strictly on the district and crop season notification.
schemes.application_window: Seasonal (Kharif & Rabi cycles per district notification)
schemes.geographic_applicability: Notified taluks and gram panchayats in Karnataka

name.en: Restructured Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS)
name.kn: ಹವಾಮಾನ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಬೆಳೆ ವಿಮೆ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಆರ್‌ಡಬ್ಲ್ಯುಬಿಸಿಐಎಸ್)
name.hi: पुनर्गठित मौसम आधारित फसल बीमा योजना (आरडब्ल्यूबीसीआईएस)

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, MoA&FW & Karnataka Department of Horticulture

summary.en: Parametric weather-based insurance protecting horticulture crops (mango, pomegranate, grapes, arecanut, pepper) against adverse rainfall, temperature, and humidity triggers.
summary.kn: ತೋಟಗಾರಿಕಾ ಬೆಳೆಗಳಿಗೆ (ಮಾವು, ದಾಳಿಂಬೆ, ದ್ರಾಕ್ಷಿ, ಅಡಿಕೆ, ಕರಿಮೆಣಸು) ಮಳೆ, ತಾಪಮಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಆರ್ದ್ರತೆಯ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸಗಳಿಂದಾಗುವ ನಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೆ ಹವಾಮಾನ ಆಧಾರಿತ ವಿಮಾ ಪರಿಹಾರ.
summary.hi: बागवानी फसलों (आम, अनार, अंगूर, सुपारी, काली मिर्च) के लिए प्रतिकूल मौसम (वर्षा, तापमान, आर्द्रता) के आधार पर त्वरित पैरामीट्रिक बीमा दावा।

description.en: RWBCIS uses weather parameters measured at automated reference weather stations (RWS) to determine crop damage and trigger payouts without requiring physical crop-cutting experiments.
description.kn: ಸ್ವಯಂಚಾಲಿತ ಹವಾಮಾನ ಕೇಂದ್ರಗಳ (RWS) ದತ್ತಾಂಶದ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ತೋಟಗಾರಿಕಾ ಬೆಳೆಗಾರರಿಗೆ ನಷ್ಟ ಪರಿಹಾರವನ್ನು ಶೀಘ್ರವಾಗಿ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಪಾರದರ್ಶಕ ವಿಮಾ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: स्वचालित मौसम केंद्रों के आधार पर बिना खेत कटाई प्रयोग के सीधे बैंक खाते में क्षतिपूर्ति देने वाली बागवानी फसल योजना।

benefit.description: Claims automatically settled based on weather station trigger breaches. Farmers pay capped premium (5% for commercial/horticulture); balance paid by Central and State Governments.

eligibility_criteria: Farmers growing notified commercial or perennial horticultural crops in notified Karnataka hoblis/panchayats
Land recorded under horticulture crop cultivation in RTC

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must cultivate notified horticulture crops in notified Karnataka areas.

exclusions.description: Non-notified horticulture crops or unauthorized encroachments without RTC entry are excluded.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Horticulture crop grower.
schemes.land_criteria: RTC showing notified horticulture crop parcel.
process: Check notified horticulture crop calendar on Karnataka Samrakshane portal.
Enroll through Raitha Samparka Kendra, BangaloreOne, or commercial bank branch.
Automatic claim computation and DBT payout on weather trigger breach.
important_current_notes: No crop-cutting experiment needed; claims are automatically triggered by weather station sensors.
schemes.application_window: Seasonal per horticulture department notification
schemes.geographic_applicability: Notified horticulture districts in Karnataka (e.g., Kolar, Mandya, Chikkaballapura, Shimoga)

name.en: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
name.kn: ಕಿಸಾನ್ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ (ಕೆಸಿಸಿ) ಯೋಜನೆ
name.hi: किसान क्रेडिट कार्ड (केसीसी) योजना

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, MoA&FW & Reserve Bank of India / NABARD

summary.en: Adequate and timely short-term credit up to ₹3 Lakhs for cultivation expenses and animal husbandry at a subsidized 4% effective interest rate with prompt repayment.
summary.kn: ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಬೆಳೆ ಸಾಗುವಳಿ, ಬೀಜ, ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಹಾಗೂ ಪಶುಪಾಲನಾ ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ₹3 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗೆ ಸಕಾಲಿಕ ಸಾಲ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ. ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಮರುಪಾವತಿಸಿದರೆ ಕೇವಲ 4% ಬಡ್ಡಿದರ.
summary.hi: फसल उत्पादन, बीज, उर्वरक और पशुपालन के लिए ₹3 लाख तक की त्वरित ऋण सीमा, समय पर भुगतान करने पर मात्र 4% प्रभावी ब्याज दर।

description.en: KCC provides farmers with revolving cash credit to meet crop production, post-harvest expenses, maintenance of farm assets, and working capital for dairy and fisheries. 7% base interest with 3% prompt repayment incentive makes effective rate 4%.
description.kn: ಕಿಸಾನ್ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಮೂಲಕ ರೈತರು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಎಟಿಎಂ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಬಳಸಿ ಕೃಷಿ ಸಾಲ ಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು. 3% ಸಕಾಲಿಕ ಮರುಪಾವತಿ ಸಬ್ಸಿಡಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಕೇವಲ 4% ಆಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.
description.hi: केसीसी के माध्यम से किसान एटीएम कार्ड द्वारा बैंक खाते से अल्पकालिक ऋण ले सकते हैं। 3% शीघ्र पुनर्भुगतान छूट के साथ प्रभावी ब्याज केवल 4% है।

benefit.description: Credit limit up to ₹3 Lakhs at 7% per annum; prompt repayment gives 3% subvention, reducing effective interest rate to 4%. Collateral-free up to ₹1.60 Lakhs.

eligibility_criteria: All owner-cultivator farmers, sharecroppers, tenant farmers, and SHG/JLG agricultural collectives
Includes farmers engaged in animal husbandry, poultry, and inland fisheries

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must cultivate agricultural land or own dairy/fisheries assets.

exclusions.description: Defaulters on existing commercial bank agricultural loans without restructuring are excluded.

schemes.income_criteria: No ceiling. Credit scale of finance determines sanctioned limit.
schemes.age_criteria: 18 to 75 years (co-borrower required if age > 60 years).
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Practicing farmer, tenant farmer, or livestock rearer.
schemes.land_criteria: Cultivable land ownership document or verified lease agreement.

required_documents.note: Current Bhoomi RTC showing land extent.
Waived for loans up to ₹1.60 Lakhs under RBI rules.

process: Obtain simple 1-page KCC application form from bank or download from PM-KISAN portal.
Submit to the bank branch where PM-KISAN DBT is received, along with Bhoomi RTC.
Bank sanctions limit and issues RuPay KCC card within 14 days.

important_dates.tenure: 5 years validity with annual review and credit limit enhancement

important_current_notes: Collateral-free agricultural loan limit is ₹1.60 Lakhs under RBI circular.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round at all commercial, regional rural, and cooperative banks
schemes.geographic_applicability: All India (Active in all districts of Karnataka)

name.en: Karnataka Zero-Percent Interest Short-Term Crop Loan Scheme
name.kn: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಶೂನ್ಯ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ದರದ ಅಲ್ಪಾವಧಿ ಕೃಷಿ ಬೆಳೆ ಸಾಲ ಯೋಜನೆ
name.hi: कर्नाटक शून्य प्रतिशत ब्याज अल्पकालिक फसली ऋण योजना

schemes.department: Department of Cooperation, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Zero-percent (0%) interest short-term agricultural crop loans up to ₹5 Lakhs, and 3% interest medium/long-term loans up to ₹15 Lakhs through DCCBs and PACS.
summary.kn: ಡಿಸಿಸಿ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಕೃಷಿ ಪತ್ತಿನ ಸಹಕಾರ ಸಂಘಗಳ (PACS) ಮೂಲಕ ₹5 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗೆ ಶೂನ್ಯ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ದರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಲ್ಪಾವಧಿ ಬೆಳೆ ಸಾಲ ಮತ್ತು ₹15 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗೆ 3% ಬಡ್ಡಿದರದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃಷಿ ಸಾಲ.
summary.hi: कर्नाटक के जिला सहकारी बैंकों एवं पैक्स के माध्यम से ₹5 लाख तक शून्य प्रतिशत (0%) ब्याज पर अल्पकालिक फसली ऋण तथा ₹15 लाख तक 3% ब्याज पर दीर्घाकालिक ऋण।

description.en: Government of Karnataka provides 100% interest subsidy to cooperative banks so that farmers can avail short-term agricultural loans up to ₹5 Lakhs at zero percent interest, provided the loan is repaid within the due date.
description.kn: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ರೈತಪರ ಯೋಜನೆಯಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಸಹಕಾರಿ ಸಂಘಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಕಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಲ ಮರುಪಾವತಿ ಮಾಡುವ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ₹5 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗಿನ ಅಲ್ಪಾವಧಿ ಬೆಳೆ ಸಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಮನ್ನಾ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
description.hi: कर्नाटक सरकार द्वारा सहकारी बैंकों को ब्याज अनुदान देकर किसानों को ₹5 लाख तक के फसली ऋण पर ब्याज-मुक्त सुविधा प्रदान की जाती है।

benefit.description: Short-term crop loan up to ₹5,00,000 at 0% interest on prompt repayment. Medium and long-term loans up to ₹15,00,000 at 3% interest rate.

eligibility_criteria: Farmer must be an active member of the local Primary Agricultural Credit Cooperative Society (PACS) or DCC Bank in Karnataka
Must possess cultivable land within the jurisdiction of the cooperative society
Prompt repayment within 12 months or seasonal crop marketing cycle

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must hold cultivable agricultural land in Karnataka.

exclusions.description: Overdue borrowers from previous cooperative loan cycles who failed to repay are not eligible for interest subvention.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Member farmer of cooperative society in Karnataka.
schemes.land_criteria: Bhoomi RTC registered with the PACS.
process: Visit the local Primary Agricultural Credit Cooperative Society (PACS) in the village or hobli.
Submit loan application form with latest Bhoomi RTC and crop plan.
PACS verifies land record and issues loan sanction directly to the farmer's account.

important_dates.repayment_period: Within 1 year (12 months) of disbursement to avail 0% interest

important_current_notes: Enhanced ceiling of ₹5 Lakhs for short-term and ₹15 Lakhs for long-term announced by Karnataka State Budget.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round across all PACS and DCC banks in Karnataka

name.en: PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop (Micro-Irrigation Subsidy)
name.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಕೃಷಿ ಸಿಂಚಾಯಿ ಯೋಜನೆ - ಹನಿ ಮತ್ತು ತುಂತುರು ನೀರಾವರಿ
name.hi: प्रधानमंत्री कृषि सिंचाई योजना - प्रति बूंद अधिक फसल (सूक्ष्म सिंचाई)

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI & Karnataka Department of Agriculture

summary.en: Subsidies for drip and sprinkler irrigation installations: up to 90% subsidy for SC/ST small/marginal farmers and 45% - 55% for other farmers in Karnataka.
summary.kn: ಹನಿ ಮತ್ತು ತುಂತುರು ನೀರಾವರಿ ಅಳವಡಿಕೆಗೆ ಭಾರಿ ಸಹಾಯಧನ: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡದ ಸಣ್ಣ/ಅತಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಶೇ. 90 ವರೆಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಇತರೆ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಶೇ. 45-55 ರವರೆಗೆ ಸಹಾಯಧನ.
summary.hi: ड्रिप एवं स्प्रिंकलर सिंचाई प्रणालियों के लिए भारी सब्सिडी: कर्नाटक में एससी/एसटी लघु/सीमांत किसानों को 90% तक तथा अन्य किसानों को 45-55% तक अनुदान।

description.en: Per Drop More Crop focuses on water use efficiency at the farm level through micro-irrigation (drip and sprinkler systems), precision water application, and fertilizer application (fertigation).
description.kn: ಕೃಷಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರಿನ ಸದ್ಬಳಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಇಳುವರಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಲು ಹನಿ ಮತ್ತು ತುಂತುರು ನೀರಾವರಿ ಘಟಕಗಳನ್ನು ಅಳವಡಿಸಲು ಸರ್ಕಾರದಿಂದ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು.
description.hi: खेत स्तर पर जल उपयोग दक्षता बढ़ाने के लिए ड्रिप एवं स्प्रिंकलर सिस्टम लगाने हेतु सब्सिडी योजना।

benefit.description: Capital subsidy on approved micro-irrigation equipment: up to 90% for SC/ST small/marginal farmers (max 2 ha/5 acres), 45-55% for general category farmers.

eligibility_criteria: All farmers holding cultivable agricultural land with assured irrigation water source (borewell, open well, canal, or farm pond)
Priority to small and marginal farmers and women farmers
System must be procured from empanelled micro-irrigation suppliers in Karnataka

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must own cultivable land with an assured water source.

exclusions.description: Farmers who already availed micro-irrigation subsidy for the same survey number within the past 7 years are not eligible.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Landholding farmer with assured water source.
schemes.land_criteria: Up to 5 hectares (12.5 acres); highest subsidy rate capped at 2 hectares (5 acres).

required_documents.note: Current Bhoomi RTC showing water source.
Proof of energized borewell or irrigation source.

process: Apply online through Karnataka Agriculture / Horticulture Department portal or visit Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK).
Select empanelled micro-irrigation vendor and get field inspection report from Assistant Director of Agriculture/Horticulture.
Equipment installed at site; GPS-tagged verification conducted; subsidy released directly to vendor/farmer account via DBT.

important_dates.annual_allocation: Financial year basis with active quarterly sanction batches

important_current_notes: 90% subsidy for SC/ST and up to 55% for other farmers in Karnataka with state top-up contribution.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round subject to district annual budgetary targets

name.en: Krishi Bhagya Scheme (Farm Ponds & Rainfed Agriculture)
name.kn: ಕೃಷಿ ಭಾಗ್ಯ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಕೃಷಿ ಹೊಂಡ ಮತ್ತು ಮಳೆಯಾಶ್ರಿತ ಕೃಷಿ)
name.hi: कृषि भाग्य योजना (खेत तालाब एवं वर्षा आधारित कृषि)

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Comprehensive support for rainfed farmers in Karnataka: 80% to 90% subsidy for construction of farm ponds (Krishi Honda), polythene lining, diesel/solar pump sets, and shade nets.
summary.kn: ಮಳೆಯಾಶ್ರಿತ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಕೃಷಿ ಹೊಂಡ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣ, ಪಾಲಿಥೀನ್ ಹೊದಿಕೆ, ಡೀಸೆಲ್/ಸೌರ ಪಂಪ್‌ಸೆಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಹನಿ ನೀರಾವರಿ ಅಳವಡಿಕೆಗೆ ಶೇ. 80 ರಿಂದ 90 ರವರೆಗೆ ಸಹಾಯಧನ.
summary.hi: कर्नाटक के वर्षा आधारित किसानों के लिए खेत तालाब निर्माण, पॉलीथीन लाइनिंग, डीजल/सोलर पंपसेट और सूक्ष्म सिंचाई हेतु 80% से 90% तक सब्सिडी।

description.en: Krishi Bhagya is Karnataka's flagship initiative for rainfed farmers to harvest rainwater through on-farm ponds (Krishi Honda) lined with polythene films, lift water using pump sets, and protect dryland horticulture and food crops.
description.kn: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಮಳೆಯಾಶ್ರಿತ ತಾಲ್ಲೂಕುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ರೈತರ ಜಮೀನಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃಷಿ ಹೊಂಡ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ, ಮಳೆ ನೀರು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ ರಕ್ಷಣಾತ್ಮಕ ನೀರಾವರಿ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: वर्षा आधारित कृषि भूमि में वर्षा जल संचयन के लिए खेत तालाब बनाने और सूखाग्रस्त समय में जीवनरक्षक सिंचाई देने हेतु कर्नाटक सरकार की योजना।

benefit.description: 80% subsidy for general farmers and 90% subsidy for SC/ST farmers for farm pond construction, polythene lining, diesel/solar pump sets, and protective shade net enclosures.

eligibility_criteria: Rainfed/dryland farmers owning cultivable agricultural land in notified rainfed taluks of Karnataka
Minimum landholding of 1 acre; priority given to small and marginal farmers
Must undertake to maintain the farm pond and utilize collected water for agricultural crops

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must hold at least 1 acre of rainfed agricultural land.

exclusions.description: Lands with existing canal irrigation network or borewell water surplus are given lower priority or excluded.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Rainfed dryland farmer.
schemes.land_criteria: Minimum 1 acre rainfed land in Karnataka.

required_documents.note: Bhoomi RTC confirming rainfed dryland status.

process: Apply at the local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) or via Raita Mitra portal.
Agriculture Department engineers inspect site, determine pond dimensions (typically 12m x 12m or 21m x 21m) and issue work order.
After earth excavation and polythene sheet laying, department conducts GPS-tagged measurement and disburses subsidy via DBT.

important_dates.sanction_window: Pre-monsoon and early monsoon (April - August) for optimal excavation

important_current_notes: Fencing around farm ponds is mandatory under safety guidelines.
schemes.application_window: Active in rainfed taluks across Karnataka
schemes.geographic_applicability: Notified rainfed taluks across 25+ districts of Karnataka

name.en: Ganga Kalyana Scheme (Individual & Community Borewells)
name.kn: ಗಂಗಾ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಯೋಜನೆ (ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮುದಾಯ ಕೊಳವೆಬಾವಿ)
name.hi: गंगा कल्याण योजना (व्यक्तिगत एवं सामुदायिक नलकूप)

schemes.department: Karnataka Minorities Development Corp, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Development Corp, D. Devaraj Urs DC, GoK

summary.en: Free drilling of irrigation borewells, installation of submersible pumps, and power line energization for small/marginal farmers from SC, ST, Backward Classes, and Religious Minorities.
summary.kn: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ, ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡ, ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳ ಸಣ್ಣ/ಅತಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಉಚಿತ ಕೊಳವೆಬಾವಿ ಕೊರೆಯಿಸಿ, ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಪಂಪ್‌ಸೆಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ವಿದ್ಯುದ್ದೀಕರಣ ಕಲ್ಪಿಸುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.
summary.hi: कर्नाटक में अनुसूचित जाति, जनजाति, पिछड़ा वर्ग एवं अल्पसंख्यक समुदाय के लघु/सीमांत किसानों को पूर्णतः निःशुल्क नलकूप खनन, मोटर पंपसेट एवं विद्युतीकरण।

description.en: Under the Ganga Kalyana Scheme, the Government of Karnataka provides 100% subsidized irrigation facilities to small and marginal farmers belonging to SC, ST, OBC, and minority communities by drilling individual borewells or establishing community lift irrigation schemes.
description.kn: ಅರ್ಹ ಸಣ್ಣ ರೈತರ ಕೃಷಿ ಭೂಮಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊಳವೆಬಾವಿ ಕೊರೆದು, ಪಂಪ್‌ಸೆಟ್ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿ, ಎಸ್ಕಾಂ (ESCOM) ಮೂಲಕ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಕಲ್ಪಿಸುವ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಅನುದಾನಿತ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: लघु और सीमांत किसानों की शुष्क भूमि को सिंचित बनाने हेतु शत-प्रतिशत सरकारी अनुदान पर बोरवेल, पंपसेट और विद्युत कनेक्शन प्रदान करने की प्रमुख योजना।

benefit.description: Complete free provision of borewell drilling, casing pipe, submersible pump set, and electrical grid line installation up to ₹3.5 Lakhs per individual unit (or ₹4.5 Lakhs for community scheme).

eligibility_criteria: Applicant must belong to SC, ST, Backward Classes (Categories 1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B), or Religious Minorities in Karnataka
Must be a small or marginal farmer (landholding between 1.20 acres to 5 acres of dryland)
Annual family income must not exceed ₹1,50,000 for rural areas and ₹2,00,000 for urban areas
No member of the applicant's family should have previously benefited from the scheme

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must hold at least 1.20 acres of cultivable dryland.
Annual household income must not exceed ₹1,50,000 for rural areas.

exclusions.description: Families with members in permanent government employment or with previous government borewell sanction are excluded.

schemes.income_criteria: Annual family income not exceeding ₹1,50,000 (rural) or ₹2,00,000 (urban).
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Small and marginal farmers.
schemes.land_criteria: Minimum 1.20 acres to maximum 5.0 acres of dryland agricultural holding in Karnataka.

required_documents.note: Issued by Tahsildar (e-Pramana with RD number).
Issued by Tahsildar showing income ≤ ₹1.5 Lakhs.
Latest Bhoomi RTC in applicant's name.
Issued by Assistant Director of Agriculture.
Stating no previous borewell benefit received.

process: Apply online through Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in) or welfare corporation portals during notification window.
District screening committee headed by MLA/DC verifies land documents and selects eligible beneficiaries.
Corporation assigns government drilling rig, hydrogeologist conducts water survey, drilling and pump installation carried out.
Coordination with ESCOM for free agricultural power line connection.

important_dates.notification_period: Annual notification released on Seva Sindhu; applications currently open for ongoing cycle

important_current_notes: Unified online application through Seva Sindhu; e-Pramana RD number verification mandatory.
schemes.application_window: Applications open for current year cycle via Seva Sindhu

name.en: Raitha Siri Scheme (Minor Millets Cultivation Incentive)
name.kn: ರೈತ ಸಿರಿ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಸಿರಿಧಾನ್ಯ ಬೆಳೆಗಾರರ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಧನ)
name.hi: रैता सिरी योजना (कंद / लघु कदन्न प्रोत्साहन योजना)

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Direct incentive of ₹10,000 per hectare (up to max 2 hectares / ₹20,000) credited directly to bank accounts of farmers cultivating six notified minor millets.
summary.kn: ಆರು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಸಿರಿಧಾನ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೆಕ್ಟೇರ್‌ಗೆ ₹10,000 (ಗರಿಷ್ಠ 2 ಹೆಕ್ಟೇರ್‌ಗೆ ₹20,000) ನೇರ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಧನವನ್ನು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ನೀಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: कर्नाटक में 6 अधिसूचित लघु कदन्नों (श्रीअन्न) की खेती करने वाले किसानों को ₹10,000 प्रति हेक्टेयर (अधिकतम 2 हेक्टेयर हेतु ₹20,000) प्रत्यक्ष प्रोत्साहन डीबीटी।

description.en: Raitha Siri promotes climate-resilient minor millets cultivation in Karnataka. Farmers cultivating Foxtail millet (Navane), Little millet (Same), Kodo millet (Haraka), Proso millet (Baragu), Barnyard millet (Oodalu), and Brown top millet (Korale) receive ₹10,000 per hectare.
description.kn: ನವಣೆ, ಸಾಮೆ, ಹಾರಕ, ಬರಗು, ಊದಲು ಮತ್ತು ಕೊರಲೆ ಸಿರಿಧಾನ್ಯ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಹೆಕ್ಟೇರ್‌ಗೆ ₹10,000 ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಧನ ನೀಡುವ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಮಹತ್ವಾಕಾಂಕ್ಷೆಯ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: कंगनी, कुटकी, कोदो, चेना, सांवा और मकरा जैसे पौष्टिक श्रीअन्न उगाने वाले किसानों को सीधे वित्तीय सहायता।

benefit.description: Direct financial incentive of ₹10,000 per hectare, up to a maximum of 2 hectares (₹20,000) directly into the farmer's Aadhaar-linked bank account.

eligibility_criteria: Farmers growing any of the 6 notified minor millets in Karnataka during the Kharif/Rabi seasons
Millet cultivation must be recorded in the state crop survey (Bele Darshini) and Bhoomi RTC
Maximum assistance capped at 2 hectares per farmer family

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must cultivate notified minor millets recorded in state crop survey.

exclusions.description: Cultivation of major millets (Ragi and Jowar) is supported under separate procurement schemes and excluded here.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Millet cultivating farmer.
schemes.land_criteria: Up to 2 hectares (approx. 5 acres) eligible for incentive.

required_documents.note: Current Bhoomi RTC showing minor millet crop.

process: Complete mandatory digital crop survey using Karnataka Farmer Crop Survey mobile app.
Verify that minor millet crop is correctly recorded in Bhoomi RTC.
Agriculture Department verifies crop survey data and credits ₹10,000/ha directly via DBT.
important_current_notes: Farmer Crop Survey (ರೈತರ ಬೆಳೆ ಸಮೀಕ್ಷೆ) verification is mandatory for DBT release.
schemes.application_window: Active for notified crop seasons across Karnataka
schemes.geographic_applicability: All Districts of Karnataka (Especially Chitradurga, Tumakuru, Mandya, Haveri, Koppal)

name.en: Chief Minister's Raitha Vidya Nidhi Scholarship Scheme
name.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳ ರೈತ ವಿದ್ಯಾ ನಿಧಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ ಯೋಜನೆ
name.hi: मुख्यमंत्री रैता विद्या निधि छात्रवृत्ति योजना

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka & SSP Portal

summary.en: Annual scholarship ranging from ₹2,000 to ₹11,000 for children of landholding farmers pursuing post-matriculation, degree, professional, and postgraduate courses.
summary.kn: ಭೂಮಾಲೀಕ ರೈತರ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಪಿಯುಸಿ, ಐಟಿಐ, ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ, ಪದವಿ, ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ನಾತಕೋತ್ತರ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹2,000 ದಿಂದ ₹11,000 ವರೆಗೆ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
summary.hi: भूमिधारक किसानों के बच्चों को 10वीं के बाद (पीयूसी, डिप्लोमा, डिग्री, मेडिकल, इंजीनियरिंग) उच्च शिक्षा हेतु वार्षिक ₹2,000 से ₹11,000 की छात्रवृत्ति।

description.en: Raitha Vidya Nidhi is Karnataka's landmark education assistance scheme for children of farmers. It provides direct scholarship amounts to encourage rural youth from agricultural families to pursue higher education.
description.kn: ಕೃಷಿಕರ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಉನ್ನತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದಿಂದ ವಂಚಿತರಾಗಬಾರದು ಎಂಬ ಉದ್ದೇಶದಿಂದ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಕೃಷಿ ಇಲಾಖೆ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಜ್ಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶದ (SSP) ಮೂಲಕ ನೀಡಲಾಗುವ ನೆರವು.
description.hi: किसान परिवारों के बच्चों को उच्च शिक्षा के लिए प्रोत्साहित करने हेतु कर्नाटक सरकार द्वारा सीधे छात्रों के बैंक खाते में दी जाने वाली छात्रवृत्ति।

benefit.description: Annual scholarship amount: ₹2,000 - ₹2,500 (PUC/ITI/Diploma), ₹5,000 - ₹5,500 (BA/B.Sc/B.Com), ₹10,000 - ₹11,000 (Medical/Engineering/Law/PG). Girls receive additional ₹500 to ₹1,000 incentive.

eligibility_criteria: Parent must be a registered landholding farmer in Karnataka with Bhoomi RTC or FRUITS ID
Student must have passed 10th standard (SSLC) and be enrolled in a recognised post-matric institution
Automatically integrated with Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP)

eligibility_rules.description: Student's parent must be a recorded landholding farmer in Karnataka.

exclusions.description: Students who are not enrolled in recognized courses or whose parents possess no agricultural land in Bhoomi portal are excluded.

schemes.income_criteria: No income ceiling (benefits all farmer categories owning land).
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Student enrolled in Class 11/PUC and higher; parent is an agriculturalist.
schemes.land_criteria: Parent must own cultivable agricultural land in Karnataka.

required_documents.note: FRUITS ID (Farmer Registration and Unified Beneficiary Information System) or RTC.

process: Obtain parent's FRUITS ID (Farmer ID) from nearest Raitha Samparka Kendra or Bhoomi portal.
Apply online through Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in).
Select Raitha Vidya Nidhi under Agriculture Department option and enter parent's FID/Aadhaar.
System auto-verifies college admission data and DBT is credited to student's bank account.

important_dates.academic_cycle: Synchronized with SSP Post-Matric application dates

important_current_notes: Female students receive an additional ₹500 to ₹1,000 scholarship over standard rates.
schemes.application_window: Open during academic year on SSP portal

name.en: Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) Certified Seed Distribution Scheme
name.kn: ರೈತ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಕೇಂದ್ರ (ಆರ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಕೆ) ಪ್ರಮಾಣೀಕೃತ ಬಿತ್ತನೆ ಬೀಜ ಸಹಾಯಧನ ಯೋಜನೆ
name.hi: रैता संपर्क केंद्र प्रमाणित बीज वितरण सब्सिडी योजना

schemes.department: Karnataka State Seeds Corporation & Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Distribution of certified high-yielding crop seeds (Paddy, Ragi, Maize, Pulses, Oilseeds) at 50% to 75% subsidized rates directly to farmers through village-level Raitha Samparka Kendras.
summary.kn: ರೈತ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಕೇಂದ್ರಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಭತ್ತ, ರಾಗಿ, ಮೆಕ್ಕೆಜೋಳ, ತೊಗರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಎಣ್ಣೆಕಾಳುಗಳ ಪ್ರಮಾಣೀಕೃತ ಬಿತ್ತನೆ ಬೀಜಗಳನ್ನು ಶೇ. 50 ರಿಂದ 75 ರ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ ದರದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿತರಣೆ.
summary.hi: ग्राम स्तर के रैता संपर्क केंद्रों के माध्यम से धान, रागी, मक्का, दालों और तिलहनों के प्रमाणित बीजों पर 50% से 75% तक की रियायती दरें।

description.en: To ensure seed security and promote high productivity, certified seeds produced by Karnataka State Seeds Corporation and agricultural universities are distributed with direct price subsidy through RSKs before each sowing season.
description.kn: ಉತ್ತಮ ಇಳುವರಿ ನೀಡುವ ದೃಢೀಕೃತ ಬಿತ್ತನೆ ಬೀಜಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಂಗಾರು ಮತ್ತು ಹಿಂಗಾರು ಹಂಗಾಮುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ ದರದಲ್ಲಿ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: बुवाई के मौसम से पूर्व किसानों को उत्तम गुणवत्ता के प्रमाणित बीज न्यूनतम मूल्य पर उपलब्ध कराने का राज्यव्यापी कार्यक्रम।

benefit.description: 50% subsidy for general category farmers and up to 75% subsidy for SC/ST small/marginal farmers on approved seed varieties.

eligibility_criteria: All landholding and tenant farmers in Karnataka holding Bhoomi RTC or FRUITS ID
Seed quantity allocated based on land area up to a maximum of 5 acres per farmer

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must hold cultivable land recorded in Bhoomi / FRUITS.

exclusions.description: Commercial traders and non-farming intermediaries are strictly barred.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Cultivating farmer.

required_documents.item: Land Record (RTC / Pahani) or FRUITS ID

process: Visit local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) at Hobli level before sowing window.
Present Aadhaar and FRUITS ID / Bhoomi RTC for biometric Point of Sale (POS) validation.
Pay subsidized farmer contribution and collect certified seed packets on the spot.
important_current_notes: Distribution through biometric POS machines linked to FRUITS database ensures zero diversion.
schemes.application_window: Seasonal (Pre-sowing windows for Kharif and Rabi)

name.en: Soil Health Card Digital Scheme
name.kn: ಮಣ್ಣು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಯೋಜನೆ
name.hi: मृदा स्वास्थ्य कार्ड डिजिटल योजना

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI

summary.en: Free periodic soil nutrient testing and customised digital Soil Health Cards with crop-wise dosage recommendations for 12 essential nutrients.
summary.kn: ರೈತರ ಜಮೀನಿನ ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಮಾದರಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ, 12 ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಪೋಷಕಾಂಶಗಳ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಬೆಳೆವಾರು ರಸಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಬಳಕೆಯ ಶಿಫಾರಸುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಉಚಿತ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಮಣ್ಣು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕಾರ್ಡ್.
summary.hi: खेत की मिट्टी का निःशुल्क वैज्ञानिक परीक्षण और 12 पोषक तत्वों की स्थिति तथा फसलवार संतुलित उर्वरक सिफारिशों वाला डिजिटल मृदा स्वास्थ्य कार्ड।

description.en: The Soil Health Card Scheme provides farmers with scientific information on the nutrient status of their agricultural soil (N, P, K, pH, EC, Organic Carbon, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo) and tailored fertilizer recommendations to lower cultivation costs and prevent soil degradation.
description.kn: ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಫಲವತ್ತತೆಯನ್ನು ಸುಧಾರಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಅನಗತ್ಯ ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಗೊಬ್ಬರಗಳ ವೆಚ್ಚವನ್ನು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡಲು ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಮಣ್ಣು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ವಿತರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
description.hi: अनावश्यक रासायनिक खादों की लागत घटाने और मिट्टी की उर्वरता बनाए रखने हेतु किसानों को मृदा स्वास्थ्य रिपोर्ट दी जाती है।

benefit.description: Free scientific soil sampling, laboratory analysis, and printed/digital Soil Health Card issued every 3 years with precise crop-wise fertilizer dosage charts.

eligibility_criteria: All farmers holding agricultural land in Karnataka
Both irrigated and rainfed holdings eligible for soil grid collection

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must hold cultivable agricultural land.

schemes.income_criteria: No income ceiling. Free service for all farmers.
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Cultivating farmer.
schemes.land_criteria: Cultivable land holding in state records.

required_documents.note: Survey number identification for grid sample.

process: Agricultural officers or village level workers collect GPS-tagged soil samples from the survey number.
Samples analyzed in district/taluk Soil Testing Laboratories (STLs).
Digital Soil Health Card generated on soilhealth.dac.gov.in portal; printed card delivered via RSK or downloaded online.
important_current_notes: Digital portal integration allows farmers to download their card anytime using state, district, and survey number.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round on national digital portal
schemes.geographic_applicability: All India (Active in all 31 Karnataka districts)

name.en: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY - Organic Farming Clusters)
name.kn: ಪರಂಪರಾಗತ್ ಕೃಷಿ ವಿಕಾಸ್ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಪಿಕೆವಿವೈ - ಸಾವಯವ ಕೃಷಿ)
name.hi: परम्परागत कृषि विकास योजना (पीकेवीवाई - जैविक खेती)

schemes.department: National Centre of Organic and Natural Farming, MoA&FW, GoI

summary.en: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years for cluster-based organic farming, PGS certification, organic inputs, bio-fertilizers, and market branding.
summary.kn: ಸಾವಯವ ಕೃಷಿ ಗುಂಪುಗಳಿಗೆ (ಕ್ಲಸ್ಟರ್) 3 ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೆಕ್ಟೇರ್‌ಗೆ ₹50,000 ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು: ಸಾವಯವ ಗೊಬ್ಬರ, ಪಿಜಿಎಸ್ ಪ್ರಮಾಣೀಕರಣ, ಪ್ಯಾಕಿಂಗ್ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ.
summary.hi: जैविक खेती समूहों को 3 वर्षों में ₹50,000 प्रति हेक्टेयर की वित्तीय सहायता: जैविक खाद, पीजीएस प्रमाणीकरण, पैकेजिंग और विपणन।

description.en: PKVY promotes commercial organic farming through cluster approach and Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) certification. Of ₹50,000/ha assistance, ₹31,000/ha is directly given to farmers for organic inputs (seeds, bio-fertilizers, bio-pesticides, vermicompost).
description.kn: ಸಾವಯವ ಕೃಷಿ ಪದ್ಧತಿಯನ್ನು ಉತ್ತೇಜಿಸಲು 20 ಹೆಕ್ಟೇರ್‌ನ ಕ್ಲಸ್ಟರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ರಚಿಸಿ, ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಸಾವಯವ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಉಚಿತ ಪ್ರಮಾಣೀಕರಣ ನೀಡುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: किसानों के 20-50 हेक्टेयर के क्लस्टर बनाकर पीजीएस जैविक प्रमाणीकरण और जैविक खाद उत्पादन हेतु प्रत्यक्ष सहायता।

benefit.description: ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years (including ₹31,000/ha direct DBT for organic inputs and balance for PGS certification, testing, and value addition).

eligibility_criteria: Farmers willing to form organic farming clusters of 20 to 50 hectares (minimum 20-50 farmers per cluster)
Committed to adopt organic practices and PGS-India peer review certification without synthetic chemicals

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must hold agricultural land committed to organic conversion.

exclusions.description: Farmers continuing chemical pesticide usage are disqualified from PGS certification.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Organic farmer / group member.
schemes.land_criteria: Up to 2 hectares per farmer within the cluster.

required_documents.note: Signed by cluster coordinator / RSK officer.

process: Form cluster of 20+ farmers through local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK).
Register cluster on PGS-India portal (pgsindia-ncof.gov.in).
Receive input subsidy directly via DBT and participate in annual peer inspections.

important_dates.conversion_tenure: 3-year conversion cycle to attain certified green/organic status

important_current_notes: Zero certification fee under PGS-India decentralized system.
schemes.application_window: Open via district agriculture departments and RSKs

name.en: National Mission on Natural Farming (NMNF)
name.kn: ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ ಕೃಷಿ ಮಿಷನ್ (ಎನ್‌ಎಂಎನ್‌ಎಫ್)
name.hi: राष्ट्रीय प्राकृतिक खेती मिशन (एनएमएनएफ)

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI

summary.en: Financial assistance of ₹15,000 per hectare per year (for up to 3 years) for adopting indigenous cow-based natural farming, preparing Jeevamrutha, and establishing bio-input resource centres.
summary.kn: ದೇಸಿ ಹಸು ಆಧಾರಿತ ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ ಕೃಷಿ (ಜೀವಾಮೃತ, ಬೀಜಾಮೃತ) ಅಳವಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೆಕ್ಟೇರ್‌ಗೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹15,000 ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಧನ.
summary.hi: देशी गाय आधारित प्राकृतिक खेती (जीवामृत, बीजामृत) अपनाने वाले किसानों को ₹15,000 प्रति हेक्टेयर प्रति वर्ष की वित्तीय सहायता।

description.en: NMNF promotes chemical-free, climate-resilient natural farming based on livestock integration, bio-inputs (Beejamrit, Jeevamrit, Neemastra), mulch, and soil aeration without external synthetic chemicals.
description.kn: ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಮುಕ್ತ ಕೃಷಿಯನ್ನು ಉತ್ತೇಜಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ಪಾದನಾ ವೆಚ್ಚವನ್ನು ತಗ್ಗಿಸಲು ದೇಸಿ ಹಸುಗಳ ಸಗಣಿ-ಗಂಜಲ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಕೃಷಿ ಪದ್ಧತಿಗೆ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹ.
description.hi: रसायन मुक्त पर्यावरण अनुकूल खेती को बढ़ावा देने हेतु गो-आधारित प्राकृतिक कृषि पद्धतियों के लिए राष्ट्रीय मिशन।

benefit.description: Financial assistance of ₹15,000 per hectare per year for 3 years, plus ₹1,000 per month maintenance allowance for indigenous cow rearers adopting natural farming.

eligibility_criteria: Farmers cultivating land who commit to practice natural farming without chemical fertilizers or synthetic pesticides
Priority to farmers maintaining indigenous (desi) cattle

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must hold cultivable land practicing natural farming.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Practicing natural farmer.
schemes.land_criteria: Up to 2 hectares per farmer family.
process: Enroll on National Natural Farming Portal (naturalfarming.dac.gov.in) or at nearest RSK.
Attend practical training on Jeevamrutha preparation organized by Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK).
Receive field inspection and DBT instalment credits directly to bank account.
important_current_notes: Master trainers (Kisan Mitras) appointed at Gram Panchayat level to handhold farmers.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round on national portal

name.en: Savayava Bhagya Yojana (Karnataka Organic Village Project)
name.kn: ಸಾವಯವ ಭಾಗ್ಯ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸಾವಯವ ಗ್ರಾಮ ಯೋಜನೆ)
name.hi: सावयव भाग्य योजना (कर्नाटक जैविक ग्राम परियोजना)

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: State support for establishing 100-hectare organic farming model villages, vermicompost units, bio-digesters, and direct organic farmer-consumer market outlets.
summary.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೋಬಳಿಗೆ 100 ಹೆಕ್ಟೇರ್ ಸಾವಯವ ಮಾದರಿ ಗ್ರಾಮಗಳ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆ, ಎರೆಹುಳು ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ತೊಟ್ಟಿ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣಕ್ಕೆ ಸಹಾಯಧನ, ಮತ್ತು ನೇರ ಸಾವಯವ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಮಳಿಗೆಗಳ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣ.
summary.hi: कर्नाटक में 100 हेक्टेयर के मॉडल जैविक गांवों की स्थापना, केंचुआ खाद (वर्मीकम्पोस्ट) इकाइयों हेतु सब्सिडी एवं सीधे जैविक विक्रय केंद्र।

description.en: Savayava Bhagya Yojana is Karnataka's state-funded initiative creating 100-hectare model organic villages in every Hobli, providing input subsidies for vermicomposting, bio-gas digesters, and Jaivik Krishik Society market linkages.
description.kn: ರೈತರು ವಿಷಮುಕ್ತ ಆಹಾರ ಬೆಳೆಯಲು ಮತ್ತು ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಸಾರವನ್ನು ಪುನಶ್ಚೇತನಗೊಳಿಸಲು ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಎರೆಹುಳು ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಘಟಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾವಯವ ಒಕ್ಕೂಟಗಳ ನೆರವು.
description.hi: राज्यभर में जैविक किसान संघों का गठन कर वर्मीकम्पोस्ट निर्माण और जैविक आउटलेट की स्थापना।

benefit.description: 50% to 75% subsidy (up to ₹25,000) for vermicompost units and bio-digesters, plus free organic certification and dedicated shelf space in Jaivik Mall outlets.

eligibility_criteria: Landholding farmers in Karnataka residing within designated Savayava Bhagya Hobli clusters
Commitment to construct vermicompost pits or install bio-digesters on their land

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must own agricultural land in Karnataka.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Farmer in Karnataka.
process: Contact Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) or Raitha Samparka Kendra at Hobli level.
Register for vermicompost unit assistance and organic cluster membership.
Complete construction; field verification by agriculture officer; subsidy credited to account.
important_current_notes: Products marketed under Karnataka state 'Jaivik' brand.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round across RSK offices

name.en: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM - Machinery Subsidy)
name.kn: ಕೃಷಿ ಯಾಂತ್ರೀಕರಣ ಉಪ-ಅಭಿಯಾನ (ಕೃಷಿ ಯಂತ್ರೋಪಕರಣ ಸಹಾಯಧನ)
name.hi: कृषि यंत्रीकरण उप-मिशन (कृषि यंत्र अनुदान योजना)

schemes.department: Mechanization and Technology Division, MoA&FW & Karnataka Agriculture Department

summary.en: 40% to 50% capital subsidy on tractors, power tillers, rotavators, paddy transplanters, harvesters, and crop protection equipment directly through the DBT portal.
summary.kn: ಟ್ರಾಕ್ಟರ್, ಪವರ್ ಟಿಲ್ಲರ್, ರೋಟಾವೇಟರ್, ಕಳೆ ಕತ್ತರಿಸುವ ಯಂತ್ರ, ಭತ್ತ ನಾಟಿ ಯಂತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಯ್ಲು ಯಂತ್ರಗಳ ಖರೀದಿಗೆ ಶೇ. 40 ರಿಂದ 50 ರವರೆಗೆ ಸಹಾಯಧನ.
summary.hi: ट्रैक्टर, पावर टिलर, रोटावेटर, पैडी ट्रांसप्लांटर और रीपर जैसे आधुनिक कृषि उपकरणों पर 40% से 50% तक प्रत्यक्ष सरकारी सब्सिडी।

description.en: SMAM promotes farm mechanization to overcome agricultural labor shortages, improve timeliness of farm operations, and reduce cost of cultivation. Subsidies are provided for individual farm machinery and establishment of custom hiring centres.
description.kn: ಕೃಷಿ ಕೂಲಿ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರ ಕೊರತೆ ನೀಗಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಕೃಷಿ ಉತ್ಪಾದಕತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಲು ಸಣ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಅತಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಆಧುನಿಕ ಯಂತ್ರೋಪಕರಣಗಳ ಖರೀದಿಗೆ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು.
description.hi: आधुनिक कृषि यंत्रों की खरीद पर डीबीटी के माध्यम से सीधे बैंक खाते में सब्सिडी देकर मशीनीकरण को बढ़ावा देना।

benefit.description: 40% subsidy for general category farmers (up to ₹2.5 Lakhs for tractors) and 50% subsidy for SC, ST, small/marginal, and women farmers.

eligibility_criteria: All landholding farmers in Karnataka registered on Bhoomi or FRUITS portal
Must not have availed subsidy for the same category of machinery within the past 5 to 7 years

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must hold cultivable land in Karnataka.

exclusions.description: Beneficiaries who sold subsidized machinery or claimed the same machine type within 5 years are excluded.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Cultivating landholder.
schemes.land_criteria: Bhoomi RTC indicating farm holding extent.
process: Register and apply online on Central SMAM portal (agrimachinery.nic.in) or Karnataka Raita Mitra portal.
Select required equipment model from empanelled manufacturers and upload quotation.
District screening committee sanctions application; purchase equipment from authorized dealer.
Physical inspection and GPS-photograph by agricultural officer; subsidy disbursed via DBT.

important_dates.application_batches: Quarterly target batches published on portal

important_current_notes: Priority given to small, marginal, and women farmers in lottery selection when applications exceed budget.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round on national portal
schemes.geographic_applicability: All India (Active in all 31 Karnataka districts)

name.en: Krishi Yanthradhare Custom Hiring Service Centres (CHSCs)
name.kn: ಕೃಷಿ ಯಂತ್ರಧಾರೆ ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಸೇವಾ ಕೇಂದ್ರಗಳು
name.hi: कृषि यंत्रधारे कस्टम हायरिंग सेवा केंद्र

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Access to heavy and specialized farm machinery (tractors, combine harvesters, laser levellers, rotavators) on a nominal, government-regulated hourly rental basis at the Hobli level.
summary.kn: ಹೋಬಳಿ ಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಲಾದ ಕೃಷಿ ಯಂತ್ರಧಾರೆ ಕೇಂದ್ರಗಳಿಂದ ಟ್ರಾಕ್ಟರ್, ಕಟಾವು ಯಂತ್ರ, ರೋಟಾವೇಟರ್ ಮುಂತಾದ ದುಬಾರಿ ಯಂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ದರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ.
summary.hi: होबली स्तर के केंद्रों से महंगे कृषि यंत्र (ट्रैक्टर, कंबाइन हार्वेस्टर, लेजर लेवलर) रियायती घंटेवार सरकारी किराये पर लेने की सुविधा।

description.en: Krishi Yanthradhare centres set up across Karnataka hoblis allow small and marginal farmers who cannot afford to purchase expensive machinery to hire modern equipment at regulated, affordable rental rates.
description.kn: ದುಬಾರಿ ಯಂತ್ರೋಪಕರಣಗಳನ್ನು ಸ್ವಂತವಾಗಿ ಖರೀದಿಸಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗದ ಸಣ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಅತಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ನಿಗದಿತ ದರದಲ್ಲಿ ಯಂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಬಾಡಿಗೆಗೆ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿಕಾರಿ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: लघु और सीमांत किसानों को खेती की लागत कम करने हेतु आधुनिक कृषि यंत्र किफायती किराये पर उपलब्ध कराने वाली कर्नाटक सरकार की सेवा।

benefit.description: Regulated rental rates 30% to 50% below open market commercial rates for tractors, power weeders, combine harvesters, and sprayers.

eligibility_criteria: All farmers cultivating land in Karnataka; priority to small and marginal farmers
Booking made on first-come-first-served basis at local Hobli centre or via mobile app

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be a farmer with agricultural holding in Karnataka.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Farmer in Karnataka.

required_documents.note: Proof of farm location for machinery deployment.

process: Visit nearest Krishi Yanthradhare centre at Hobli level or book through mobile app.
Select required equipment, enter survey number, and book desired date and operating hours.
Machinery delivered with trained operator; pay regulated rental charges upon completion.

important_dates.availability: Open daily across all operating Hobli centres

important_current_notes: Over 500+ CHSCs operating across all taluks of Karnataka.
schemes.application_window: Open daily on-demand at all Hobli CHSCs

name.en: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
name.kn: ತೋಟಗಾರಿಕಾ ಸಮಗ್ರ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಮಿಷನ್ (ಎಂಐಡಿಹೆಚ್)
name.hi: एकीकृत बागवानी विकास मिशन (एमआईडीएच)

schemes.department: Horticulture Division, MoA&FW, GoI & Karnataka Department of Horticulture

summary.en: Capital assistance up to 40% - 50% for high-density fruit orchards, protected polyhouses, shade net structures, hi-tech nurseries, mushroom units, and cold storages.
summary.kn: ಹಣ್ಣು ಬೆಳೆಗಳ ತೋಟ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆ, ಪಾಲಿಹೌಸ್, ನೆರಳು ಪರದೆ (ಶೇಡ್ ನೆಟ್), ಹೈಟೆಕ್ ನರ್ಸರಿ, ಅಣಬೆ ಕೃಷಿ ಮತ್ತು ಶೀತಲ ಗೋದಾಮುಗಳ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣಕ್ಕೆ ಶೇ. 40 ರಿಂದ 50 ರವರೆಗೆ ಸಹಾಯಧನ.
summary.hi: फलों के नए बगीचे, पॉलीहाउस, शेडनेट हाउस, मशरूम उत्पादन, कोल्ड स्टोरेज और पैक हाउस निर्माण हेतु 40% से 50% तक पूंजीगत अनुदान।

description.en: MIDH promotes holistic growth of the horticulture sector covering fruits, vegetables, root and tuber crops, mushrooms, spices, flowers, and aromatic plants through quality planting material, protected cultivation, and post-harvest management.
description.kn: ತೋಟಗಾರಿಕಾ ಬೆಳೆಗಳ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆ ಮತ್ತು ರಫ್ತು ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಲು ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಸಸಿಗಳು, ಹನಿ ನೀರಾವರಿ, ಸಂರಕ್ಷಿತ ಬೇಸಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಯ್ಲೋತ್ತರ ಶೀತಲ ಘಟಕಗಳಿಗೆ ನೆರವು ನೀಡುವ ಕೇಂದ್ರ-ರಾಜ್ಯ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: बागवानी फसलों की गुणवत्ता और किसानों की आय में वृद्धि हेतु संरक्षित खेती एवं भंडारण अधोसंरचना पर सब्सिडी।

benefit.description: 40% to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹30 Lakhs depending on component: ₹1.60 Lakh/ha for new orchards; ₹335/sq.m for shade nets; ₹467/sq.m for tubular polyhouses; 35% on cold chain projects).

eligibility_criteria: All farmers owning cultivable agricultural land suitable for horticulture in Karnataka
Individual farmers, farmer groups, SHGs, and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must hold cultivable land suitable for horticulture crops.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Horticulture cultivator.
schemes.land_criteria: Bhoomi RTC showing ownership of the project parcel.
process: Apply online through Karnataka Horticulture Department portal or submit proposal to Senior Assistant Director of Horticulture (SADH).
Technical verification and site inspection by horticulture department engineers.
Work order issued; post-construction GPS verification; subsidy released directly to bank account via DBT.

important_dates.annual_targets: District action plans finalized in April-May annually

important_current_notes: Karnataka ranks among top states in MIDH protected cultivation implementation.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round subject to district physical and financial targets

name.en: Comprehensive Horticulture Development Scheme (Polyhouse & Shade Net)
name.kn: ಸಮಗ್ರ ತೋಟಗಾರಿಕಾ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಪಾಲಿಹೌಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಹಸಿರು ಮನೆ ಸಹಾಯಧನ)
name.hi: व्यापक बागवानी विकास योजना (पॉलीहाउस एवं ग्रीनहाउस अनुदान)

schemes.department: Department of Horticulture, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Karnataka state top-up subsidy providing up to 50% - 75% total financial assistance for establishing naturally ventilated polyhouses and shade net structures for exotic flowers and vegetables.
summary.kn: ಗುಲಾಬಿ, ಜರ್ಬೆರಾ, ಕಾರ್ನೇಶನ್ ಹೂಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ಯಾಪ್ಸಿಕಂ ಮುಂತಾದ ತರಕಾರಿ ಬೆಳೆಯಲು ಹಸಿರುಮನೆ/ಪಾಲಿಹೌಸ್ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣಕ್ಕೆ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಸಹಾಯಧನ (ಶೇ. 50 ರಿಂದ 75 ರವರೆಗೆ).
summary.hi: गुलाब, जरबेरा, शिमला मिर्च जैसी उच्च मूल्य फसलों की संरक्षित खेती हेतु पॉलीहाउस और शेडनेट निर्माण पर 50% से 75% तक संयुक्त सरकारी सहायता।

description.en: Karnataka offers state-specific top-up assistance over central guidelines to encourage young and progressive farmers to adopt high-value protected floriculture and olericulture with climate control and fertigation systems.
description.kn: ರೈತರು ಹವಾಮಾನ ವೈಪರೀತ್ಯದಿಂದ ಮುಕ್ತವಾಗಿ ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯಿಕವಾಗಿ ಅಧಿಕ ಆದಾಯ ಗಳಿಸಲು ನೆರವಾಗುವ ರಾಜ್ಯ ತೋಟಗಾರಿಕಾ ಇಲಾಖೆಯ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: जलवायु परिवर्तन के प्रभाव से बचकर वर्षभर विदेशी सब्जियों और फूलों की खेती करने हेतु राज्य सरकार की विशेष प्रोत्साहन योजना।

benefit.description: 50% general subsidy and up to 75% subsidy for SC/ST farmers for naturally ventilated polyhouses (minimum 1,000 sq.m to maximum 4,000 sq.m) with maximum assistance up to ₹18 Lakhs.

eligibility_criteria: Farmers possessing agricultural land with perennial irrigation source in Karnataka
Minimum area of 1,000 square meters (approx. 10 guntas)
Undertake to cultivate high-value horticulture crops for at least 5 years

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must hold at least 10 guntas (0.25 acres) of land with assured water.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Cultivating farmer with assured water source.
process: Submit online application via Karnataka Horticulture Department portal.
District level committee reviews DPR, conducts pre-construction site inspection, and issues work permit.
Construct polyhouse structure through empanelled agency; post-completion technical audit; subsidy released via DBT.

important_dates.application_window: Applications currently open for current financial year allocation

important_current_notes: Empanelled agency list and technical standards updated on department website.
schemes.application_window: Applications open on Karnataka Horticulture portal

name.en: Ksheera Dhare Scheme (Milk Producer Incentive ₹5/Litre)
name.kn: ಕ್ಷೀರಧಾರೆ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಹಾಲು ಉತ್ಪಾದಕರಿಗೆ ₹5 ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಧನ)
name.hi: क्षीरधारे योजना (दुग्ध उत्पादक प्रोत्साहन ₹5/लीटर)

schemes.department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services, GoK & KMF

summary.en: Direct incentive of ₹5 per litre transferred directly into the bank accounts of registered dairy farmers pouring milk into village Milk Producers Cooperative Societies (MPCS) affiliated to KMF.
summary.kn: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸಹಕಾರಿ ಹಾಲು ಮಹಾಮಂಡಳಿ (ಕೆಎಂಎಫ್) ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿಯ ಹಾಲು ಉತ್ಪಾದಕರ ಸಹಕಾರ ಸಂಘಗಳಿಗೆ ಹಾಲು ಪೂರೈಸುವ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಲೀಟರ್ ಹಾಲಿಗೆ ₹5 ನೇರ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಧನ.
summary.hi: केएमएफ दुग्ध सहकारी समितियों को दूध देने वाले किसानों के बैंक खाते में ₹5 प्रति लीटर की सीधी डीबीटी प्रोत्साहन राशि।

description.en: Ksheera Dhare is Karnataka's flagship livestock livelihood scheme. To sustain rural dairy farming and remunerate small dairy farmers, the Government provides an additional incentive of ₹5/litre over and above the procurement price paid by district milk unions.
description.kn: ಹಾಲು ಉತ್ಪಾದಕರ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಸುಧಾರಿಸಲು ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಹಾಲು ಒಕ್ಕೂಟಗಳು ನೀಡುವ ಖರೀದಿ ದರದ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಸರ್ಕಾರವು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ರೈತರ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ₹5 ಜಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
description.hi: दुग्ध उत्पादकों की आय बढ़ाने के लिए जिला दुग्ध संघ द्वारा देय मूल्य के अतिरिक्त सरकार द्वारा ₹5 प्रति लीटर का सीधा भुगतान।

benefit.description: ₹5 per litre direct benefit transfer into dairy farmer's Aadhaar-linked bank account on monthly basis based on computerized milk pouring records.

eligibility_criteria: Dairy farmer pouring milk to a village-level Primary Milk Producers Cooperative Society (MPCS) affiliated to KMF in Karnataka
Active member with registered Aadhaar number and computerized milk fat/SNF testing records

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must have an active Aadhaar-linked bank account.

exclusions.description: Suppliers to private non-cooperative commercial dairies are not covered under state Ksheera Dhare.

schemes.income_criteria: No income ceiling. All dairy cooperative pouring members eligible.
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Dairy farmer pouring milk to village MPCS.
schemes.land_criteria: Not required (landless agricultural laborers with dairy cows are fully eligible).
process: Pour milk daily at village Primary Milk Producers Cooperative Society (MPCS).
Automatic milk analyzer records quantity, Fat %, and SNF % against member ID.
Monthly consolidated pouring data pushed to Animal Husbandry Department portal; incentive credited directly via DBT.

important_dates.payment_cycle: Monthly DBT transfer directly to farmer bank accounts

important_current_notes: Benefits over 25 lakh dairy farming families across Karnataka.
schemes.application_window: Open continuously through local village MPCS
schemes.geographic_applicability: All 31 Districts of Karnataka (All 16 District Milk Unions)

name.en: National Programme for Dairy Development (NPDD)
name.kn: ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಹೈನುಗಾರಿಕೆ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮ (ಎನ್‌ಪಿಡಿಡಿ)
name.hi: राष्ट्रीय डेयरी विकास कार्यक्रम (एनपीडीडी)

schemes.department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, GoI

summary.en: Financial assistance for creating modern milk chilling infrastructure, automated milk collection units, electronic milk testing equipment, and bulk milk coolers at village level.
summary.kn: ಗ್ರಾಮ ಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವಯಂಚಾಲಿತ ಹಾಲು ಸಂಗ್ರಹ ಘಟಕಗಳು, ವಿದ್ಯುನ್ಮಾನ ಕೊಬ್ಬು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಯಂತ್ರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಬಲ್ಕ್ ಮಿಲ್ಕ್ ಕೂಲರ್‌ಗಳ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆಗೆ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು.
summary.hi: गांव स्तर पर स्वचालित दूध संग्रह इकाइयों, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक दुग्ध परीक्षण मशीनों और बल्क मिल्क कूलर स्थापना हेतु वित्तीय सहायता।

description.en: NPDD aims to enhance the quality of milk and milk products and increase procurement share by funding village-level chilling infrastructure, electronic adulteration testing, and training dairy farmers.
description.kn: ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಭಾಗದ ಹಾಲಿನ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟವನ್ನು ಕಾಪಾಡಲು ಮತ್ತು ಹಾಲಿಗೆ ನ್ಯಾಯಯುತ ಬೆಲೆ ಸಿಗುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಲು ಸ್ವಯಂಚಾಲಿತ ಯಂತ್ರೋಪಕರಣಗಳ ಅಳವಡಿಕೆಗೆ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ನೆರವು.
description.hi: दूध की गुणवत्ता सुधारने और मिलावट रोकने हेतु ग्रामीण सहकारी समितियों में आधुनिक शीतलन संयंत्रों की स्थापना।

benefit.description: Up to 50% - 100% grant assistance for milk testing equipment, chilling infrastructure, and farmer member training.

eligibility_criteria: Dairy cooperative societies, district milk unions, and farmer producer companies engaged in dairy operations
Individual farmers benefit through accurate fat/SNF computerized payment at village level
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Dairy farmer or dairy cooperative.
process: Village cooperative society applies through District Milk Union (e.g., BAMUL, MANMUL in Mandya, MYMUL).
Project approved by State and Central Screening Committee; automated milk collection units deployed.
important_current_notes: Automated milk collection centers provide printed slips displaying quantity, fat, SNF, and payout on the spot.
schemes.application_window: Active through District Milk Unions across Karnataka

name.en: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY - Fisheries Subsidy)
name.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಮತ್ಸ್ಯ ಸಂಪದ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಪಿಎಂಎಂಎಸ್‌ವೈ)
name.hi: प्रधानमंत्री मत्स्य संपदा योजना (पीएमएमएसवाई)

schemes.department: Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying, GoI

summary.en: 40% general and 60% SC/ST/women capital subsidy for constructing inland fish/prawn culture ponds, biofloc units, recirculatory aquaculture systems (RAS), and motorized boats.
summary.kn: ಒಳನಾಡು ಮೀನುಗಾರಿಕೆ ಕೊಳಗಳ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣ, ಬಯೋಫ್ಲೋಕ್ ಘಟಕ, ಮರುಪರಿಚಲನಾ ಜಲಕೃಷಿ (ಆರ್‌ಎಎಸ್), ಮತ್ತು ಮೀನು ಸಾಗಣೆ ವಾಹನಗಳ ಖರೀದಿಗೆ ಶೇ. 40 ರಿಂದ 60 ರವರೆಗೆ ಸಹಾಯಧನ.
summary.hi: मछली पालन तालाब निर्माण, बायोफ्लोक, आरएएस इकाइयों और मत्स्य परिवहन वाहनों की खरीद पर 40% (सामान्य) और 60% (एससी/एसटी/महिला) अनुदान।

description.en: PMMSY is the flagship central scheme to bring about the Blue Revolution through sustainable and responsible development of the fisheries sector, creating modern aquaculture ponds, fish hatcheries, and cold chain logistics.
description.kn: ಮೀನುಗಾರರು ಮತ್ತು ರೈತರ ಆದಾಯ ದ್ವಿಗುಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಒಳನಾಡು ಮತ್ತು ಕರಾವಳಿ ಮೀನುಗಾರಿಕೆ ಮೂಲಸೌಕರ್ಯ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಗೆ ಬೃಹತ್ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು ನೀಡುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: मत्स्य पालन क्षेत्र में नीली क्रांति लाने और आधुनिक जलीय कृषि को बढ़ावा देने हेतु केंद्र सरकार की प्रमुख योजना।

benefit.description: 40% subsidy for general category (up to ₹6 Lakhs for 1-hectare pond construction) and 60% subsidy for SC, ST, and women beneficiaries (up to ₹9 Lakhs).

eligibility_criteria: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, SHGs, and agricultural landholders wishing to adopt aquaculture
Ownership or registered lease agreement of agricultural land/waterbody for minimum 7 to 10 years

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must hold land or waterbody suitable for aquaculture.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Farmer, fish culturist, or fisher.
schemes.land_criteria: Minimum 0.2 ha (approx. 20 guntas) landholding for aquaculture pond.
process: Submit project application online on PMMSY portal (pmmsy.dof.gov.in) or via Karnataka Fisheries Department.
District Level Committee headed by Deputy Commissioner approves project.
Construct aquaculture pond / install equipment; inspection by Senior Assistant Director of Fisheries; subsidy released via DBT.

important_dates.application_window: Open annually on central and state fisheries portals

important_current_notes: Special focus on inland aquaculture in reservoirs, farm ponds, and saline/alkaline water.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round on national portal

name.en: Matsya Ashraya Housing and Welfare Scheme for Fishermen
name.kn: ಮತ್ಸ್ಯ ಆಶ್ರಯ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಮೀನುಗಾರರ ವಸತಿ ಯೋಜನೆ)
name.hi: मत्स्य आश्रय योजना (मछुआरों हेतु आवास योजना)

schemes.department: Department of Fisheries, Government of Karnataka & Rajiv Gandhi Housing Corp

summary.en: Subsidized pucca housing construction assistance of ₹1.50 Lakhs to ₹2.00 Lakhs for houseless traditional inland and marine fishermen families in Karnataka.
summary.kn: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ವಸತಿರಹಿತ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಒಳನಾಡು ಮತ್ತು ಕರಾವಳಿ ಮೀನುಗಾರರ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಪಕ್ಕಾ ಮನೆ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ₹1.50 ರಿಂದ ₹2.00 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗೆ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಸಹಾಯಧನ.
summary.hi: कर्नाटक के बेघर पारंपरिक अंतर्देशीय एवं तटीय मछुआरा परिवारों को पक्का मकान निर्माण हेतु ₹1.50 लाख से ₹2.00 लाख तक का सरकारी अनुदान।

description.en: Matsya Ashraya provides safe, resilient shelter to vulnerable traditional fishing communities in inland river/reservoir basins and coastal belts of Karnataka.
description.kn: ನದಿ, ಜಲಾಶಯ ಮತ್ತು ಕೆರೆಗಳ ಆಶ್ರಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೀನುಗಾರಿಕೆ ನಡೆಸುವ ಬಡ ಮೀನುಗಾರ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಸ್ವಂತ ಸೂರು ಕಲ್ಪಿಸುವ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವಸತಿ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: नदी, जलाशय एवं तटीय क्षेत्रों में जीवनयापन करने वाले मछुआरा परिवारों को पक्के आवास की सुविधा।

benefit.description: Financial grant of ₹1.50 Lakhs (General/OBC) to ₹2.00 Lakhs (SC/ST) released in 4 geo-tagged construction stages directly into bank account.

eligibility_criteria: Must be a traditional full-time fisherman/fisherwoman registered with local Fishermen Cooperative Society in Karnataka
Must be houseless or living in a dilapidated katcha house; must own site/plot
Annual family income must not exceed ₹1,20,000

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹1,20,000.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Traditional fisherman/fisherwoman.
schemes.land_criteria: Must possess title deed (Hakku Patra) of site for housing.

required_documents.item: Fisherman Cooperative Society Membership / Biometric Card
House Site Hakku Patra / Title Deed

process: Apply through local Gram Panchayat or Assistant Director of Fisheries.
Beneficiary selection by Grama Sabha and approval by Taluk Housing Committee.
Construction stages geo-tagged on Ashraya mobile app; funds credited directly to bank account via DBT.
important_current_notes: Administered in coordination with Rajiv Gandhi Housing Corporation Limited (RGHCL).
schemes.application_window: Annual selection via Gram Panchayats and Fisheries offices
schemes.geographic_applicability: All Coastal and Inland Fisheries Districts in Karnataka

name.en: National Livestock Mission (NLM - Breed Development & Poultry)
name.kn: ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಜಾನುವಾರು ಮಿಷನ್ (ಎನ್‌ಎಲ್‌ಎಂ)
name.hi: राष्ट्रीय पशुधन मिशन (एनएलएम)

schemes.department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, GoI

summary.en: 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹50 Lakhs) for establishing commercial sheep/goat breeding farms, pig breeding units, rural poultry parent farms, and fodder seed production.
summary.kn: ಕುರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮೇಕೆ ತಳಿ ಸಂವರ್ಧನೆ ಘಟಕ, ಹಂದಿ ಸಾಕಾಣಿಕೆ, ನಾಟಿ ಕೋಳಿ ಪೋಷಣಾ ಫಾರ್ಮ್ ಹಾಗೂ ಮೇವು ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆಗೆ ಶೇ. 50 ರಷ್ಟು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಸಹಾಯಧನ (ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ₹50 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗೆ).
summary.hi: भेड़/बकरी प्रजनन फार्म, शूकर पालन, ग्रामीण कुक्कुट (मुर्गी) पालन और चारा उत्पादन इकाइयों की स्थापना पर 50% पूंजीगत सब्सिडी (अधिकतम ₹50 लाख तक)।

description.en: National Livestock Mission aims to enhance employment generation, entrepreneurship, and productivity in sheep, goat, piggery, and poultry sectors. Subsidies are channeled directly through the SIDBI Udyamimitra portal.
description.kn: ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಯುವಕರು ಮತ್ತು ರೈತರು ಪಶುಸಂಗೋಪನೆಯನ್ನು ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯ ಉದ್ಯಮವಾಗಿ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಉತ್ತೇಜಿಸುವ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಉದ್ಯಮಶೀಲತಾ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: पशुपालन के माध्यम से ग्रामीण उद्यमिता, मांस व ऊन उत्पादन तथा रोजगार सृजन हेतु 50% प्रत्यक्ष सरकारी सहायता।

benefit.description: 50% back-ended capital subsidy up to ₹50 Lakhs for sheep/goat units (500 breeding females + 25 males); up to ₹25 Lakhs for poultry parent units; up to ₹30 Lakhs for pig breeding units.

eligibility_criteria: Individuals, farmers, SHGs, FPOs, cooperatives, and Section 8 companies in Karnataka
Must possess required land and arranged bank loan or self-financing for the remaining 50% project cost
Trained in animal husbandry from government veterinary training centres

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must hold land or leased premises for livestock sheds and fodder.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Farmer / livestock entrepreneur.
schemes.land_criteria: Land for shed and green fodder cultivation.

required_documents.note: Detailed Project Report and bank appraisal.

process: Register on NLM portal via SIDBI Udyamimitra (nlm.udyamimitra.in).
Submit Detailed Project Report (DPR) and bank loan appraisal.
State Level Executive Committee screens project; Central DAHD approves; subsidy released in 2 equal tranches via SIDBI.

important_dates.portal_status: Active online application portal on SIDBI Udyamimitra

important_current_notes: Paperless online process with direct tracking via SIDBI.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round on SIDBI Udyamimitra portal

name.en: Pashu Bhagya Scheme (Subsidized Loans for Cattle, Sheep & Goats)
name.kn: ಪಶು ಭಾಗ್ಯ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಹಸು, ಕುರಿ, ಮೇಕೆ ಸಾಲ ಮತ್ತು ಸಹಾಯಧನ)
name.hi: पशु भाग्य योजना (गाय, भेड़, बकरी हेतु ऋण व सब्सिडी)

schemes.department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Subsidized bank loans with 25% (General) to 33.33% (SC/ST) back-ended capital subsidy for purchase of 2 crossbred cows/buffaloes, or sheep/goat units (10+1), and piggery units.
summary.kn: ಎರಡು ಮಿಶ್ರತಳಿ ಹಸು/ಎಮ್ಮೆ, ಅಥವಾ 10+1 ಕುರಿ/ಮೇಕೆ ಘಟಕಗಳ ಖರೀದಿಗೆ ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌ಗಳಿಂದ ಸಾಲ: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವರ್ಗಕ್ಕೆ ಶೇ. 25 ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ/ಪಂಗಡದವರಿಗೆ ಶೇ. 33.33 ರಷ್ಟು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಸಹಾಯಧನ.
summary.hi: 2 दुधारू गाय/भैंस या 10+1 भेड़/बकरी इकाई की खरीद पर बैंक ऋण: सामान्य वर्ग को 25% और एससी/एसटी वर्ग को 33.33% बैक-एंडेड पूंजीगत सब्सिडी।

description.en: Pashu Bhagya facilitates commercial animal husbandry loans through commercial and regional rural banks in Karnataka, with the State Government providing upfront margin money and capital subsidy directly to the lending bank.
description.kn: ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕೃಷಿ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರಿಗೆ ಪೂರಕ ಆದಾಯ ಕಲ್ಪಿಸಲು ಹೈನುಗಾರಿಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಕುರಿ ಸಾಕಾಣಿಕೆಗೆ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ ಸಾಲ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: कर्नाटक में ग्रामीण किसानों एवं पशुपालकों को बैंकों के माध्यम से रियायती दर पर दुधारू पशु खरीदने हेतु सहायता।

benefit.description: 25% subsidy (up to ₹30,000) for general category and 33.33% subsidy (up to ₹40,000) for SC/ST beneficiaries on purchase of 2 milch cows/buffaloes or sheep/goat units.

eligibility_criteria: Small/marginal farmers and landless agricultural laborers residing in rural areas of Karnataka
Must have shelter and water facilities for animals
Loan sanctioned by participating commercial, RRB, or DCC bank

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must have an active bank account.

schemes.income_criteria: Preference to low-income small and marginal farmers.
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Farmer, agricultural labourer, or traditional livestock keeper.

required_documents.note: Issued by Assistant Director of Veterinary Services during purchase.

process: Submit application form at local Veterinary Dispensary / Hospital or participating bank branch.
Bank approves loan application; animal purchase mela organized under supervision of veterinary doctor.
Government subsidy released directly into the farmer's loan account reducing loan liability.

important_dates.annual_allocation: Financial year targets allocated to taluk veterinary officers

important_current_notes: Animal insurance premium for the first year is subsidized under the scheme.
schemes.application_window: Open annually through taluk veterinary offices and banks

name.en: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF - 3% Interest Subvention)
name.kn: ಕೃಷಿ ಮೂಲಸೌಕರ್ಯ ನಿಧಿ (ಎಐಎಫ್ - ಶೇ. 3 ಬಡ್ಡಿ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ)
name.hi: कृषि अवसंरचना कोष (एआईएफ - 3% ब्याज छूट)

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI

summary.en: 3% per annum interest subvention on loans up to ₹2 Crores for setting up post-harvest farm infrastructure: cold rooms, sorting/grading units, godowns, silos, and primary processing units.
summary.kn: ಕೊಯ್ಲೋತ್ತರ ಮೂಲಸೌಕರ್ಯ, ಶೀತಲ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಾಗಾರ, ಗೋದಾಮು, ಗ್ರೇಡಿಂಗ್ ಘಟಕ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಸಂಸ್ಕರಣಾ ಘಟಕಗಳನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಲು ₹2 ಕೋಟಿವರೆಗಿನ ಸಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಶೇ. 3 ರಷ್ಟು ಬಡ್ಡಿ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ.
summary.hi: कटाई उपरांत भंडारण, कोल्ड स्टोरेज, सॉर्टिंग/ग्रेडिंग, साइलो और प्राथमिक प्रसंस्करण इकाइयों की स्थापना हेतु ₹2 करोड़ तक के ऋण पर 3% वार्षिक ब्याज अनुदान।

description.en: AIF is a medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets. Loans up to ₹2 Crores carry 3% interest subvention for max 7 years and credit guarantee coverage under CGTMSE.
description.kn: ಕೃಷಿ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನಗಳ ನಷ್ಟ ತಡೆಯಲು ಮತ್ತು ರೈತರು ಉತ್ತಮ ಬೆಲೆ ಪಡೆಯುವವರೆಗೆ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಲು ಕೃಷಿ ಗೋದಾಮು ಮತ್ತು ಶೀತಲ ಕೇಂದ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲು ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು.
description.hi: फसल कटाई के बाद होने वाले नुकसान को रोकने और मूल्य संवर्धन हेतु खेत स्तर पर अधोसंरचना निर्माण की राष्ट्रव्यापी योजना।

benefit.description: 3% per annum interest subvention on term loans up to ₹2 Crores for up to 7 years, plus fee-free CGTMSE credit guarantee coverage.

eligibility_criteria: Individual farmers, agri-entrepreneurs, Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), FPOs, SHGs, and startups
Project must be for eligible post-harvest management or community farming asset listed under AIF guidelines
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Farmer, FPO, PACS, or agri-entrepreneur.
schemes.land_criteria: Land for constructing storage or processing unit.

required_documents.note: Lending commercial or cooperative bank branch.

process: Apply online through AIF portal (agriinfra.dac.gov.in) with project DPR and select preferred bank.
Ministry approves project viability; lending bank processes and disburses loan.
Interest subvention of 3% credited automatically directly to the loan account by Government.
important_current_notes: AIF portal integrated with multiple national banks for fast online sanctioning.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round on national portal

name.en: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM - Electronic Trading Portal)
name.kn: ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಕೃಷಿ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ (ಇ-ನಾಮ್ - ವಿದ್ಯುನ್ಮಾನ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್)
name.hi: राष्ट्रीय कृषि बाजार (ई-नाम - इलेक्ट्रॉनिक व्यापार मंच)

schemes.department: Small Farmers Agribusiness Consortium (SFAC), Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI

summary.en: Pan-India electronic trading portal integrating agricultural wholesale markets (mandis/APMCs) with online bidding, quality assaying, and direct online payment to farmers.
summary.kn: ರೈತರು ಬೆಳೆದ ಕೃಷಿ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನಗಳಿಗೆ ದೇಶದ ಯಾವುದೇ ಮಂಡಿಯ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳಿಂದ ಉತ್ತಮ ಬೆಲೆ ಪಡೆಯಲು ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಬಿಡ್ಡಿಂಗ್, ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಮತ್ತು ನೇರ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಜಮೆ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ವೇದಿಕೆ.
summary.hi: देशभर की मंडियों को जोड़कर ऑनलाइन बोली, पारदर्शी वजन, गुणवत्ता जांच और किसानों के बैंक खाते में सीधा भुगतान करने वाला राष्ट्रीय पोर्टल।

description.en: e-NAM creates a unified national market for agricultural commodities by networking existing APMC mandis. Farmers receive transparent price discovery based on scientific assaying and immediate electronic settlement.
description.kn: ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಮಧ್ಯವರ್ತಿಗಳ ಶೋಷಣೆ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿ, ಪಾರದರ್ಶಕ ತೂಕ ಮತ್ತು ಅಖಿಲ ಭಾರತ ಮಟ್ಟದ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧಾತ್ಮಕ ಬೆಲೆಯನ್ನು ದೊರಕಿಸಿಕೊಡುವ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ.
description.hi: बिचौलियों से मुक्ति और पारदर्शी मूल्य खोज हेतु देशभर के 1300+ एपीएमसी को जोड़ने वाला डिजिटल मंच।

benefit.description: Free electronic trading platform, access to national buyers, assaying reports, and direct bank settlement without commission cuts.

eligibility_criteria: All farmers bringing agricultural produce to registered e-NAM mandis/APMCs in Karnataka
Individual farmers, FPOs, and traders

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must possess an active bank account for online trade settlement.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Farmer selling produce.
process: Register on e-NAM mobile app or at e-NAM gate in participating APMC mandi.
Commodity sample tested at assaying lab and lot details uploaded on electronic portal.
Buyers across India bid online; farmer accepts highest bid; money transferred directly to farmer's bank account.

important_dates.operations: Daily live trading during market operating hours

important_current_notes: Mobile app enables farmers to monitor live bidding from their home.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round across all registered e-NAM APMC mandis

name.en: Rashtriya e-Market Services - Unified Market Platform (ReMS-UMP Karnataka)
name.kn: ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಇ-ಮಾರ್ಕೆಟ್ ಸರ್ವೀಸಸ್ - ಏಕೀಕೃತ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ವೇದಿಕೆ (ರೀಮ್ಸ್ - ಯುಎಂಪಿ)
name.hi: राष्ट्रीय ई-मार्केट सर्विसेज - एकीकृत बाजार मंच (रीम्स - यूएमपी कर्नाटक)

schemes.department: Karnataka State Agricultural Marketing Board & ReMS Ltd, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Karnataka's pioneering Unified Market Platform connecting 160+ APMC mandis with automated electronic weighing, transparent online auctioning, and guaranteed direct DBT settlement into farmers' accounts.
summary.kn: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ 160 ಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಎಪಿಎಂಸಿ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿದ್ಯುನ್ಮಾನ ತೂಕ, ಪಾರದರ್ಶಕ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಹರಾಜು ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರಾಟದ ಹಣವನ್ನು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ರೈತರ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮೆ ಮಾಡುವ ರಾಜ್ಯ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ.
summary.hi: कर्नाटक की 160+ एपीएमसी मंडियों में इलेक्ट्रॉनिक तौल, पारदर्शी ऑनलाइन नीलामी और किसानों के खाते में त्वरित डीबीटी भुगतान की एकीकृत राज्य प्रणाली।

description.en: ReMS-UMP operates across Karnataka APMCs to provide seamless online marketing, automated gate entry, computerized grading and weighing, and electronic clearing so that farmers receive competitive prices and prompt payment without cash delays.
description.kn: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಕೃಷಿ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಸುಧಾರಣೆಯಾಗಿದ್ದು, ರೈತರು ತಂದ ಬೆಳೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಪಾರದರ್ಶಕ ದರ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಹಾಗೂ ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ ಪಾವತಿಯನ್ನು ಖಾತರಿಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
description.hi: मंडी प्रांगण में किसानों की उपज का सही तौल और ऑनलाइन नीलामी द्वारा उच्चतम मूल्य दिलाने वाली कर्नाटक की अग्रणी व्यवस्था।

benefit.description: Zero deduction for unauthorized market fees, transparent electronic weighment, automated competitive online bidding, and direct DBT settlement within 24 hours.

eligibility_criteria: All farmers bringing agricultural commodities to any of the 160+ APMC yards in Karnataka
Must possess active bank account and registered mobile number

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must have an active bank account.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Agricultural producer selling produce.
process: Farmer arrives at APMC yard; entry slip generated with lot number and mobile notification.
Electronic weighment and quality analysis conducted.
Traders bid on UMP online portal; farmer receives SMS with top bid; confirms sale; proceeds credited to bank account.

important_dates.mandi_days: Operating on notified mandi market days across all Karnataka taluks

important_current_notes: Over 90% of agricultural trade in Karnataka APMCs processed through ReMS.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round across all APMCs in Karnataka

name.en: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY - Small Farmers Pension)
name.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಕಿಸಾನ್ ಮಾನ್‌ಧನ್ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಪಿಎಂ-ಕೆಎಂವೈ - ರೈತರ ಮಾಸಾಶನ)
name.hi: प्रधानमंत्री किसान मानधन योजना (पीएम-केएमवाई - किसान पेंशन)

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI & Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)

summary.en: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹3,000 for small and marginal farmers on attaining the age of 60 years, with affordable monthly contributions of ₹55 to ₹200.
summary.kn: ಸಣ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಅತಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ರೈತರಿಗೆ 60 ವರ್ಷ ತುಂಬಿದ ನಂತರ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ₹3,000 ಖಾತರಿಯ ಮಾಸಾಶನ (ಪಿಂಚಣಿ). ಮಾಸಿಕ ₹55 ರಿಂದ ₹200 ರವರೆಗೆ ವಯೋಮಾನಕ್ಕೆ ತಕ್ಕಂತೆ ವಂತಿಗೆ.
summary.hi: 60 वर्ष की आयु पूर्ण होने पर लघु एवं सीमांत किसानों को ₹3,000 प्रति माह की गारंटीकृत पेंशन, ₹55 से ₹200 तक का न्यूनतम मासिक अंशदान।

description.en: PM-KMY is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers (owning up to 2 hectares of cultivable land) between 18 to 40 years of age. The Central Government matches 100% of the farmer's monthly contribution.
description.kn: ರೈತರು ತಮ್ಮ ವೃದ್ಧಾಪ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಭದ್ರತೆ ಹೊಂದಲು 18 ರಿಂದ 40 ವರ್ಷ ವಯಸ್ಸಿನ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಆರಂಭಿಸಲಾದ ಸಮಾಜ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಪಿಂಚಣಿ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: किसानों को वृद्धावस्था में सामाजिक सुरक्षा देने हेतु 50% सरकारी अंशदान वाली स्वैच्छिक पेंशन योजना।

benefit.description: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining 60 years of age. In case of death, spouse is entitled to 50% family pension (₹1,500/month).

eligibility_criteria: Small and marginal farmers holding cultivable land up to 2 hectares (5 acres) in state land records
Entry age between 18 and 40 years at the time of enrolment
Active Aadhaar-linked savings bank account

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must hold cultivable land up to 5 acres (2 hectares).
Applicant entry age must be between 18 and 40 years.
Applicant entry age must be between 18 and 40 years.

exclusions.description: Farmers covered under other social security schemes (NPS, ESIC, EPFO, PM-SYM) or income tax payers are excluded.

schemes.age_criteria: 18 to 40 years at entry; pension commences at age 60.
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Small and marginal farmers.
schemes.land_criteria: Up to 2 hectares (5 acres) of cultivable land.
process: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or Village BangaloreOne / GramaOne centre with Aadhaar and RTC.
CSC operator enters Aadhaar and bank details; monthly contribution auto-calculated based on age.
Initial contribution paid in cash; auto-debit mandate signed; Pension Card (Kisan Pension ID) issued immediately.

important_dates.pension_age: Pensions begin automatically on turning 60 years

important_current_notes: Farmers can choose to pay monthly contributions directly from their PM-KISAN instalments.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round on Maandhan portal and at CSCs

name.en: Raitha Sanjeevini Accidental Insurance Scheme
name.kn: ರೈತ ಸಂಜೀವಿನಿ ಅಪಘಾತ ವಿಮಾ ಯೋಜನೆ
name.hi: रैता संजीवनी दुर्घटना बीमा योजना

schemes.department: Karnataka State Agricultural Marketing Board (KSAMB), Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Financial compensation of up to ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or permanent disablement of farmers, agricultural laborers, and family members during agricultural operations or APMC yard activities.
summary.kn: ಕೃಷಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಅಥವಾ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತೊಡಗಿದ್ದಾಗ ಅಪಘಾತದಿಂದ ಮೃತಪಟ್ಟರೆ ₹2 ಲಕ್ಷ ಹಾಗೂ ಶಾಶ್ವತ ಅಂಗವಿಕಲತೆಗೆ ₹1 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗೆ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಪರಿಹಾರ.
summary.hi: कृषि कार्य या मंडी में दुर्घटना से मृत्यु होने पर ₹2 लाख तथा स्थायी दिव्यांगता पर ₹1 लाख तक की सीधी सरकारी आर्थिक सहायता।

description.en: Raitha Sanjeevini is Karnataka's safety-net scheme protecting agricultural workers against hazards like snakebites, electric shocks from irrigation pumps, tractor overturns, machinery accidents, and pest chemical inhalation.
description.kn: ಹಾವು ಕಡಿತ, ಪಂಪ್‌ಸೆಟ್ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಆಘಾತ, ಟ್ರಾಕ್ಟರ್ ಪಲ್ಟಿ, ಯಂತ್ರಗಳ ಅನಾಹುತ ಹಾಗೂ ಕೀಟನಾಶಕ ಸಿಂಪಡಣೆಯ ವಿಷಬಾಧೆಯಿಂದ ಸಂಭವಿಸುವ ಸಾವು-ನೋವುಗಳಿಗೆ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಪರಿಹಾರ.
description.hi: सर्पदंश, कीटनाशक विषाक्तता, करंट लगने या ट्रैक्टर/मशीनरी दुर्घटना से किसान की मृत्यु/अपंगता होने पर त्वरित राहत।

benefit.description: ₹2,00,000 compensation for accidental death; ₹1,00,000 for loss of two limbs/eyes; ₹50,000 for loss of one limb/eye paid directly to legal heir/survivor.
