eligibility_criteria: All farmers, agricultural workers, and their family members aged 15 to 70 years residing in Karnataka
Incident must occur during agricultural work, irrigation pump operation, farm machinery use, or transit of farm produce to APMC

eligibility_rules.description: Victim must be between 15 and 70 years old.
Victim must be between 15 and 70 years old.

exclusions.description: Suicide, intentional self-injury, and death under the influence of alcohol/narcotics are strictly excluded.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Farmer or agricultural worker in Karnataka.
schemes.land_criteria: Landholding or farm laborer status verified by Village Administrative Officer.

required_documents.item: Aadhaar Card of Victim and Nominee
RTC / Land Record or VAO Certificate
required_documents.note: Confirming agricultural occupation at time of incident.

process: Intimate incident to local Police and Agriculture/APMC Secretary within 30 days of accident.
Submit claim form with FIR, Post-Mortem / Disability Certificate, and land records to local APMC Secretary.
APMC Committee approves and KSAMB releases compensation via DBT directly to nominee's bank account.

important_dates.intimation: Claim must be submitted within 90 days of the incident

important_current_notes: No premium paid by farmer; 100% funded through APMC marketing development funds.
schemes.application_window: Open continuously upon occurrence of accident

name.en: Karnataka Fuel / Diesel Subsidy for Agricultural Machinery
name.kn: ಕೃಷಿ ಯಂತ್ರೋಪಕರಣಗಳ ಇಂಧನ (ಡೀಸೆಲ್) ಸಹಾಯಧನ ಯೋಜನೆ
name.hi: कृषि यंत्र ईंधन (डीजल) सब्सिडी योजना कर्नाटक

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Direct benefit fuel subsidy of ₹250 per acre (up to max 5 acres / ₹1,250) for farmers owning tractors and power tillers to offset farm machinery diesel consumption.
summary.kn: ಸ್ವಂತ ಟ್ರಾಕ್ಟರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಪವರ್ ಟಿಲ್ಲರ್ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಕೃಷಿ ಉಳುಮೆಯ ಡೀಸೆಲ್ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಭರಿಸಲು ಪ್ರತಿ ಎಕರೆಗೆ ₹250 (ಗರಿಷ್ಠ 5 ಎಕರೆಗೆ ₹1,250) ನೇರ ನಗದು ಸಹಾಯಧನ.
summary.hi: स्वयं का ट्रैक्टर या पावर टिलर रखने वाले किसानों को जुताई के डीजल खर्च हेतु ₹250 प्रति एकड़ (अधिकतम 5 एकड़ हेतु ₹1,250) प्रत्यक्ष डीबीटी अनुदान।

description.en: To reduce cultivation costs for mechanized farmers during primary tillage and harvesting, the Karnataka Government credits a direct cash subsidy into the FRUITS-registered bank account of farmers owning tractors/tillers.
description.kn: ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಕೃಷಿ ಉತ್ಪಾದನಾ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡಲು ಡೀಸೆಲ್ ಮೇಲಿನ ತೆರಿಗೆ ಹೊರೆಯನ್ನು ತಗ್ಗಿಸುವ ಉದ್ದೇಶದಿಂದ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ನೀಡಲಾಗುವ ನೆರವು.
description.hi: जुताई और बुवाई के समय किसानों के डीजल व्यय का बोझ कम करने के लिए कर्नाटक कृषि विभाग की सीधी सहायता।

benefit.description: Direct cash transfer of ₹250 per acre up to a maximum of 5 acres (₹1,250) per farmer family into Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

eligibility_criteria: Farmer owning cultivable land in Karnataka registered on FRUITS portal
Must own tractor or power tiller with Registration Certificate (RC) in farmer's name or family member's name

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must hold cultivable land in Karnataka.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Farmer owning farm machinery.
schemes.land_criteria: Up to 5 acres eligible for financial subsidy.
process: Update Tractor / Tiller Registration Certificate (RC) details on FRUITS portal (fruits.karnataka.gov.in).
Department of Agriculture cross-verifies RC from Parivahan database and land from Bhoomi.
Subsidy calculated automatically and released via DBT to farmer's account before cropping season.
important_current_notes: FRUITS database integration enables automatic validation without physical application submission.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round via FRUITS portal profile update

name.en: Mandya District Zilla Panchayat Sugarcane Drip Top-Up Scheme
name.kn: ಮಂಡ್ಯ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಪಂಚಾಯತ್ ಕಬ್ಬು ಬೆಳೆ ಹನಿ ನೀರಾವರಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಸಹಾಯಧನ
name.hi: मंड्या जिला पंचायत गन्ना ड्रिप सिंचाई टॉप-अप योजना

schemes.department: District Administration and Zilla Panchayat Mandya, Karnataka

summary.en: Special 15% district top-up subsidy for sugarcane farmers adopting micro-drip irrigation in Cauvery basin command areas of Mandya district, raising total subsidy to 65% - 90%.
summary.kn: ಕಾವೇರಿ ಜಲಾನಯನ ಪ್ರದೇಶದ ಮಂಡ್ಯ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಕಬ್ಬು ಬೆಳೆಗಾರರಿಗೆ ಹನಿ ನೀರಾವರಿ ಅಳವಡಿಕೆಗೆ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಪಂಚಾಯತಿಯಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಶೇ. 15 ರಷ್ಟು ಅನುದಾನ.
summary.hi: कावेरी कमान क्षेत्र के मंड्या जिले में गन्ना किसानों को ड्रिप सिंचाई लगाने हेतु जिला पंचायत द्वारा 15% अतिरिक्त टॉप-अप अनुदान।

description.en: To conserve water in the Cauvery basin and maximize sugarcane tonnage per acre, the Mandya Zilla Panchayat provides a special 15% top-up over existing PMKSY subsidies for farmers installing subsurface/online drip systems in sugarcane fields.
description.kn: ಕಬ್ಬು ಕೃಷಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ಮತ್ತು ರಸಗೊಬ್ಬರದ ಸದ್ಬಳಕೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಅಧಿಕ ಇಳುವರಿ ಪಡೆಯಲು ಮಂಡ್ಯ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ವಿಶೇಷ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಮಟ್ಟದ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಧನ.
description.hi: मंड्या जिले में गन्ने की खेती में पानी की बचत और पैदावार बढ़ाने के लिए जिला प्रशासन की विशेष प्रोत्साहन योजना।

benefit.description: Additional 15% top-up subsidy over PMKSY rates (effectively 65% - 70% for general and up to 90% for SC/ST sugarcane farmers) up to ₹35,000 per hectare.

eligibility_criteria: Sugarcane farmers owning land within the geographical boundaries of Mandya district (Mandya, Maddur, Malavalli, Pandavapura, Srirangapatna, Nagamangala, K.R. Pet taluks)
Installing micro-irrigation system for sugarcane crop with minimum 1 acre holding

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must cultivate sugarcane on at least 1 acre in Mandya district.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Sugarcane cultivating farmer in Mandya district.
schemes.land_criteria: Bhoomi RTC confirming sugarcane plot in Mandya district.
process: Apply at local Taluk Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) office or RSK in Mandya district.
Verify PMKSY drip installation in sugarcane plot.
Zilla Panchayat Agriculture Sub-Committee sanctions the 15% top-up; credited via DBT to farmer's account.

important_dates.application_window: Open during current district agricultural plan

important_current_notes: Exclusive to Mandya district sugarcane farmers; helps save 40% irrigation water in Cauvery basin.
schemes.application_window: Open in all 7 taluks of Mandya district

name.en: Taluk Panchayat Knapsack Power Sprayer Promotion Scheme
name.kn: ತಾಲ್ಲೂಕು ಪಂಚಾಯಿತಿ ಬ್ಯಾಟರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪವರ್ ಸ್ಪ್ರೇಯರ್ ಸಹಾಯಧನ ಯೋಜನೆ
name.hi: तालुक पंचायत नैपसैक पावर स्प्रेयर सब्सिडी योजना

schemes.department: Taluk Panchayat Agricultural Extension Division, Mandya District

summary.en: 50% equipment subsidy on knapsack battery and engine-operated plant protection sprayers for marginal smallholders in Mandya taluks.
summary.kn: ಮಂಡ್ಯ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಸಣ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಅತಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಸಸ್ಯ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಣಾ ಬ್ಯಾಟರಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಪವರ್ ಸ್ಪ್ರೇಯರ್‌ಗಳ ಖರೀದಿಗೆ ಶೇ. 50 ರಷ್ಟು ಸಹಾಯಧನ.
summary.hi: मंड्या जिले के सीमांत किसानों को बैटरी एवं इंजन चालित कीटनाशक स्प्रेयर की खरीद पर 50% सरकारी अनुदान।

description.en: Taluk Panchayats in Mandya district distribute subsidized battery and engine sprayers under local decentralized development grants to assist smallholders in crop protection for paddy, sugarcane, and vegetables.
description.kn: ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಕೀಟನಾಶಕ ಸಿಂಪಡಣೆ ಸುಲಭಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಕೂಲಿ ವೆಚ್ಚ ತಗ್ಗಿಸಲು ತಾಲ್ಲೂಕು ಪಂಚಾಯಿತಿ ವತಿಯಿಂದ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ ದರದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಪ್ರೇಯರ್ ವಿತರಣೆ.
description.hi: कीट नियंत्रण एवं छिड़काव कार्य को आसान बनाने के लिए तालुका पंचायत द्वारा रियायती स्प्रेयर वितरण।

benefit.description: 50% subsidy (up to ₹3,500 for battery sprayers and ₹6,000 for engine-operated power sprayers) on approved ISI-marked models.

eligibility_criteria: Small and marginal farmers holding agricultural land in Mandya district taluks
Preference to SC, ST, women farmers, and farmers with landholding below 2.5 acres

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must hold cultivable land in Mandya district.

schemes.income_criteria: Priority to BPL and small/marginal farmers.
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Cultivating farmer in Mandya district.
process: Submit application at local Taluk Panchayat office or Raitha Samparka Kendra during distribution cycle.
Beneficiary list approved by Taluk Panchayat Executive Officer (EO).
Collect sprayer from authorized distribution depot upon payment of subsidized farmer contribution.
important_current_notes: Distributed on first-come-first-served basis during annual target announcements.
schemes.application_window: Seasonal (Pre-Kharif distribution across Mandya taluks)

name.en: Soil Health Card Manual Paper Slip Distribution (Cycle 1 & 2)
name.kn: ಮಣ್ಣು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಮ್ಯಾನುಯಲ್ ಪೇಪರ್ ಸ್ಲಿಪ್ ಹಂಚಿಕೆ (ಸೈಕಲ್ 1 & 2 - ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ)
name.hi: मृदा स्वास्थ्य कार्ड मैनुअल पेपर पर्ची वितरण (साइकिल 1 और 2 - बंद)

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI

summary.en: Legacy physical paper slip distribution without digital portal linking. Officially DISCONTINUED and replaced by the unified digital Soil Health Card portal.
summary.kn: ಹಿಂದಿನ ಕೈಬರಹದ ಕಾಗದದ ಮಣ್ಣು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಚೀಟಿಗಳು. ಅಧಿಕೃತವಾಗಿ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಲಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಮಣ್ಣು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.
summary.hi: पारंपरिक कागजी पर्ची वितरण व्यवस्था जिसे अब पूरी तरह बंद कर एकीकृत ऑनलाइन डिजिटल पोर्टल से प्रतिस्थापित कर दिया गया है।

description.en: The early physical distribution cycles of paper soil testing slips lacked centralized digital verification and have been officially discontinued and superseded by online digital cards on soilhealth.dac.gov.in.
description.kn: ಹಳೆಯ ಆಫ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಕಾಗದ ಚೀಟಿ ಪದ್ಧತಿಯು ನಿಂತುಹೋಗಿದ್ದು, ಈಗ ಎಲ್ಲ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯು ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಲಭ್ಯವಿದೆ.
description.hi: पुरानी ऑफ़लाइन व्यवस्था अब बंद है। वर्तमान में केवल डिजिटल ऑनलाइन कार्ड ही मान्य हैं।

benefit.description: Historical paper test slips. Officially discontinued.

eligibility_criteria: Legacy scheme - no new applicants accepted.

exclusions.description: Scheme discontinued; superseded by digital Soil Health Card portal.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Not applicable.
process: Do not apply. Please use the active Soil Health Card Digital Scheme (SOIL_HEALTH_CARD).
important_current_notes: Excluded from active discovery. Replaced by SOIL_HEALTH_CARD.
schemes.application_window: Closed / Discontinued

name.en: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Unified Directory
name.kn: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ರಾಜ್ಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶ (ಎಸ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಪಿ) ಏಕೀಕೃತ ನಿರ್ದೇಶಿಕೆ
name.hi: कर्नाटक राज्य छात्रवृत्ति पोर्टल (एसएसपी) एकीकृत निर्देशिका

schemes.department: Centre for e-Governance & Department of Social Welfare / Higher Education, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Karnataka's unified digital scholarship portal coordinating post-matric, pre-matric, fee concessions, and hostel admissions across 8 government welfare departments.
summary.kn: ರಾಜ್ಯದ 8 ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಇಲಾಖೆಗಳ ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್-ಪೂರ್ವ, ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್-ನಂತರ, ಶುಲ್ಕ ವಿನಾಯಿತಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಸತಿ ನಿಲಯ ಪ್ರವೇಶಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಯೋಜಿಸುವ ಏಕೀಕೃತ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್.
summary.hi: कर्नाटक के 8 कल्याणकारी विभागों की प्री-मैट्रिक, पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति, शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति और छात्रावास प्रवेश का एकीकृत डिजिटल मंच।

description.en: The State Scholarship Portal (SSP) is Karnataka's single-window platform for students to apply for pre-matric and post-matric financial assistance, tuition fee reimbursement, and maintenance allowances from Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare, Backward Classes, Minorities, and Technical Education departments.
description.kn: ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ಅರ್ಜಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ತಮಗೆ ಅನ್ವಯವಾಗುವ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ರಾಜ್ಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನಗಳಿಗೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಲು ಅನುವು ಮಾಡಿಕೊಡುವ ಪಾರದರ್ಶಕ ಡಿಬಿಟಿ ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶ.
description.hi: एकल आवेदन द्वारा सभी राज्य छात्रवृत्ति योजनाओं का लाभ सीधे आधार-लिंक्ड बैंक खाते में पहुंचाने वाला कर्नाटक का प्रमुख पोर्टल।

benefit.description: Direct benefit transfer of course fees, examination fees, maintenance allowances (₹2,500 to ₹25,000/yr), and hostel mess charges depending on department and course.

eligibility_criteria: Domicile student of Karnataka enrolled in recognized school, PU college, polytechnic, degree, or university course
Valid Kutumba family ID and student Aadhaar number seeded with NPCI bank account
Income and caste certificate verified electronically via e-Pramana (RD number)

eligibility_rules.description: Student must have an active Aadhaar-linked bank account.

schemes.income_criteria: Criteria vary by department (typically up to ₹2.5 Lakhs for SC/ST and Category 1; ₹1 Lakh to ₹2.5 Lakhs for other backward classes).
schemes.age_criteria: Student age (typically 5 to 30 years depending on course level).
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Enrolled student in recognized educational institution in Karnataka.
process: Create student account on SSP portal (ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in) using Aadhaar and Kutumba ID.
Enter Caste & Income RD numbers; system automatically fetches verified family records.
Select college and course details; institution verifies attendance and fee structure online.
Department sanctions scholarship and disburses directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank account via DBT.
important_current_notes: Zero paper submission; electronic verification via e-Pramana and Kutumba databases.
schemes.application_window: Open for 2026-27 academic session on SSP portal

name.en: SSP Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
name.kn: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್-ನಂತರದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ (ಎಸ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಪಿ)
name.hi: अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति के छात्रों हेतु एसएसपी पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति

schemes.department: Social Welfare & Scheduled Tribes Welfare Departments, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Full tuition fee reimbursement, examination fee waiver, and monthly maintenance allowance for Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) students pursuing post-matriculation courses.
summary.kn: ಪಿಯುಸಿ, ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ, ಪದವಿ, ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ, ಇಂಜಿನಿಯರಿಂಗ್ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ/ಪಂಗಡದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಬೋಧನಾ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮರುಪಾವತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾಸಿಕ ನಿರ್ವಹಣಾ ಭತ್ಯೆ.
summary.hi: 10वीं के बाद (पीयूसी, डिप्लोमा, डिग्री, मेडिकल, इंजीनियरिंग) अध्ययनरत एससी/एसटी छात्रों को पूर्ण शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं मासिक निर्वाह भत्ता।

description.en: Under this scheme, SC/ST students studying in post-matric institutions in Karnataka receive 100% tuition and mandatory fee reimbursement credited directly to the institution, and monthly maintenance allowance credited directly to the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
description.kn: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ವರ್ಗದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು ಉನ್ನತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಪಡೆಯಲು ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಹೊರೆಯಾಗದಂತೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಭರಿಸಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾಭ್ಯಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹ ನೀಡುವ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: अनुसूचित जाति एवं जनजाति के विद्यार्थियों को उच्च शिक्षा के सभी स्तरों पर निःशुल्क शिक्षा एवं मासिक भत्ता देने वाली योजना।

benefit.description: 100% compulsory college and university fee waiver/reimbursement, plus annual maintenance allowance of ₹7,000 (Day Scholars) to ₹15,000 (Hostellers).

eligibility_criteria: Student must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) domicile in Karnataka
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 (full maintenance and fee reimbursement)
Enrolled in a recognized post-matric course (PUC, Diploma, ITI, Degree, PG, Professional)

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must belong to SC or ST category.
Annual household income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.

exclusions.description: Students pursuing distance education without practical classes or failing in multiple consecutive attempts are subject to review.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Student enrolled in recognized post-matric course.

required_documents.note: Issued by Tahsildar with SC/ST classification.

process: Apply online through Karnataka SSP portal (ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in).
Enter Caste & Income RD numbers; system auto-validates from Revenue e-Pramana portal.
College verifies student enrollment and fee demand online; Taluk Social Welfare Officer sanctions scholarship via DBT.

important_dates.portal_deadline: Applications open for current academic year

important_current_notes: Freeship card issued automatically allowing admission without upfront tuition fee payment.
schemes.application_window: Open for 2026-27 academic session on SSP portal

name.en: SSP Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes (Cat 1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B)
name.kn: ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್-ನಂತರದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ (ಪ್ರವರ್ಗ 1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B)
name.hi: पिछड़ा वर्ग हेतु एसएसपी पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति (श्रेणी 1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B)

schemes.department: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Fee concession, course fee reimbursement, and maintenance allowance for students belonging to Category 1, 2A, 2B, 3A, and 3B studying in post-matric courses in Karnataka.
summary.kn: ಪ್ರವರ್ಗ-1, 2ಎ, 2ಬಿ, 3ಎ ಮತ್ತು 3ಬಿ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಪಿಯುಸಿಯಿಂದ ಸ್ನಾತಕೋತ್ತರದವರೆಗೆ ಕಾಲೇಜು ಶುಲ್ಕ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ವಹಣಾ ಭತ್ಯೆ.
summary.hi: कर्नाटक में पिछड़ा वर्ग (श्रेणी 1, 2ए, 2बी, 3ए, 3बी) के विद्यार्थियों को कॉलेज शुल्क में छूट और मासिक अनुरक्षण भत्ता।

description.en: Administered by the Backward Classes Welfare Department through SSP, this scheme provides fee concessions and maintenance allowances to meritorious and economically backward OBC students.
description.kn: ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಇಲಾಖೆಯ ವತಿಯಿಂದ ಎಸ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಪಿ ಮೂಲಕ ಅರ್ಹ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ನೀಡಲಾಗುವ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು.
description.hi: पिछड़े वर्ग के गरीब विद्यार्थियों को उच्च अध्ययन जारी रखने हेतु राज्य सरकार द्वारा दी जाने वाली वित्तीय सहायता।

benefit.description: Tuition and laboratory fee concession (credited directly to institution) plus annual maintenance allowance of ₹3,000 to ₹7,000 depending on course level.

eligibility_criteria: Student must belong to Category 1, 2A, 2B, 3A, or 3B in Karnataka
Annual family income ceiling: ₹2,50,000 for Category 1; ₹1,00,000 for Categories 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B
Must have secured minimum 50% marks (40% for disabled) in previous qualifying examination

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must belong to recognized backward classes in Karnataka.

schemes.income_criteria: Annual family income ≤ ₹2.5 Lakhs (Category 1) or ≤ ₹1 Lakh (Cat 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B).
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Enrolled in recognized post-matric course in Karnataka.
process: Log in to SSP Post-Matric portal and apply under Backward Classes Welfare Department.
Verify RD numbers for automated e-Pramana retrieval.
College e-attestation and Taluk BCM Officer approval; DBT payment released.
important_current_notes: Fee concession rules strictly conform to Karnataka Government orders on government/management quotas.
schemes.application_window: Open on SSP portal for ongoing academic cycle

name.en: SSP Post-Matric Fee Reimbursement for Religious Minorities
name.kn: ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್-ನಂತರದ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮರುಪಾವತಿ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಎಸ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಪಿ)
name.hi: अल्पसंख्यक छात्रों हेतु एसएसपी पोस्ट-मैट्रिक शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति योजना

schemes.department: Directorate of Minorities, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: 100% course fee and exam fee reimbursement plus scholarship allowance for Muslim, Christian, Jain, Buddhist, Sikh, and Parsi students enrolled in post-matric courses in Karnataka.
summary.kn: ಮುಸ್ಲಿಂ, ಕ್ರಿಶ್ಚಿಯನ್, ಜೈನ, ಬೌದ್ಧ, ಸಿಖ್ ಮತ್ತು ಪಾರ್ಸಿ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಪಿಯುಸಿ, ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ, ಪದವಿ, ಇಂಜಿನಿಯರಿಂಗ್, ಎಂಬಿಬಿಎಸ್ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮರುಪಾವತಿ.
summary.hi: मुस्लिम, ईसाई, जैन, बौद्ध, सिख और पारसी छात्रों को 10वीं के बाद सभी डिग्री, डिप्लोमा एवं व्यावसायिक पाठ्यक्रमों हेतु पूर्ण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति।

description.en: The Directorate of Minorities reimburses tuition fees and examination fees charged by colleges for eligible minority community students whose family income is within ₹2 Lakhs per annum.
description.kn: ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಕಾರಣಗಳಿಂದ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು ಅರ್ಧದಲ್ಲೇ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸದಂತೆ ತಡೆಯಲು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತರ ನಿರ್ದೇಶನಾಲಯವು ನೀಡುವ ನೆರವು.
description.hi: अल्पसंख्यक समुदाय के छात्रों की उच्च शिक्षा को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए राज्य सरकार की शत-प्रतिशत शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति योजना।

benefit.description: Full reimbursement of tuition, admission, and examination fees up to ₹50,000 for general degree/diploma and up to ₹1,00,000+ for professional engineering/medical courses, plus maintenance allowance.

eligibility_criteria: Must belong to notified Religious Minorities (Muslim, Christian, Jain, Buddhist, Sikh, Parsi) with Karnataka domicile
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,00,000
Secured minimum 50% marks in previous examination

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹2,00,000.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Post-matric student in recognized Karnataka institution.

required_documents.note: Issued by Tahsildar showing income ≤ ₹2 Lakhs.

process: Submit online application on SSP portal under Directorate of Minorities option.
Authenticate using Aadhaar and Kutumba ID; auto-fetch e-Pramana income certificate.
College conducts online e-attestation; Directorate sanctions fee reimbursement via DBT.
important_current_notes: Fee reimbursement transferred directly into student's Aadhaar-seeded account.
schemes.application_window: Open on SSP portal for ongoing academic cycle

name.en: SSP Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students (Classes 1 to 10)
name.kn: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡದ ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್-ಪೂರ್ವ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ (ತರಗತಿ 1 ರಿಂದ 10)
name.hi: एससी/एसटी छात्रों हेतु एसएसपी प्री-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति (कक्षा 1 से 10)

schemes.department: Social Welfare and Tribal Welfare Departments, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Annual financial stipends of ₹1,000 to ₹3,500 for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe day scholars and hostellers from Class 1 to 10 to curb school dropouts.
summary.kn: 1 ರಿಂದ 10 ನೇ ತರಗತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಶಾಲೆ ಬಿಡುವುದನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪಿಸಲು ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹1,000 ದಿಂದ ₹3,500 ರವರೆಗೆ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
summary.hi: कक्षा 1 से 10 तक अध्ययनरत एससी और एसटी के छात्र-छात्राओं को स्कूल छोड़ने से रोकने हेतु ₹1,000 से ₹3,500 तक की वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति।

description.en: Pre-matric scholarship administered through Karnataka SSP Pre-Matric portal linked with Student Achievement Tracking System (SATS) to support basic schooling, books, and uniforms for SC/ST children.
description.kn: ಸ್ಯಾಟ್ಸ್ (SATS) ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶದ ಮೂಲಕ ಸ್ವಯಂಚಾಲಿತವಾಗಿ ಅರ್ಹ ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಪೋಷಕರ/ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮೆ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: एसएटीएस पोर्टल के माध्यम से प्राथमिक एवं माध्यमिक शाला के विद्यार्थियों को दी जाने वाली छात्रवृत्ति।

benefit.description: Annual stipend ranging from ₹1,000 (Class 1-5), ₹1,500 (Class 6-8), to ₹3,500 (Class 9-10 hostellers) credited via DBT.

eligibility_criteria: Student belonging to SC or ST community studying in government or government-aided school in Karnataka
Annual parental income not exceeding ₹2,50,000
Valid Student Achievement Tracking System (SATS) student ID

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must belong to SC or ST category.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Enrolled in Class 1 to 10 in recognized Karnataka school.
process: School Headmaster logs into SSP Pre-Matric portal using school credentials and fetches SATS data.
Parent provides Caste and Income RD number to school.
Taluk Social Welfare Officer approves master list; DBT credited directly to student/parent bank account.

important_dates.school_cycle: June to October annual verification cycle

important_current_notes: Headmaster-driven SATS integration minimizes burden on rural parents.
schemes.application_window: Active school-based verification cycle

name.en: SSP Pre-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes (Cat 1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B)
name.kn: ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್-ಪೂರ್ವ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ (ತರಗತಿ 1 ರಿಂದ 10)
name.hi: पिछड़ा वर्ग हेतु एसएसपी प्री-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति (कक्षा 1 से 10)

schemes.department: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Annual stipends for backward classes students studying in Classes 1 to 10 in government and aided schools across Karnataka.
summary.kn: ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅನುದಾನಿತ ಶಾಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 1 ರಿಂದ 10 ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ಪ್ರವರ್ಗ 1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
summary.hi: कर्नाटक के सरकारी एवं सहायता प्राप्त स्कूलों में कक्षा 1 से 10 तक पढ़ने वाले पिछड़ा वर्ग के विद्यार्थियों हेतु वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति।

description.en: Assistance to underprivileged students from Other Backward Classes to meet school expenses, stationery, and books, encouraging universal school retention.
description.kn: ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಬಡ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಶಾಲಾ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಲು ನೆರವಾಗುವ ರಾಜ್ಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
description.hi: ओबीसी समुदाय के छात्र-छात्राओं के स्कूल ड्रॉपआउट को रोकने हेतु सरकारी छात्रवृत्ति।

benefit.description: Annual stipend of ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 transferred directly to bank account via DBT.

eligibility_criteria: Belong to Category 1, 2A, 2B, 3A, or 3B in Karnataka
Annual family income ceiling: ₹44,500 for rural areas and ₹44,500 - ₹1,00,000 depending on category
Valid SATS enrollment number

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must belong to recognized backward classes.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Enrolled in Class 1 to 10.
process: School registers student on SSP Pre-Matric portal using SATS ID.
Automated cross-check with e-Pramana caste/income data.
Funds disbursed via DBT directly into student/parent Aadhaar-linked account.
important_current_notes: Processed directly through school SATS portal.
schemes.application_window: Active school-based cycle on SSP Pre-Matric

name.en: Vidyasiri - Food and Accommodation Scheme (Karnataka BCM)
name.kn: ವಿದ್ಯಾಸಿರಿ - ಊಟ ಮತ್ತು ವಸತಿ ಸಹಾಯ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಬಿಸಿಎಂ)
name.hi: विद्यासिरी - भोजन एवं आवास सहायता योजना (कर्नाटक बीसीएम)

schemes.department: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Monthly stipend of ₹1,500 for 10 months (total ₹15,000 per year) credited directly to post-matric rural students who could not secure admission in government welfare hostels.
summary.kn: ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ವಸತಿ ನಿಲಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಸಿಗದ ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಪ್ರದೇಶದ ಬಡ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಊಟ ಮತ್ತು ವಸತಿ ವೆಚ್ಚಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ₹1,500 ರಂತೆ 10 ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಟ್ಟು ₹15,000 ಸಹಾಯಧನ.
summary.hi: सरकारी छात्रावास में स्थान न मिलने वाले ग्रामीण पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रों को भोजन व आवास हेतु ₹1,500 प्रति माह की दर से 10 माह तक कुल ₹15,000 की सीधी सहायता।

description.en: Vidyasiri (Food and Accommodation Scheme) provides monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 directly into the bank accounts of post-matric students belonging to SC, ST, and OBC communities who reside more than 5 km away from their college and were unable to obtain a seat in government hostels.
description.kn: ದೂರದ ಊರುಗಳಿಂದ ಬಂದು ನಗರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ಮನೆ ಅಥವಾ ಪಿಜಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿದುಕೊಂಡು ವಿದ್ಯಾಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡುವ ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಊಟ ಮತ್ತು ವಸತಿ ಭರಿಸಲು ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ನೆರವು.
description.hi: कॉलेज से 5 किमी से अधिक दूरी पर रहने वाले और हॉस्टल से वंचित ग्रामीण विद्यार्थियों के रहने-खाने का खर्च वहन करने वाली प्रमुख योजना।

benefit.description: Monthly allowance of ₹1,500 for 10 months (₹15,000 per academic year) credited via DBT directly to student's bank account.

eligibility_criteria: Post-matric students belonging to Category 1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B, SC, or ST in Karnataka
Must not be admitted to any government hostel or residential institution
Distance between student's permanent residence and college must be greater than 5 km
Annual family income ceiling: ₹2,50,000 (Cat-1/SC/ST) and ₹1,00,000 (Cat-2A/2B/3A/3B)
Minimum 75% college attendance maintained every month

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must have an active Aadhaar-linked bank account.

exclusions.description: Students already staying in government free hostels or receiving other residential stipends are excluded.

schemes.income_criteria: Annual family income ≤ ₹2.5 Lakhs (Cat-1/SC/ST) or ≤ ₹1 Lakh (Cat-2A/2B/3A/3B).
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Post-matric student residing > 5 km from college.

required_documents.item: Rural Residence Certificate / Gram Panchayat Certificate
required_documents.note: Proof of residence > 5 km from college.
Proof of rented stay in college town.

process: Apply online through Karnataka SSP Post-Matric portal under Vidyasiri (Food & Accommodation) option.
Upload rental agreement and village distance certificate.
College verifies attendance (minimum 75%) online every month; monthly ₹1,500 released via DBT.

important_dates.monthly_release: Monthly DBT released based on college attendance confirmation

important_current_notes: Direct benefit to over 1.5 lakh rural students across Karnataka.
schemes.application_window: Open for 2026-27 academic session on SSP portal

name.en: Karnataka SC/ST First-Class Degree Prize Money Scheme
name.kn: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡದ ಪ್ರಥಮ ದರ್ಜೆ ಪದವೀಧರರಿಗೆ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಧನ (ಬಹುಮಾನ ಹಣ)
name.hi: कर्नाटक एससी/एसटी प्रथम श्रेणी स्नातक पुरस्कार प्रोत्साहन योजना

schemes.department: Social Welfare & Scheduled Tribes Welfare Departments, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: One-time cash reward ranging from ₹20,000 to ₹35,000 for SC and ST students passing Polytechnic, Degree, PG, Engineering, and Medical courses in first attempt with First Class.
summary.kn: ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ, ಪದವಿ, ಸ್ನಾತಕೋತ್ತರ, ಇಂಜಿನಿಯರಿಂಗ್ ಮತ್ತು ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊದಲ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನದಲ್ಲೇ ಪ್ರಥಮ ದರ್ಜೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ತೀರ್ಣರಾಗುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ/ಪಂಗಡದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ₹20,000 ದಿಂದ ₹35,000 ವರೆಗೆ ಏಕಗಂಟು ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಧನ.
summary.hi: पॉलिटेक्निक, स्नातक, स्नातकोत्तर, इंजीनियरिंग या मेडिकल परीक्षा प्रथम प्रयास में प्रथम श्रेणी में उत्तीर्ण करने वाले एससी/एसटी छात्रों को ₹20,000 से ₹35,000 का एकमुश्त नकद पुरस्कार।

description.en: The Social Welfare Department rewards high-performing SC/ST graduates to encourage academic excellence: ₹20,000 for Polytechnic/Diploma, ₹25,000 for General Degree, ₹30,000 for Postgraduate Degree, and ₹35,000 for Engineering/Medical/Agriculture professional graduates.
description.kn: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ವರ್ಗದ ಪ್ರತಿಭಾನ್ವಿತ ಯುವಜನರನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ, ಸ್ಪರ್ಧಾತ್ಮಕ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಿದ್ಧರಾಗಲು ಹಾಗೂ ಉನ್ನತ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಲು ನೆರವಾಗುವ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿ ಹಣ.
description.hi: मेधावी अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति के स्नातकों को प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं एवं उच्च अध्ययन की तैयारी हेतु दिया जाने वाला विशेष नकद प्रोत्साहन।

benefit.description: One-time cash reward: ₹20,000 (Diploma), ₹25,000 (Degree), ₹30,000 (Postgraduate), ₹35,000 (Medical / Engineering / Agriculture) via DBT.

eligibility_criteria: Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) domicile of Karnataka
Must have completed course in the first attempt with First Class (minimum 60% aggregate marks)
Course must be recognized by state universities, DTE, VTU, or Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences
Must apply within the notified window following final results announcement

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must belong to SC or ST category.

exclusions.description: Candidates who cleared exams through supplementary/arrears attempts are not eligible.

schemes.income_criteria: No income ceiling (Purely merit-based for first-class SC/ST graduates).
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Passed degree/diploma in first class in first attempt.

required_documents.item: All Semester Marks Cards & Degree/Diploma Certificate
required_documents.note: Proving first class in first attempt.

process: Apply online through Karnataka Social Welfare Department portal (sw.karnataka.gov.in) under Prize Money option.
Upload marks cards showing first attempt first class passing.
District Social Welfare Officer verifies university database; prize money credited directly via DBT.

important_dates.annual_window: Applications open following annual university convocation and final results

important_current_notes: No family income limit; open to all SC/ST students graduating with first class.
schemes.application_window: Applications currently open on Social Welfare portal

name.en: Arivu Education Loan Scheme (KMDC - 2% Interest)
name.kn: ಅರಿವು ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಾಲ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಕೆಎಂಡಿಸಿ - ಶೇ. 2 ಬಡ್ಡಿದರ)
name.hi: अरीवु शिक्षा ऋण योजना (केएमडीसी - 2% रियायती ब्याज)

schemes.department: Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation (KMDC), Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Subsidised education loan up to ₹5,00,000 per year at a nominal 2% annual interest rate for minority students pursuing professional courses (MBBS, BDS, B.Tech, MBA, MCA) selected through KEA/CET/NEET.
summary.kn: ಕೆಇಎ/ಸಿಇಟಿ/ನೀಟ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯಾದ ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ, ಇಂಜಿನಿಯರಿಂಗ್, ಎಂಬಿಎ ಮುಂತಾದ ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ಗಳ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹5 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗೆ ಕೇವಲ 2% ಬಡ್ಡಿದರದಲ್ಲಿ ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಾಲ.
summary.hi: सीईटी/नीट द्वारा चयनित अल्पसंख्यक छात्रों को एमबीबीएस, बीटेक, बीडीएस आदि व्यावसायिक पाठ्यक्रमों हेतु ₹5 लाख प्रति वर्ष तक मात्र 2% ब्याज पर शिक्षा ऋण।

description.en: The Arivu Scheme is an education loan initiative by KMDC to enable meritorious students from religious minorities (Muslims, Christians, Jains, Buddhists, Sikhs, Parsis) to pursue higher professional and technical education without private high-interest loans.
description.kn: ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಬಡ ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಾಲೇಜು ಶುಲ್ಕವನ್ನು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಪಾವತಿಸುವ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತರ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ನಿಗಮದ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: अल्पसंख्यक छात्रों के तकनीकी एवं मेडिकल कॉलेज की फीस सीधे केईए के माध्यम से जमा करने वाली कम ब्याज वाली ऋण योजना।

benefit.description: Loan amount up to ₹5,00,000 per year for MBBS; up to ₹1,00,000 per year for Engineering; up to ₹50,000 per year for other courses at 2% simple interest. Repayment commences 1 year after course completion.

eligibility_criteria: Applicant must belong to notified Religious Minorities with domicile in Karnataka
Must have secured admission through Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA) CET / NEET counseling
Annual family income must not exceed ₹4,50,000

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹4,50,000.

exclusions.description: Management quota admissions without KEA/CET entrance ranking are excluded.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Student admitted through KEA CET/NEET.
process: Apply online through KMDC loan portal (kmdc.karnataka.gov.in) or Seva Sindhu.
Upload KEA admission order and verified RD numbers.
KMDC transfers sanctioned fee amount directly to KEA / college account on student's behalf.

important_dates.counseling_window: Synchronized with KEA CET/NEET admission counseling rounds

important_current_notes: Direct electronic transfer to KEA prevents upfront fee burden on parents.
schemes.application_window: Open during state professional admission cycle

name.en: Yuva Nidhi Scheme (Karnataka Guarantee for Unemployed Youth)
name.kn: ಯುವ ನಿಧಿ ಯೋಜನೆ (ನಿರುದ್ಯೋಗಿ ಯುವಜನರಿಗೆ ಮಾಸಾಶನ ಖಾತರಿ)
name.hi: युवा निधि योजना (बेरोजगार युवाओं हेतु मासिक भत्ता गारंटी)

schemes.department: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Monthly unemployment financial allowance of ₹3,000 for graduate degree holders and ₹1,500 for diploma holders who graduated in 2023 or 2024 and remain unemployed for 180 days, paid for up to 2 years.
summary.kn: 2023 ಅಥವಾ 2024 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಪದವಿ ಅಥವಾ ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ ಪಡೆದು 6 ತಿಂಗಳಿನಿಂದ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಸಿಗದ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಯುವಕ-ಯುವತಿಯರಿಗೆ ಪದವೀಧರರಿಗೆ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ₹3,000 ಹಾಗೂ ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾದಾರರಿಗೆ ₹1,500 ಮಾಸಾಶನ (ಗರಿಷ್ಠ 2 ವರ್ಷಗಳವರೆಗೆ).
summary.hi: 2023/2024 में स्नातक या डिप्लोमा उत्तीर्ण कर 6 माह से बेरोजगार कर्नाटक के युवाओं को ₹3,000 (स्नातक) एवं ₹1,500 (डिप्लोमा) प्रति माह का बेरोजगारी भत्ता (2 वर्ष हेतु)।

description.en: Yuva Nidhi is one of Karnataka's flagship guarantee schemes. It provides financial security and covers job search/competitive examination expenses for unemployed graduates and diploma holders for up to 24 months or until they secure employment or self-employment.
description.kn: ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಹುಡುಕುತ್ತಿರುವ ಯುವಜನರು ಸ್ಪರ್ಧಾತ್ಮಕ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಿದ್ಧರಾಗಲು ಹಾಗೂ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯ ತರಬೇತಿ ಪಡೆಯಲು ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ನೀಡುವ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಭದ್ರತೆ.
description.hi: बेरोजगार युवाओं को प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं की तैयारी और कौशल प्रशिक्षण प्राप्त करने हेतु कर्नाटक सरकार की गारंटी योजना।

benefit.description: ₹3,000 per month for Degree holders (BA, B.Sc, B.Com, B.Tech, etc.) and ₹1,500 per month for Diploma holders credited directly via DBT for up to 2 years.

eligibility_criteria: Must be a domicile of Karnataka for at least 6 years
Graduated with degree or diploma from recognized university/board in Karnataka during academic year 2022-23 or 2023-24
Must have remained unemployed for at least 180 days (6 months) after passing
Not enrolled in higher full-time educational studies and not employed in government or private sector (verified via EPFO/ESIC)

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must have an active Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

exclusions.description: Candidates employed in government/private sector, registered with EPFO/ESIC, or receiving other apprentice stipends are excluded.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Unemployed graduate degree or diploma holder from Karnataka.

required_documents.note: Study certificate for 6 years in Karnataka.

process: Apply online through Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in) or BangaloreOne / GramaOne centre.
Authenticate Aadhaar and enter degree registration number; system verifies university database.
Automated background check against EPFO, ESIC, and government payroll databases.
Monthly allowance credited directly via DBT; submit monthly self-declaration of continuing unemployment on portal.

important_dates.monthly_attestation: Monthly online declaration required between 25th and 10th of every month

important_current_notes: Beneficiaries receive free skill training opportunities through Karnataka Skill Development Corporation.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round on Seva Sindhu portal

name.en: Karnataka Government Free Welfare Hostels Scheme
name.kn: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಉಚಿತ ವಸತಿ ನಿಲಯ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಎಸ್‌ಸಿ, ಎಸ್‌ಟಿ, ಬಿಸಿಎಂ, ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ)
name.hi: कर्नाटक सरकारी निःशुल्क छात्रावास योजना (एससी, एसटी, पिछड़ा व अल्पसंख्यक)

schemes.department: Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare, BCM & Minority Welfare Departments, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Free boarding, lodging, meals, study facilities, and library support for rural SC, ST, OBC, and minority students enrolled in pre-matric and post-matric institutions in Karnataka.
summary.kn: ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಭಾಗದ ಬಡ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ, ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡ, ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗ ಹಾಗೂ ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ತಾಲೂಕು ಮತ್ತು ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಕೇಂದ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಉಚಿತ ಊಟ, ವಸತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಗ್ರಂಥಾಲಯ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ.
summary.hi: ग्रामीण एससी, एसटी, ओबीसी और अल्पसंख्यक विद्यार्थियों को तहसील व जिला मुख्यालयों में निःशुल्क भोजन, आवास और अध्ययन सामग्री की व्यवस्था।

description.en: Karnataka operates over 3,000+ free departmental hostels across all taluks for school and college students, ensuring that lack of local high schools or colleges does not prevent rural youth from completing education.
description.kn: ರಾಜ್ಯದ 3,000 ಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್ ಪೂರ್ವ ಮತ್ತು ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್ ನಂತರದ ವಸತಿ ನಿಲಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಉಚಿತ ವಾಸ್ತವ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಪೌಷ್ಟಿಕ ಆಹಾರ ನೀಡುವ ಸಮಾಜ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: दूरदराज के ग्रामीण छात्रों को शहरों में निःशुल्क और सुरक्षित छात्रावास सुविधा प्रदान करने वाली राज्यव्यापी योजना।

benefit.description: 100% free lodging, nutritional breakfast, lunch and dinner, bed, study desk, uniform, and reference books throughout the academic year.

eligibility_criteria: Student belonging to SC, ST, Backward Classes (BCM), or Religious Minorities in Karnataka
Enrolled in recognized school, college, or university located more than 5 km from native village
Parental annual income within departmental limits (₹2.5 Lakhs for SC/ST; ₹1 Lakh for OBC)

exclusions.description: Students living within 5 km of college or admitted into other paid residential colleges are not eligible.

schemes.income_criteria: Annual family income ≤ ₹2.5 Lakhs (SC/ST) or ≤ ₹1 Lakh (OBC).
schemes.age_criteria: School and college students (10 to 28 years).
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Full-time student enrolled in recognized institution.
process: Apply online through Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP Hostel Module: ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in).
Select preferred hostel locations in college taluk/district.
Computerized merit-cum-distance allotment list published; report to hostel warden with allotment letter.

important_dates.admission_season: June to August annually with academic session opening

important_current_notes: Admission quota allocated strictly on computerized merit and distance from college.
schemes.application_window: Seasonal (Academic reopening window June-August on SSP)

name.en: National Scholarship Portal Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
name.kn: ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶ (ಎನ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಪಿ) ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತರ ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್-ಪೂರ್ವ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ
name.hi: राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति पोर्टल (एनएसपी) अल्पसंख्यक प्री-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति

schemes.department: Ministry of Minority Affairs & National Scholarship Portal, Government of India

summary.en: Tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance for Class 1 to 10 students belonging to six notified minority communities with family income up to ₹1,00,000.
summary.kn: 1 ರಿಂದ 10 ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ಮುಸ್ಲಿಂ, ಕ್ರಿಶ್ಚಿಯನ್, ಜೈನ, ಬೌದ್ಧ, ಸಿಖ್, ಪಾರ್ಸಿ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಶಾಲಾ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ವಹಣಾ ಭತ್ಯೆ.
summary.hi: कक्षा 1 से 10 तक अध्ययनरत 6 अधिसूचित अल्पसंख्यक समुदायों के विद्यार्थियों हेतु शिक्षण शुल्क और मासिक अनुरक्षण भत्ता।

description.en: Central scheme providing financial assistance to meritorious minority students from economically weaker families to ensure schooling completion and eliminate child labour.
description.kn: ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯದ ವತಿಯಿಂದ ನೀಡಲಾಗುವ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
description.hi: अल्पसंख्यक समुदाय के बच्चों को बुनियादी स्कूली शिक्षा पूरी कराने हेतु केंद्र सरकार की छात्रवृत्ति।

benefit.description: Tuition fee up to ₹500/month and maintenance allowance of ₹500 to ₹1,000 per month credited directly via DBT.

eligibility_criteria: Belong to notified minority community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi)
Enrolled in Class 1 to 10 in recognized school; secured ≥ 50% marks in previous final exam (not applicable for Class 1)
Annual family income must not exceed ₹1,00,000

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹1,00,000.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Class 1 to 10 student in recognized school.
process: Complete One Time Registration (OTR) on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Fill Pre-Matric application form and upload certificates.
Institute-level verification by school headmaster, followed by District Nodal Officer verification; DBT released directly.

important_dates.otr_notice: National OTR mandatory on NSP before applying

important_current_notes: One-Time Registration (OTR) via face-authentication/biometrics mandatory on NSP.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round on national portal

name.en: National Scholarship Portal Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
name.kn: ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶ (ಎನ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಪಿ) ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತರ ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್-ನಂತರದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ
name.hi: राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति पोर्टल (एनएसपी) अल्पसंख्यक पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति

schemes.department: Ministry of Minority Affairs & National Scholarship Portal, Government of India

summary.en: Admission, tuition fee and maintenance allowance for Class 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, Graduation, and Post-Graduation minority students with parental income up to ₹2,00,000.
summary.kn: ಪಿಯುಸಿ, ಐಟಿಐ, ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ, ಪದವಿ, ಸ್ನಾತಕೋತ್ತರ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಶುಲ್ಕ, ಬೋಧನಾ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ವಹಣಾ ಭತ್ಯೆ.
summary.hi: 11वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई, डिप्लोमा, डिग्री व पीजी अल्पसंख्यक छात्रों हेतु शिक्षण शुल्क एवं मासिक निर्वाह भत्ता।

description.en: Provides scholarships to encourage higher education among religious minorities, covering course fee expenses up to ₹10,000 per annum and monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200 per month.
description.kn: ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ಸಮುದಾಯದ ಯುವಕ-ಯುವತಿಯರು ಉನ್ನತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯಲು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಬೆಂಬಲ.
description.hi: अल्पसंख्यक युवाओं को उच्च शिक्षा के अवसरों से जोड़ने हेतु राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति योजना।

benefit.description: Tuition and course fee up to ₹10,000 per year, plus monthly maintenance allowance of ₹570 (Day Scholars) to ₹1,200 (Hostellers) credited via DBT.

eligibility_criteria: Minority community student (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi)
Enrolled in Class 11 to Ph.D. level courses in recognized government or private college
Secured minimum 50% marks in previous qualifying board or university exam
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,00,000

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹2,00,000.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Post-matric student in recognized college/university.
process: Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on NSP portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Submit Post-Matric application form with academic and fee details.
College verifies application; Ministry releases scholarship directly into student's Aadhaar-linked account.

important_dates.otr_validation: Aadhaar face authentication required for OTR registration

important_current_notes: Students in Karnataka may choose either Karnataka State SSP or Central NSP based on eligibility.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round on national portal

name.en: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Professional and Technical Courses CS
name.kn: ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ಮತ್ತು ತಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ಗಳ ಮೆರಿಟ್-ಕಮ್-ಮೀನ್ಸ್ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ (ಕೇಂದ್ರ ವಲಯ)
name.hi: व्यावसायिक एवं तकनीकी पाठ्यक्रमों हेतु मेरिट-कम-मीन्स छात्रवृत्ति सीएस

schemes.department: Ministry of Minority Affairs & National Scholarship Portal, Government of India

summary.en: Full course fee reimbursement up to ₹20,000 per year plus maintenance allowance of ₹10,000 per year for minority students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate professional and technical courses.
summary.kn: ಇಂಜಿನಿಯರಿಂಗ್, ಮೆಡಿಕಲ್, ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜ್‌ಮೆಂಟ್, ಫಾರ್ಮಸಿ ಮುಂತಾದ ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ಪದವಿ ಓದುತ್ತಿರುವ ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ₹20,000 ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮರುಪಾವತಿ ಮತ್ತು ₹10,000 ನಿರ್ವಹಣಾ ಭತ್ಯೆ.
summary.hi: इंजीनियरिंग, मेडिकल, एमबीए जैसे व्यावसायिक पाठ्यक्रमों के अल्पसंख्यक छात्रों को ₹20,000 वार्षिक शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं ₹10,000 निर्वाह भत्ता।

description.en: Merit-cum-Means scholarship assists meritorious and economically disadvantaged minority students admitted into professional courses. For 85 notified premier institutes (IITs, IIMs, NITs), full tuition fee is reimbursed directly.
description.kn: ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ತಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ಪ್ರತಿಭಾನ್ವಿತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಹೊರೆ ನಿವಾರಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
description.hi: प्रतिष्ठित तकनीकी संस्थानों में अध्ययनरत अल्पसंख्यक छात्रों के लिए पूर्ण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति योजना।

benefit.description: Course fee up to ₹20,000 per year (full actual fee for 85 premier institutes) plus ₹1,000 per month maintenance allowance for 10 months (₹10,000/yr).

eligibility_criteria: Minority community student (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi)
Enrolled in recognized undergraduate or postgraduate professional/technical course (B.Tech, MBBS, B.Pharm, MBA, MCA, Law)
Secured minimum 50% marks in higher secondary / graduation examination
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Enrolled in recognized professional/technical course.
process: Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with OTR.
Select Merit-cum-Means scheme under Ministry of Minority Affairs.
College verifies admission and credentials; DBT transferred directly to student account.
important_current_notes: Full actual fee reimbursed if studying in 85 notified premier institutions.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round on national portal

name.en: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
name.kn: ಕಾಲೇಜು ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ವವಿದ್ಯಾಲಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ವಲಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ (ಪಿಎಂ-ಯುಎಸ್‌ಪಿ ಸಿಎಸ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಎಸ್)
name.hi: कॉलेज और विश्वविद्यालय के छात्रों हेतु पीएम-यूएसपी केंद्रीय क्षेत्र छात्रवृत्ति (सीएसएसएस)

schemes.department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India

summary.en: Merit scholarship of ₹12,000 per year for undergraduate studies (first 3 years) and ₹20,000 per year for postgraduate studies for students in the top 20th percentile of their 12th board examinations.
summary.kn: 12 ನೇ ತರಗತಿ (ಪಿಯುಸಿ) ಬೋರ್ಡ್ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಗ್ರ ಶ್ರೇಣಿ (ಟಾಪ್ 20 ಪರ್ಸಂಟೈಲ್) ಪಡೆದ ಪ್ರತಿಭಾನ್ವಿತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಪದವಿ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹12,000 ಹಾಗೂ ಸ್ನಾತಕೋತ್ತರ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹20,000 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
summary.hi: 12वीं बोर्ड परीक्षा में शीर्ष 20 प्रतिशत (टॉप 20 परसेंटाइल) अंक प्राप्त करने वाले मेधावी छात्रों को स्नातक स्तर पर ₹12,000/वर्ष और स्नातकोत्तर स्तर पर ₹20,000/वर्ष की छात्रवृत्ति।

description.en: The Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students aims to support meritorious students from low-income families to meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher education.
description.kn: ಉನ್ನತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗ ಮಾಡುವ ಬಡ ಪ್ರತಿಭಾವಂತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯದ ವತಿಯಿಂದ ನೀಡಲಾಗುವ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
description.hi: निम्न आय वर्ग के मेधावी विद्यार्थियों के दैनिक शैक्षिक व्यय की पूर्ति हेतु केंद्र सरकार की प्रमुख योजना।

benefit.description: ₹12,000 per year at graduation level for first 3 years and ₹20,000 per year at postgraduate level (or in 4th/5th year of integrated/professional courses) credited directly via DBT.

eligibility_criteria: Students above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream in Class 12th board exam (Karnataka PUC Board or CBSE/ICSE)
Pursuing regular full-time degree course in a recognized college/university
Gross annual family/parental income must not exceed ₹4,50,000

eligibility_rules.description: Gross parental income must not exceed ₹4,50,000 per annum.

exclusions.description: Students pursuing distance, correspondence, or diploma courses are not eligible.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Top 20th percentile in 12th board; enrolled in regular degree course.
process: Check board percentile cutoff list released on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Apply online through NSP portal under Department of Higher Education.
College online verification, State Nodal Officer approval, and direct DBT disbursement.

important_dates.annual_window: Open on National Scholarship Portal for academic year

important_current_notes: 50% of the total scholarships earmarked for female students.
schemes.application_window: Applications open on National Scholarship Portal

name.en: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
name.kn: ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಮೀನ್ಸ್-ಕಮ್-ಮೆರಿಟ್ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಎನ್‌ಎಂಎಂಎಸ್‌ಎಸ್)
name.hi: राष्ट्रीय मीन्स-कम-मेरिट छात्रवृत्ति योजना (एनएमएमएसएस)

schemes.department: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education, Government of India

summary.en: Merit scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) for economically weaker meritorious students from Class IX to Class XII to prevent secondary school dropouts.
summary.kn: 8 ನೇ ತರಗತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎನ್‌ಎಂಎಂಎಸ್ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೇರ್ಗಡೆಯಾದ ಆರ್ಥಿಕವಾಗಿ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ಪ್ರತಿಭಾನ್ವಿತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ 9 ರಿಂದ 12 ನೇ ತರಗತಿಯವರೆಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ₹1,000 ದಂತೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹12,000 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
summary.hi: 8वीं कक्षा में एनएमएमएस परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण करने वाले आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर मेधावी छात्रों को कक्षा 9 से 12 तक ₹1,000 प्रति माह (वार्षिक ₹12,000) की छात्रवृत्ति।

description.en: NMMSS awards 1,00,000 scholarships annually across India to gifted students studying in government and aided schools, selected through a state-level competitive examination in Class VIII.
description.kn: ಪ್ರೌಢಶಾಲಾ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಡತನದ ಕಾರಣದಿಂದ ಶಾಲೆ ತೊರೆಯುವುದನ್ನು ತಡೆಯಲು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯವು ಜಾರಿಗೆ ತಂದಿರುವ ಮೆರಿಟ್ ಆಧಾರಿತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
description.hi: कक्षा 8 के बाद माध्यमिक शिक्षा के स्तर पर ड्रॉपआउट रोकने हेतु केंद्र सरकार की राष्ट्रीय मेधावी छात्रवृत्ति।

benefit.description: ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) credited via quarterly DBT transfers into student's Aadhaar-linked bank account continuously from Class IX to XII.

eligibility_criteria: Student must have passed Class VII with minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST) and currently studying in Class VIII in government or aided school in Karnataka
Must appear and qualify in State NMMS Examination conducted by Karnataka KSEAB / DSERT
Parental annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹3,50,000

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹3,50,000.

exclusions.description: Students studying in Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas, Kendriya Vidyalayas, and private residential schools are not eligible.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Government/aided school student qualifying NMMS exam.

required_documents.item: NMMS Exam Hall Ticket / Selection Rank Card

process: Qualify in State-level NMMS Examination held in November/December.
Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with OTR and enter NMMS roll number.
School validates application online; Ministry disburses ₹12,000 annually via DBT.

important_dates.exam_cycle: NMMS exam held annually in November/December; applications open on NSP following results

important_current_notes: Scholarship continues till Class XII subject to minimum 55% marks in annual exams.
schemes.application_window: Applications open on National Scholarship Portal

name.en: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Technical Degree & Diploma)
name.kn: ಎಐಸಿಟಿಇ ಪ್ರಗತಿ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ ಯೋಜನೆ (ತಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ಪದವಿ ಮತ್ತು ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ)
name.hi: एआईसीटीई प्रगति बालिका छात्रवृत्ति योजना (तकनीकी डिग्री एवं डिप्लोमा)

schemes.department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Government of India

summary.en: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per annum for girl students admitted to 1st year (or lateral entry 2nd year) technical degree and diploma programmes in AICTE-approved institutions.
summary.kn: ಎಐಸಿಟಿಇ ಮಾನ್ಯತೆ ಪಡೆದ ಕಾಲೇಜುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಇಂಜಿನಿಯರಿಂಗ್, ತಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ಪದವಿ ಅಥವಾ ಪಾಲಿಟೆಕ್ನಿಕ್ ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ ಪ್ರಥಮ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹50,000 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
summary.hi: एआईसीटीई से मान्यता प्राप्त संस्थानों में बीटेक या डिप्लोमा प्रथम वर्ष में प्रवेश लेने वाली बालिकाओं को ₹50,000 प्रति वर्ष की वित्तीय सहायता।

description.en: AICTE Pragati empowers girls by supporting technical education. A lump sum of ₹50,000 per annum is provided towards college tuition fees, purchase of computer/laptop, books, and equipment.
description.kn: ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳು ತಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಇಂಜಿನಿಯರಿಂಗ್ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಉನ್ನತ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡಲು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹ.
description.hi: तकनीकी शिक्षा में बालिकाओं की भागीदारी बढ़ाने हेतु केंद्र सरकार की प्रमुख प्रोत्साहन छात्रवृत्ति।

benefit.description: ₹50,000 per annum for each year of study (4 years for Degree, 3 years for Diploma) credited directly via DBT.

eligibility_criteria: Girl student admitted to 1st year of Degree or Diploma course in an AICTE-approved institution through centralized state admission process (KEA CET in Karnataka)
Maximum two girl children per family eligible
Annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹8,00,000.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Girl student in AICTE-approved technical degree/diploma.

required_documents.item: KEA CET / Centralized Admission Allotment Letter

process: Apply online through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) under AICTE Scheme section.
College verifies admission status and AICTE approval code.
AICTE sanctions and releases ₹50,000 annually via DBT.

important_dates.application_window: Open on National Scholarship Portal for academic year

important_current_notes: Over 10,000 scholarships disbursed nationwide; no minimum percentage restriction beyond clearing admission.
schemes.application_window: Applications open on National Scholarship Portal

name.en: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students
name.kn: ಎಐಸಿಟಿಇ ಸಕ್ಷಮ್ ವಿಶೇಷ ಚೇತನ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ ಯೋಜನೆ
name.hi: एआईसीटीई सक्षम दिव्यांग छात्रवृत्ति योजना

schemes.department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Government of India

summary.en: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per annum for students with disability (≥ 40%) admitted to 1st year technical degree or diploma courses in AICTE-approved institutions.
summary.kn: ಎಐಸಿಟಿಇ ಮಾನ್ಯತೆ ಪಡೆದ ಕಾಲೇಜುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ಪದವಿ ಅಥವಾ ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ಶೇ. 40 ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಅಂಗವೈಕಲ್ಯ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹50,000 ಸಹಾಯಧನ.
summary.hi: एआईसीटीई अनुमोदित तकनीकी डिग्री या डिप्लोमा में अध्ययनरत 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले छात्रों को ₹50,000 वार्षिक सहायता।

description.en: AICTE Saksham encourages specially-abled youth to attain technical qualifications and achieve self-reliance. ₹50,000 per year covers tuition fees and purchase of assistive technologies, laptop, and books.
description.kn: ವಿಶೇಷ ಚೇತನ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು ತಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಪಡೆದು ಸ್ವಾಭಿಮಾನಿ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸಲು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹ.
description.hi: दिव्यांग विद्यार्थियों को तकनीकी शिक्षा से जोड़कर आत्मनिर्भर बनाने की योजना।

benefit.description: ₹50,000 per annum credited via DBT directly to student's bank account for the duration of the degree/diploma.

eligibility_criteria: Specially-abled student having disability not less than 40% certified by competent medical authority (UDID Card)
Admitted to 1st year of technical degree or diploma in AICTE approved institution
Annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹8,00,000.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Disabled student in AICTE-approved technical program.
process: Apply online through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with OTR and UDID number.
College verifies admission and AICTE course approval.
AICTE verifies and disburses ₹50,000 directly via DBT.

important_dates.application_window: Open on National Scholarship Portal for academic cycle

important_current_notes: All eligible specially-abled candidates meeting criteria are awarded scholarship without quota ceiling.
schemes.application_window: Open on National Scholarship Portal

name.en: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme (Orphans & COVID-19 Deceased Parents)
name.kn: ಎಐಸಿಟಿಇ ಸ್ವನಾಥ್ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಅನಾಥ ಮತ್ತು ಹುತಾತ್ಮರ ಮಕ್ಕಳು)
name.hi: एआईसीटीई स्वनाथ छात्रवृत्ति योजना (अनाथ व कोविड मृतकों के बच्चे)

schemes.department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Government of India

summary.en: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per annum for orphans, wards of parents who died due to COVID-19, and wards of Armed Forces/Central Paramilitary personnel martyred in action pursuing technical education.
summary.kn: ತಂದೆ-ತಾಯಿ ಇಬ್ಬರನ್ನೂ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡ ಅನಾಥ ಮಕ್ಕಳು, ಕೋವಿಡ್‌ನಿಂದ ಪೋಷಕರನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡವರು ಮತ್ತು ಹುತಾತ್ಮ ಸೈನಿಕರ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ತಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹50,000 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
summary.hi: अनाथ बच्चों, कोविड-19 में माता-पिता खोने वाले विद्यार्थियों और सशस्त्र बलों के शहीदों के बच्चों को तकनीकी शिक्षा हेतु ₹50,000 वार्षिक सहायता।

description.en: AICTE Swanath provides financial stability to vulnerable students facing extreme distress, enabling them to pursue technical degrees or diplomas in AICTE-approved institutions without financial abandonment.
description.kn: ಕಠಿಣ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಯುವಜನರಿಗೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಅರ್ಧಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಲ್ಲದಂತೆ ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಉದಾತ್ತ ನೆರವು.
description.hi: संकटग्रस्त और अनाथ युवाओं को उच्च तकनीकी शिक्षा पूर्ण कराने हेतु छात्रवृत्ति।

benefit.description: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study credited directly via DBT.

eligibility_criteria: Student must be an orphan, OR both parents deceased due to COVID-19, OR ward of Armed Forces / CAPF personnel martyred in line of duty
Admitted to AICTE-approved institution in Degree or Diploma course
Annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹8,00,000.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Student in AICTE-approved technical program.

required_documents.item: Death Certificate of Both Parents / Martyrdom Certificate
required_documents.note: Issued by municipal authority or Ministry of Defence.

required_documents.item: Admission Allotment Letter to AICTE Course

process: Apply online through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Upload death certificates or defense service martyrdom certificate.
AICTE verifies and releases ₹50,000 directly via DBT into student's account.
important_current_notes: All eligible verified applicants receive scholarship without competition cutoff.

schemes.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, MSJE, Government of India

summary.en: Maintenance allowance of ₹3,500 to ₹7,000 per year, book grant, and disability allowances for students with ≥ 40% disability studying in Class 9 and 10.
summary.kn: 9 ಮತ್ತು 10 ನೇ ತರಗತಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಓದುತ್ತಿರುವ ಶೇ. 40 ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಅಂಗವಿಕಲತೆ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ವಿಶೇಷ ಚೇತನ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ನಿರ್ವಹಣಾ ಭತ್ಯೆ, ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಅನುದಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಸಹಾಯಕ ಭತ್ಯೆ.
summary.hi: कक्षा 9 और 10 में अध्ययनरत 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले विद्यार्थियों को वार्षिक निर्वाह भत्ता, पुस्तक अनुदान और रीडर/एस्कॉर्ट भत्ता।

description.en: Supports children with benchmark disabilities in secondary schooling, helping them transition successfully into higher education with disability allowances for visual, hearing, or physical impairments.
description.kn: ವಿಶೇಷ ಚೇತನ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಪ್ರೌಢಶಾಲಾ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಬೆಂಬಲ.
description.hi: दिव्यांग बच्चों की माध्यमिक शिक्षा में निरंतरता बनाए रखने हेतु केंद्र सरकार की छात्रवृत्ति।

benefit.description: Maintenance allowance of ₹3,500/yr (Day Scholars) or ₹7,000/yr (Hostellers) plus book grant of ₹1,000/yr and disability allowances (Reader/Escort/Transport) up to ₹4,000/yr via DBT.

eligibility_criteria: Student having not less than 40% benchmark disability certified by competent medical authority (UDID Card)
Enrolled in regular Class 9 or 10 in recognized school in Karnataka
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Class 9 or 10 student with benchmark disability.
process: Apply online through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with UDID number.
School verifies enrollment; District Welfare Officer approves.
Ministry credits maintenance and disability allowances directly via DBT.
important_current_notes: UDID (Unique Disability Identity Card) portal integrated for paperless verification.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round on national portal

name.en: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities (DEPwD)
name.kn: ವಿಶೇಷ ಚೇತನ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್-ನಂತರದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ (ಕೇಂದ್ರ ವಿಕಲಚೇತನರ ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ ಇಲಾಖೆ)
name.hi: दिव्यांग विद्यार्थियों हेतु पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति (डीईपीडब्ल्यूडी)

schemes.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, MSJE, Government of India

summary.en: Full mandatory fee reimbursement, monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,600, book grant of ₹4,000, and disability allowances for post-matric students with benchmark disability (≥ 40%).
summary.kn: ಪಿಯುಸಿ, ಪದವಿ, ಸ್ನಾತಕೋತ್ತರ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ವಿಶೇಷ ಚೇತನ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಕಾಲೇಜು ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮರುಪಾವತಿ, ಮಾಸಿಕ ನಿರ್ವಹಣಾ ಭತ್ಯೆ (₹1,600 ವರೆಗೆ) ಮತ್ತು ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಅನುದಾನ.
summary.hi: 11वीं, 12वीं, कॉलेज एवं विश्वविद्यालय में अध्ययनरत 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले छात्रों को पूर्ण अनिवार्य शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति, मासिक निर्वाह भत्ता एवं पुस्तक अनुदान।

description.en: Central sector scholarship ensuring disabled students have equal access to higher education, covering all compulsory non-refundable fees, reader allowance for visually impaired, transport allowance, and escort allowance.
description.kn: ವಿಶೇಷ ಚೇತನ ಯುವಜನರು ಉನ್ನತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಪಡೆದು ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರವಾಗಿ ಬದುಕಲು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಸಮಗ್ರ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು.
description.hi: दिव्यांग छात्र-छात्राओं को उच्च शिक्षा में आत्मनिर्भरता प्रदान करने हेतु संपूर्ण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं सहायक भत्ता योजना।

benefit.description: 100% compulsory course and exam fee reimbursement, monthly maintenance allowance (₹900 - ₹1,600/month for 10 months), book grant ₹4,000/yr, and disability allowances up to ₹4,000/yr via DBT.

eligibility_criteria: Student having benchmark disability ≥ 40% certified by Government Medical Board (UDID Card)
Enrolled in recognized post-matric course (Class 11 to Ph.D.) in recognized institution
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Post-matric student with benchmark disability.
process: Apply online through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with OTR and UDID number.
College verifies admission credentials online.
State Nodal Officer approves; Ministry releases fee and maintenance allowance directly via DBT.

important_dates.academic_window: Open on National Scholarship Portal for academic cycle

important_current_notes: Over 17,000 slots allocated nationally each year.
schemes.application_window: Applications open on National Scholarship Portal

name.en: Central Sector Scholarship for Top Class Education for SC Students
name.kn: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಉನ್ನತ ದರ್ಜೆಯ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ (ಟಾಪ್ ಕ್ಲಾಸ್ ಎಜುಕೇಶನ್)
name.hi: अनुसूचित जाति के छात्रों हेतु टॉप क्लास शिक्षा छात्रवृत्ति (केंद्रीय क्षेत्र)

schemes.department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

summary.en: Full tuition fee reimbursement (up to ₹2 Lakhs in private or actual in government), living expenses of ₹3,000/month, computer grant of ₹45,000, and books grant for SC students admitted to premier institutions (IITs, IIMs, NITs, IISc, NLUs, AIIMS).
summary.kn: ಐಐಟಿ, ಐಐಎಂ, ಐಐಎಸ್‌ಸಿ, ನಿಟ್, ಎನ್‌ಎಲ್‌ಯು ಮತ್ತು ಏಮ್ಸ್ ಮುಂತಾದ ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠಿತ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಪಡೆದ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಬೋಧನಾ ಶುಲ್ಕ, ಮಾಸಿಕ ₹3,000 ಜೀವನ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಹಾಗೂ ಲ್ಯಾಪ್‌ಟಾಪ್ ಖರೀದಿಗೆ ₹45,000 ಅನುದಾನ.
summary.hi: आईआईटी, आईआईएम, आईआईएससी, एम्स जैसे देश के शीर्ष 266+ संस्थानों में प्रवेश पाने वाले एससी छात्रों को पूर्ण शिक्षण शुल्क, ₹3,000/माह निर्वाह व्यय और ₹45,000 कंप्यूटर सहायता।

description.en: Top Class Education Scheme recognizes and promotes quality education among SC students by fully funding their studies in 266+ notified premier institutions across India.
description.kn: ದೇಶದ ಅತ್ಯುನ್ನತ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಯ ಪ್ರತಿಭಾವಂತ ಯುವಜನರಿಗೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಉಚಿತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನ ಭತ್ಯೆ ನೀಡುವ ಮಹತ್ವಾಕಾಂಕ್ಷೆಯ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: देश के शीर्षस्थ उच्च शिक्षण संस्थानों में अनुसूचित जाति के मेधावी विद्यार्थियों के संपूर्ण शैक्षिक और रहने के खर्च को वहन करने वाली केंद्रीय योजना।

benefit.description: Full tuition fee reimbursement (actual for govt institutions, up to ₹2.00 Lakhs/yr for private) + ₹3,000/month living expenses + ₹45,000 one-time computer grant + ₹5,000/yr books grant via DBT.

eligibility_criteria: Student belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) admitted into notified premier institution (e.g., IISc Bengaluru, IIM Bangalore, NITK Surathkal, NLSIU Bengaluru in Karnataka)
Annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000
Total 4,100 fresh slots awarded annually nationwide

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC).
Annual household income must not exceed ₹8,00,000.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Admitted to notified premier institution.
process: Apply online through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with OTR.
Select Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students under Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
Premier institution verifies admission credentials; Ministry sanctions full fee and allowances via DBT.

important_dates.annual_window: Open on National Scholarship Portal for academic session

important_current_notes: One-time computer purchase grant of ₹45,000 paid in 1st year directly to student.
schemes.application_window: Applications open on National Scholarship Portal

name.kn: ವಿಶೇಷ ಚೇತನ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಉನ್ನತ ದರ್ಜೆಯ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ (ಟಾಪ್ ಕ್ಲಾಸ್)

schemes.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, MSJE, Government of India

summary.en: Full tuition fee reimbursement (up to ₹7 Lakhs/yr in private or actual in government), maintenance allowance of ₹3,000/month, computer grant of ₹30,000, and assistive devices assistance for disabled students in premier institutions.
summary.kn: ದೇಶದ 240 ಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠಿತ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಪಡೆದ ವಿಕಲಚೇತನ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಬೋಧನಾ ಶುಲ್ಕ (ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹7 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗೆ), ಮಾಸಿಕ ₹3,000 ನಿರ್ವಹಣಾ ಭತ್ಯೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಸಹಾಯಕ ಸಲಕರಣೆಗಳ ಅನುದಾನ.
summary.hi: शीर्ष 240+ राष्ट्रीय संस्थानों में अध्ययनरत दिव्यांग छात्रों को संपूर्ण शिक्षण शुल्क, ₹3,000/माह निर्वाह भत्ता, कंप्यूटर अनुदान और सहायक उपकरण सहायता।

description.en: Recognizes and supports students with benchmark disabilities admitted to graduate or postgraduate courses in notified premier institutions across India.
description.kn: ವಿಶೇಷ ಚೇತನ ಪ್ರತಿಭಾವಂತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು ಉನ್ನತ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟದ ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಪಡೆಯಲು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಸಮಗ್ರ ನೆರವು.
description.hi: दिव्यांग युवाओं को देश के सर्वोत्तम शैक्षणिक संस्थानों में निःशुल्क उच्च शिक्षा उपलब्ध कराने की योजना।

benefit.description: Full reimbursement of tuition fees up to ₹7,00,000/yr (actual in govt institutes), ₹3,000/month living expenses, ₹30,000 computer aid, and assistive aids allowance up to ₹2,000/yr via DBT.

eligibility_criteria: Student having benchmark disability ≥ 40% certified by competent medical authority (UDID Card)
Admitted into notified premier institution (IITs, IIMs, NITs, Central Universities, etc.)
Annual family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹6,00,000.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Student with benchmark disability admitted to notified premier institution.

required_documents.item: Admission Letter from Notified Premier Institute

process: Apply online through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with OTR and UDID number.
Premier institution verifies admission credentials online.
Ministry sanctions full fee and allowances directly via DBT into student's account.

important_current_notes: Total 300 fresh scholarships awarded each year.

name.kn: ಪಿಎಂ ಯಶಸ್ವಿ ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್-ಪೂರ್ವ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗ ಮತ್ತು ಇಬಿಸಿ)
name.hi: पीएम यशस्वी प्री-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति योजना (ओबीसी, ईबीसी एवं डीएनटी)

schemes.department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment & National Scholarship Portal, Government of India

summary.en: Financial scholarship of ₹4,000 per annum for OBC, Economically Backward Classes (EBC), and De-notified Tribes (DNT) students studying in Classes 9 and 10 in top schools.
summary.kn: 9 ಮತ್ತು 10 ನೇ ತರಗತಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಓದುತ್ತಿರುವ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗಗಳು (OBC), ಆರ್ಥಿಕವಾಗಿ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗಗಳು (EBC) ಮತ್ತು ಅಲೆಮಾರಿ ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟುಗಳ (DNT) ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹4,000 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
summary.hi: कक्षा 9 और 10 में अध्ययनरत अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग (ओबीसी), ईबीसी और डीएनटी विद्यार्थियों को ₹4,000 प्रति वर्ष की छात्रवृत्ति।

description.en: PM-YASASVI provides financial assistance to students belonging to OBC, EBC, and DNT categories studying in identified top-class schools, supporting uniforms, textbooks, and tuition expenses.
description.kn: ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸಮಾಜ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಮತ್ತು ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯದ ವತಿಯಿಂದ ನೀಡಲಾಗುವ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
description.hi: पिछड़ा वर्ग के प्रतिभाशाली विद्यार्थियों को गुणवत्तापूर्ण स्कूली शिक्षा जारी रखने हेतु केंद्र सरकार की योजना।

benefit.description: ₹4,000 per annum credited via DBT directly to student's bank account for Classes 9 and 10.

eligibility_criteria: Student must belong to OBC, EBC, or DNT category
Enrolled in regular Class 9 or 10 in recognized school in Karnataka
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: OBC/EBC/DNT student in Class 9 or 10.
process: Apply online through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with OTR.
Select PM-YASASVI Pre-Matric under Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
School online verification, followed by DBT credit to student's account.
