summary.en: Full tuition and academic fee reimbursement plus monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200 per month for OBC, EBC, and DNT students pursuing post-matric courses.
summary.kn: ಪಿಯುಸಿ, ಐಟಿಐ, ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ, ಪದವಿ, ಸ್ನಾತಕೋತ್ತರ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ಒಬಿಸಿ, ಇಬಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಡಿಎನ್‌ಟಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾಸಿಕ ನಿರ್ವಹಣಾ ಭತ್ಯೆ.
summary.hi: 11वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई, डिप्लोमा, डिग्री व स्नातकोत्तर ओबीसी, ईबीसी एवं डीएनटी छात्रों हेतु शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं निर्वाह भत्ता।

description.en: The central post-matric scholarship scheme for Other Backward Classes, Economically Backward Classes, and De-notified Nomadic Tribes covers course fees and living expenses for higher studies across India.
description.kn: ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಯುವಜನರಿಗೆ ಉನ್ನತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದ ಹಾದಿ ಸುಲಭಗೊಳಿಸುವ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಡಿಬಿಟಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
description.hi: पिछड़े और वंचित वर्गों के युवाओं को उच्च शिक्षा के वित्तीय भार से मुक्त करने वाली राष्ट्रीय योजना।

benefit.description: Full compulsory course fee reimbursement plus monthly maintenance allowance of ₹500 to ₹1,200 per month for 10 months via DBT.

eligibility_criteria: Student must belong to Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), or De-notified Tribes (DNT)
Enrolled in recognized post-matric course (Class 11 to Ph.D.)
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Post-matric student belonging to OBC/EBC/DNT.
process: Register with OTR on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Submit PM-YASASVI Post-Matric application form.
College e-verifies credentials; Ministry sanctions and disburses DBT funds directly.
important_current_notes: Scholarship amount credited directly to student bank accounts via PFMS/DBT.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round on national portal

name.en: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship for Meritorious Minority Girls
name.kn: ಬೇಗಂ ಹಜರತ್ ಮಹಲ್ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ (ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ)
name.hi: बेगम हज़रत महल राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति (मेधावी अल्पसंख्यक बालिकाएं)

schemes.department: Maulana Azad Education Foundation & Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India

summary.en: Direct financial assistance of ₹5,000 (Classes 9-10) and ₹6,000 (Classes 11-12) for meritorious girl students belonging to six notified minority communities with family income up to ₹2,00,000.
summary.kn: 9 ಮತ್ತು 10 ನೇ ತರಗತಿಗೆ ₹5,000 ಹಾಗೂ 11 ಮತ್ತು 12 ನೇ ತರಗತಿಗೆ ₹6,000 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ: ಮುಸ್ಲಿಂ, ಕ್ರಿಶ್ಚಿಯನ್, ಜೈನ, ಬೌದ್ಧ, ಸಿಖ್, ಪಾರ್ಸಿ ಪ್ರತಿಭಾನ್ವಿತ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ.
summary.hi: कक्षा 9-10 हेतु ₹5,000 और कक्षा 11-12 हेतु ₹6,000 की प्रत्यक्ष छात्रवृत्ति: 6 अल्पसंख्यक समुदायों की मेधावी छात्राओं के लिए।

description.en: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship recognizes and assists meritorious minority girl students who cannot continue their education due to financial distress, providing direct support for fees, books, and uniforms.
description.kn: ಬಡ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳು ಪ್ರೌಢಶಾಲಾ ಮತ್ತು ಪದವಿಪೂರ್ವ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದಿಂದ ವಂಚಿತರಾಗಬಾರದು ಎಂಬ ಉದ್ದೇಶದಿಂದ ನೀಡಲಾಗುವ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ನೆರವು.
description.hi: अल्पसंख्यक बालिकाओं की माध्यमिक एवं उच्चतर माध्यमिक शिक्षा को बढ़ावा देने हेतु विशेष छात्रवृत्ति।

benefit.description: ₹5,000 per year for Class 9 and 10; ₹6,000 per year for Class 11 and 12 credited directly via DBT.

eligibility_criteria: Girl student belonging to notified Religious Minorities (Muslim, Christian, Jain, Buddhist, Sikh, Parsi)
Studying in Class 9 to 12; secured minimum 50% marks in previous final examination
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,00,000

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹2,00,000.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Girl student in Class 9 to 12 belonging to minority community.
process: Apply online through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with OTR registration.
School principal verifies student record online.
Direct Benefit Transfer credited to student's bank account.
important_current_notes: Exclusively reserved for female minority students.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round on national portal

name.en: CBSE Merit Scholarship Scheme for Single Girl Child
name.kn: ಸಿಬಿಎಸ್‌ಇ ಏಕೈಕ ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಮಗುವಿನ ಮೆರಿಟ್ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ ಯೋಜನೆ
name.hi: सीबीएसई एकल बालिका मेधावी छात्रवृत्ति योजना

schemes.department: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), Ministry of Education, Government of India

summary.en: Monthly scholarship of ₹500 for two years (Classes XI and XII) for meritorious single girl children who cleared Class X from CBSE with 60% or more marks.
summary.kn: ಸಿಬಿಎಸ್‌ಇ 10 ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಶೇ. 60 ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಅಂಕ ಪಡೆದು 11 ಮತ್ತು 12 ನೇ ತರಗತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಓದುತ್ತಿರುವ ಪೋಷಕರ ಏಕೈಕ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ₹500 ರಂತೆ 2 ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಕಾಲ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
summary.hi: सीबीएसई 10वीं में 60% या अधिक अंक प्राप्त कर 11वीं-12वीं में अध्ययनरत एकल कन्याओं को ₹500 प्रति माह की दर से 2 वर्ष हेतु छात्रवृत्ति।

description.en: CBSE awards scholarships to single girl children of their parents to encourage education of girls and promote small family norms. The scholarship supports school tuition fees during Classes 11 and 12.
description.kn: ಪೋಷಕರಿಗೆ ಒಬ್ಬಳೇ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಗಳಿರುವ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು ಉತ್ತೇಜಿಸಲು ಸಿಬಿಎಸ್‌ಇ ಮಂಡಳಿಯು ನೀಡುವ ಮೆರಿಟ್ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
description.hi: बालिका शिक्षा को प्रोत्साहन देने और एकल कन्या वाले परिवारों को सहयोग देने हेतु सीबीएसई की छात्रवृत्ति योजना।

benefit.description: ₹500 per month (₹6,000 per year) for up to two years credited via DBT.

eligibility_criteria: Must be the only child of her parents (single girl child without any brother or sister)
Passed Class X examination from CBSE affiliated school with minimum 60% marks
Pursuing Class XI and XII in a CBSE affiliated school whose tuition fee is not more than ₹1,500/month

exclusions.description: Girls having brothers or sisters are not eligible. School monthly tuition fee must not exceed ₹1,500.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Single girl child in Class 11/12 CBSE school.

required_documents.note: Sworn by parents certifying single girl child status attested by First Class Magistrate/Notary.
Signed by Principal certifying monthly fee ≤ ₹1,500.

process: Apply online through CBSE official scholarship portal (cbse.gov.in).
Print application, get signature of school Principal, and upload attested documents.
CBSE verifies and credits ₹6,000 annually directly into student's bank account via ECS/DBT.

important_dates.annual_window: Typically closes in December-January following Class X results; applications currently closed for current window

important_current_notes: Current application window closed; fresh submissions open with next Class X board results.
schemes.application_window: Applications currently closed (Reopens with next board results)
schemes.geographic_applicability: All India CBSE Schools (Karnataka CBSE schools eligible)

name.en: DST INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE - Basic Sciences)
name.kn: ಡಿಎಸ್‌ಟಿ ಇನ್‌ಸ್ಪೈರ್ ಉನ್ನತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ (ಮೂಲ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ವಿಭಾಗ)
name.hi: डीएसटी इंस्पायर उच्च शिक्षा छात्रवृत्ति (एसएचई - बुनियादी विज्ञान)

schemes.department: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India

summary.en: Prestigious scholarship of ₹80,000 per annum (₹60,000 scholarship + ₹20,000 summer research project grant) for top 1% meritorious 12th board students pursuing B.Sc./M.Sc. courses in natural and basic sciences.
summary.kn: 12 ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಬೋರ್ಡ್ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಗ್ರ ಶೇ. 1 (ಟಾಪ್ 1%) ಅಂಕ ಗಳಿಸಿ ಭೌತಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ, ರಸಾಯನಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ, ಗಣಿತ, ಜೀವಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಮುಂತಾದ ಮೂಲ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿ.ಎಸ್ಸಿ / ಎಂ.ಎಸ್ಸಿ ಓದುತ್ತಿರುವ ಪ್ರತಿಭಾನ್ವಿತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹80,000 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
summary.hi: 12वीं बोर्ड में शीर्ष 1% मेधावियों को भौतिकी, रसायन, गणित आदि बुनियादी विज्ञानों में बीएससी/एमएससी करने हेतु ₹80,000 प्रति वर्ष की राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति।

description.en: INSPIRE (Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research) SHE encourages talented youth to undertake higher education in science-intensive courses and research careers. It provides ₹5,000 per month (₹60,000/yr) plus ₹20,000 mentorship grant for research projects.
description.kn: ದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಯನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸಲು ಪ್ರತಿಭಾವಂತ ಯುವಜನರಿಗೆ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ಮತ್ತು ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ ಇಲಾಖೆಯ ವತಿಯಿಂದ ನೀಡಲಾಗುವ ಅತ್ಯುನ್ನತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.
description.hi: प्रतिभावान युवाओं को विज्ञान एवं शोध के क्षेत्र में आकर्षित करने हेतु भारत सरकार की प्रमुख छात्रवृत्ति योजना।

benefit.description: ₹80,000 per annum (₹60,000 direct scholarship @ ₹5,000/month + ₹20,000 summer research mentorship project grant) for 5 years (B.Sc. and M.Sc. integrated).

eligibility_criteria: Meritorious student within top 1% in Class 12th examination in state board (Karnataka PUC) or central boards (CBSE/ICSE)
OR rank within top 10,000 in JEE Advanced, JEE Main, or NEET pursuing basic sciences
Enrolled in regular B.Sc., B.S., or Int. M.Sc./M.S. in Natural/Basic Sciences (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Statistics, Geology, Astrophysics)

exclusions.description: Students pursuing engineering, medicine, agriculture, law, or commerce professional courses are not covered under SHE.

schemes.income_criteria: No income ceiling (Purely academic merit based on top 1% board ranking).
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Top 1% 12th board enrolled in B.Sc./M.Sc. basic sciences.

required_documents.note: Issued by Karnataka PUC Board / CBSE.
Must be active savings account in State Bank of India (SBI).

process: Apply online through INSPIRE web portal (online-inspire.gov.in).
Upload 12th marks sheet, Board advisory note, and college endorsement form.
DST verifies cutoff eligibility and disburses ₹80,000/year directly via DBT into student's SBI account.

important_dates.annual_call: Calls for application open annually on online-inspire.gov.in

important_current_notes: Total 10,000 scholarships awarded annually across India.
schemes.application_window: Applications open on DST INSPIRE portal

name.en: Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF)
name.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ ಫೆಲೋಶಿಪ್ (ಪಿಎಂಆರ್‌ಎಫ್)
name.hi: प्रधानमंत्री रिसर्च फेलोशिप (पीएमआरएफ)

schemes.department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India

summary.en: India's highest research fellowship of ₹70,000 to ₹80,000 per month plus an annual research contingency grant of ₹2,00,000 for Ph.D. scholars in premier institutions (IITs, IISc Bengaluru, IISERs).
summary.kn: ಐಐಎಸ್‌ಸಿ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು, ಐಐಟಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಐಐಎಸ್‌ಇಆರ್ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪಿಎಚ್‌ಡಿ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ನಡೆಸುವ ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸರಿಗೆ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ₹70,000 ದಿಂದ ₹80,000 ಫೆಲೋಶಿಪ್ ಹಾಗೂ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹2,00,000 ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ ಅನುದಾನ.
summary.hi: आईआईएससी बेंगलुरु, आईआईटी जैसे शीर्ष संस्थानों में पीएचडी शोधकर्ताओं को ₹70,000 से ₹80,000 प्रति माह फेलोशिप तथा ₹2,00,000 वार्षिक शोध अनुदान।

description.en: PMRF attracts the best talent to doctoral research in cutting-edge science and technology domains. Fellows receive ₹70,000/month for years 1-2, ₹75,000/month for year 3, and ₹80,000/month for years 4-5, with ₹2 Lakhs annual research contingency grant.
description.kn: ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ಮತ್ತು ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಾಗತಿಕ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟದ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಯನ್ನು ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ನೀಡುವ ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠಿತ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ ಫೆಲೋಶಿಪ್.
description.hi: अत्याधुनिक विज्ञान एवं प्रौद्योगिकी अनुसंधान हेतु देश की सर्वोच्च फेलोशिप योजना।

benefit.description: Monthly fellowship: ₹70,000 (Years 1-2), ₹75,000 (Year 3), ₹80,000 (Years 4-5) plus ₹2,00,000 annual research contingency grant for 5 years.

eligibility_criteria: Completed B.Tech, M.Tech, or M.Sc. from recognized Indian university with CGPA ≥ 8.0 (or valid GATE score ≥ 650)
Selected for full-time Ph.D. program in a PMRF granting institution (including IISc Bengaluru in Karnataka, IITs)
Recommended by PMRF National Coordination Committee based on research proposal
schemes.income_criteria: No income ceiling (Highest academic merit and research proposal based).
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Enrolled Ph.D. scholar in notified PMRF granting institution.

required_documents.item: B.Tech / M.Tech / M.Sc. Degree Certificates and Transcripts
Ph.D. Admission Letter from PMRF Institution

process: Get admitted to Ph.D. program at PMRF granting institution (IISc Bengaluru, IITs).
Institution nominates scholar through direct entry or lateral entry channel.
National Screening Committee interviews scholar and approves PMRF status.

important_dates.selection_cycles: Conducted twice annually (May and December cycles)

important_current_notes: PMRF fellows undertake mandatory teaching assistantship at local schools or polytechnics.
schemes.application_window: Open for institutional nominations on PMRF portal
schemes.geographic_applicability: All India (Active at IISc Bengaluru and IITs)

name.en: UGC Junior Research Fellowship (JRF - Humanities & Social Sciences)
name.kn: ಯುಜಿಸಿ ಕಿರಿಯ ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ ಫೆಲೋಶಿಪ್ (ಜೆಆರ್‌ಎಫ್)
name.hi: यूजीसी जूनियर रिसर्च फेलोशिप (जेआरएफ)

schemes.department: University Grants Commission (UGC) & National Testing Agency (NTA), Ministry of Education, GoI

summary.en: Monthly research stipend of ₹37,000 for first two years (JRF) and ₹42,000 for subsequent three years (SRF) plus HRA and contingency grant for Ph.D. scholars qualifying the UGC-NET exam.
summary.kn: ಯುಜಿಸಿ-ನೆಟ್ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜೆಆರ್‌ಎಫ್ ಅರ್ಹತೆ ಪಡೆದು ಪಿಎಚ್‌ಡಿ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ನಡೆಸುವ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಮೊದಲ 2 ವರ್ಷ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ₹37,000 ಹಾಗೂ ಮುಂದಿನ 3 ವರ್ಷ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ₹42,000 ಫೆಲೋಶಿಪ್ ಜತೆಗೆ ಮನೆ ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ಭತ್ಯೆ.
summary.hi: यूजीसी-नेट परीक्षा में जेआरएफ उत्तीर्ण कर पीएचडी करने वाले शोधार्थियों को प्रथम 2 वर्ष ₹37,000/माह और अगले 3 वर्ष ₹42,000/माह फेलोशिप तथा एचआरए।

description.en: UGC-JRF provides financial assistance to candidates who qualify in the National Eligibility Test (NET) and enroll in full-time Ph.D. programs in Humanities, Social Sciences, Languages, Commerce, and Environmental Sciences.
description.kn: ವಿಶ್ವವಿದ್ಯಾಲಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟದ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಿಸಲು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಏಜೆನ್ಸಿ (NTA) ಮತ್ತು ಯುಜಿಸಿ ನೀಡುವ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ ವೇತನ.
description.hi: विश्वविद्यालयों में उच्च शोध को बढ़ावा देने हेतु यूजीसी द्वारा प्रदत्त प्रतिष्ठित मासिक अनुसंधान फेलोशिप।

benefit.description: Monthly fellowship of ₹37,000 (JRF - 1st & 2nd year) and ₹42,000 (SRF - 3rd, 4th & 5th year) + HRA (8% to 27%) + Contingency grant of ₹10,000 to ₹20,500 per annum.

eligibility_criteria: Master's Degree with minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwD)
Qualified for JRF in UGC-NET examination conducted by NTA
Enrolled in regular full-time Ph.D. in recognized university in Karnataka or across India within 3 years of result declaration
schemes.age_criteria: Not more than 30 years as on exam date (5 years relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Women).
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Master's degree holder enrolled in Ph.D. qualifying UGC-NET JRF.

required_documents.item: Canara Bank UGC Scholar Portal Account

process: Appear and qualify for JRF in UGC-NET examination conducted by NTA (ugcnet.nta.ac.in).
Take admission into Ph.D. program in recognized university.
University links scholar profile onto UGC Scholarship Fellowship Management Portal (SFMP); monthly stipend disbursed via DBT.

important_dates.exam_cycles: UGC-NET conducted twice a year in June and December

important_current_notes: Direct monthly payment via Canara Bank SFMP scholarship portal.
schemes.application_window: Bi-annual exam cycle (June and December sessions)
schemes.geographic_applicability: All India (Active in all Karnataka Universities)

name.en: CSIR Junior Research Fellowship (JRF in Science & Engineering)
name.kn: ಸಿಎಸ್‌ಐಆರ್ ಕಿರಿಯ ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ ಫೆಲೋಶಿಪ್ (ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಎಂಜಿನಿಯರಿಂಗ್ ವಿಭಾಗ)
name.hi: सीएसआईआर जूनियर रिसर्च फेलोशिप (विज्ञान एवं इंजीनियरिंग)

schemes.department: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), Ministry of Science and Technology, GoI

summary.en: Research fellowship of ₹37,000 per month (first 2 years) and ₹42,000 per month (subsequent years) plus HRA and annual contingency grant of ₹20,000 for Ph.D. scholars in Chemical, Earth, Life, Mathematical, and Physical Sciences.
summary.kn: ರಸಾಯನಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ, ಜೀವಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ, ಗಣಿತ, ಭೌತಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಹಾಗೂ ಎಂಜಿನಿಯರಿಂಗ್ ವಿಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಿಎಚ್‌ಡಿ ಮಾಡುವ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಿಎಸ್‌ಐಆರ್ ನೀಡುವ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ₹37,000 ದಿಂದ ₹42,000 ಫೆಲೋಶಿಪ್ ಮತ್ತು ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ ಅನುದಾನ.
summary.hi: रसायन, जीवन विज्ञान, गणित, भौतिकी और इंजीनियरिंग में पीएचडी करने वाले सीएसआईआर-नेट उत्तीर्ण शोधकर्ताओं को ₹37,000 से ₹42,000/माह फेलोशिप।

description.en: Joint CSIR-UGC NET JRF aims to identify promising young scientists for doctoral research in scientific and technological domains across CSIR laboratories, central institutes, and universities.
description.kn: ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಕೈಗಾರಿಕಾ ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ ಮಂಡಳಿಯ ವತಿಯಿಂದ ದೇಶದ ಅಗ್ರ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ಸಂಶೋಧಕರಿಗೆ ನೀಡಲಾಗುವ ಗೌರವಾನ್ವಿತ ಫೆಲೋಶಿಪ್.
description.hi: वैज्ञानिक अनुसंधान को समर्पित देश के प्रमुख शोध संस्थानों एवं विश्वविद्यालयों में पीएचडी हेतु केंद्रीय फेलोशिप।

benefit.description: Monthly fellowship of ₹37,000 (JRF) and ₹42,000 (SRF) + HRA (8% - 27%) + annual contingency grant of ₹20,000 directly via DBT.

eligibility_criteria: M.Sc. or equivalent degree / Integrated BS-MS / BS-4 Years / BE / B.Tech / B.Pharma / MBBS with minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/PwD)
Qualified in Joint CSIR-UGC NET JRF examination
Registered for Ph.D. in recognized university/institute within 2 years of result
schemes.age_criteria: Maximum 28 years (5 years relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD).
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: M.Sc./B.Tech degree holder qualifying CSIR NET JRF.
process: Appear and qualify for JRF in Joint CSIR-UGC NET examination.
Take admission into Ph.D. at research institution or university.
Submit joining report and bank details to CSIR HRDG; monthly fellowship released via direct DBT.
important_current_notes: Tenure is 5 years subject to satisfactory annual research progress.
schemes.application_window: Bi-annual examination cycle via CSIR HRDG

name.en: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme (CSIS - Education Loan Subsidy)
name.kn: ಕೇಂದ್ರ ವಲಯ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಸಹಾಯಧನ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಸಿಎಸ್‌ಐಎಸ್ - ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಾಲದ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಮನ್ನಾ)
name.hi: केंद्रीय क्षेत्र ब्याज सब्सिडी योजना (सीएसआईएस - शिक्षा ऋण ब्याज छूट)

schemes.department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education & Canara Bank (Nodal Bank), GoI

summary.en: 100% full interest subsidy during the moratorium period (course duration + 1 year) on educational loans up to ₹7.5 Lakhs for students from economically weaker sections pursuing professional/technical courses.
summary.kn: ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ಮತ್ತು ತಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಓದುವ ಬಡ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು ಪಡೆದ ₹7.5 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗಿನ ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಾಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗದ ಅವಧಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಮುಂದಿನ 1 ವರ್ಷದ ಮೊರಟೋರಿಯಂ ಅವಧಿಯ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಬಡ್ಡಿಯನ್ನು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರವೇ ಭರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: व्यावसायिक/तकनीकी पाठ्यक्रमों के गरीब छात्रों द्वारा लिए गए ₹7.5 लाख तक के शिक्षा ऋण पर अध्ययन अवधि + 1 वर्ष तक 100% ब्याज का भुगतान केंद्र सरकार करती है।

description.en: CSIS provides full interest subsidy during the moratorium period on educational loans availed under the IBA Model Educational Loan Scheme by students belonging to Economically Weaker Sections (family income ≤ ₹4.5 Lakhs) pursuing higher education in India.
description.kn: ಬಡ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು ಕಾಲೇಜು ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಲದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಬಡ್ಡಿಯ ಹೊರೆ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಓದನ್ನು ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಲು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯದ ನೆರವು.
description.hi: बैंक शिक्षा ऋण पर पढ़ाई के दौरान लगने वाले पूरे ब्याज का सरकारी पुनर्भुगतान।

benefit.description: 100% interest waiver during moratorium period (course tenure + 1 year) on education loans up to ₹7.5 Lakhs sanctioned by scheduled commercial banks.

eligibility_criteria: Student enrolled in professional or technical degree/diploma in recognized institutions in India
Educational loan availed from scheduled commercial banks under IBA model scheme without collateral/third-party guarantee up to ₹7.5 Lakhs
Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹4,50,000

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household income must not exceed ₹4,50,000.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Student with bank education loan for professional/technical course.

required_documents.note: Issued by authorized revenue authority showing income ≤ ₹4.5 Lakhs.

process: Avail educational loan from any scheduled commercial bank for recognized professional/technical course.
Submit income certificate (≤ ₹4.5 Lakhs) to the lending bank branch.
Lending bank branch uploads claim onto Canara Bank nodal portal; interest subsidy credited directly to loan account by Government.

important_dates.annual_claim: Submitted annually by commercial banks on Canara Bank CSIS web portal

important_current_notes: Student pays zero interest during course duration plus one year post-course.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round through lending commercial banks

name.en: Kittur Rani Chennamma Award and Incentive Scheme for Rural Girls
name.kn: ಕಿತ್ತೂರು ರಾಣಿ ಚೆನ್ನಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಧನ ಯೋಜನೆ
name.hi: कित्तूर रानी चेन्नम्मा पुरस्कार एवं ग्रामीण बालिका प्रोत्साहन योजना

schemes.department: Department of Women and Child Development & Education, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Annual cash incentives and awards (₹10,000 to ₹25,000) for meritorious rural girl students who achieve top ranks in SSLC and PUC examinations in Karnataka government schools.
summary.kn: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಪ್ರೌಢಶಾಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪದವಿಪೂರ್ವ ಕಾಲೇಜುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಎಸ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಎಲ್‌ಸಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಪಿಯುಸಿ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಅಂಕ ಗಳಿಸುವ ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ₹10,000 ದಿಂದ ₹25,000 ವರೆಗೆ ನಗದು ಬಹುಮಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿ.
summary.hi: कर्नाटक के ग्रामीण सरकारी विद्यालयों में 10वीं (एसएसएलसी) और 12वीं (पीयूसी) में सर्वोच्च अंक प्राप्त करने वाली छात्राओं को ₹10,000 से ₹25,000 का नकद पुरस्कार।

description.en: Named after the historic warrior queen of Kittur, this scheme honours top-performing rural girl students in government institutions, fostering female leadership, higher education, and academic excellence in rural Karnataka.
description.kn: ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಭಾಗದ ಪ್ರತಿಭಾನ್ವಿತ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನು ಗೌರವಿಸಿ ಉನ್ನತ ವಿದ್ಯಾಭ್ಯಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಿಸಲು ಮಹಿಳಾ ಮತ್ತು ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಇಲಾಖೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಇಲಾಖೆಯ ವತಿಯಿಂದ ನೀಡಲಾಗುವ ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠಿತ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿ.
description.hi: ग्रामीण बालिकाओं में उच्च शिक्षा और नेतृत्व को प्रोत्साहित करने हेतु राज्य सरकार का वार्षिक पुरस्कार।

benefit.description: Cash prize of ₹10,000 (Taluk level toppers) to ₹25,000 (District level toppers) plus citation and certificate.

eligibility_criteria: Girl student who completed SSLC or PUC in a government school/college in rural Karnataka
Must have scored highest marks in the taluk or district among female government school candidates
Studied for at least 7 years in rural Karnataka institutions
schemes.income_criteria: No income ceiling (Merit-based for rural government school girl toppers).
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Rural government school girl student topping SSLC/PUC.

required_documents.note: Official marks card showing top ranking.
Signed by BEO certifying rural government school study.

process: Block Education Officer (BEO) and DDPI compile taluk-level merit lists of rural government school girl candidates following board results.
District Administration sanctions awards and felicitates toppers on Republic Day or Rajyotsava; prize amount credited via DBT.

important_dates.annual_ceremony: Felicitated during district state celebrations annually

important_current_notes: Automated nomination through BEO office without requiring individual paperwork.
schemes.application_window: Active annual departmental nomination cycle

name.en: Mandya District Zilla Panchayat Rural SSLC/PUC Merit Incentive Scheme
name.kn: ಮಂಡ್ಯ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಪಂಚಾಯತ್ ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಎಸ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಎಲ್‌ಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪಿಯುಸಿ ಪ್ರತಿಭಾ ಪುರಸ್ಕಾರ ಯೋಜನೆ
name.hi: मंड्या जिला पंचायत ग्रामीण 10वीं/12वीं प्रतिभा प्रोत्साहन योजना

schemes.department: District Administration and Zilla Panchayat Mandya, Karnataka

summary.en: Special cash awards of ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 for top-performing students from rural government high schools and pre-university colleges in Mandya district.
summary.kn: ಮಂಡ್ಯ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಶಾಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಲೇಜುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಎಸ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಎಲ್‌ಸಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಪಿಯುಸಿ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಅಂಕ ಗಳಿಸಿದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಪಂಚಾಯತಿಯಿಂದ ₹10,000 ದಿಂದ ₹15,000 ನಗದು ಪುರಸ್ಕಾರ.
summary.hi: मंड्या जिले के ग्रामीण सरकारी स्कूलों व कॉलेजों में 10वीं एवं 12वीं में उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन करने वाले विद्यार्थियों को ₹10,000 से ₹15,000 का नकद पुरस्कार।

description.en: To motivate students in rural taluks of Mandya (Mandya, Maddur, Malavalli, Pandavapura, Srirangapatna, Nagamangala, K.R. Pet), the Mandya Zilla Panchayat awards special merit grants to high school and PUC board exam toppers.
description.kn: ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಶಾಲೆಗಳ ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಬಡ ಪ್ರತಿಭೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಿಸಲು ಮಂಡ್ಯ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಪಂಚಾಯತಿ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿದ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: मंड्या जिले के ग्रामीण सरकारी विद्यालयों में उच्च शैक्षिक परिणाम प्राप्त करने वाले छात्रों हेतु जिला स्तरीय प्रोत्साहन।

benefit.description: Cash incentive of ₹10,000 for SSLC taluk toppers and ₹15,000 for PUC toppers from rural government institutions in Mandya district.

eligibility_criteria: Student enrolled in a rural government high school or government PU college located in Mandya district
Secured top 3 rank in the taluk in SSLC or PUC board examinations
Studied in rural government school for at least 5 years
schemes.income_criteria: No income ceiling (Merit-based for rural government students).
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Student in rural government school/college in Mandya district.

required_documents.note: Proving top taluk ranking in Mandya.

required_documents.item: Study Certificate from Mandya Rural School

process: DDPI Mandya and Deputy Director of Pre-University Education submit list of top rural government school performers to Zilla Panchayat.
Zilla Panchayat Standing Committee for Education confirms awards; DBT transfer made directly to student accounts.

important_dates.annual_cycle: Sanctioned annually in July-August following board results

important_current_notes: Direct merit incentive for rural students across all 7 taluks of Mandya district.
schemes.application_window: Active for current academic year in Mandya district

name.en: Karnataka Shishya Vethana Paper Voucher Scheme
name.kn: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಶಿಷ್ಯ ವೇತನ ಪೇಪರ್ ವೋಚರ್ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಹಳೆಯ ಯೋಜನೆ - ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ)
name.hi: कर्नाटक शिष्य वेतन कागजी वाउचर योजना (पुरानी योजना - बंद)

schemes.department: Department of Public Instruction, Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Legacy paper coupon stipend system for rural students. Officially DISCONTINUED and replaced by direct benefit transfer through the Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP).
summary.kn: ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾಗದದ ಕೂಪನ್ ಮತ್ತು ನಗದು ಶಿಷ್ಯ ವೇತನ ಪದ್ಧತಿ. ಅಧಿಕೃತವಾಗಿ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಲಾಗಿದ್ದು, ರಾಜ್ಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶದ (SSP) ಡಿಬಿಟಿ ಮೂಲಕ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.
summary.hi: पुरानी कागजी कूपन व नकद छात्रवृत्ति व्यवस्था जिसे अब पूर्णतः बंद कर डिजिटल एसएसपी पोर्टल से बदल दिया गया है।

description.en: This manual voucher system was phased out and discontinued by the Karnataka Government to eliminate leakages and delays. All student scholarships are now channeled exclusively through the digital SSP platform.
description.kn: ಹಳೆಯ ಕೈಪಿಡಿ ಪದ್ಧತಿಯನ್ನು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಆಧಾರ್ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ನೇರ ಹಣ ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆ ಜಾರಿಗೆ ತರಲಾಗಿದೆ.
description.hi: नकद भुगतान की पुरानी प्रणाली बंद हो चुकी है। अब सभी छात्रवृत्तियां सीधे बैंक खाते में डिजिटल माध्यम से भेजी जाती हैं।

benefit.description: Historical manual paper coupons. Officially discontinued.

eligibility_criteria: Discontinued legacy scheme - no active applications accepted.

exclusions.description: Scheme discontinued; superseded by Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP).

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Not applicable.
process: Do not apply. Please use the active State Scholarship Portal (KARNATAKA_SSP_DIRECTORY).
important_current_notes: Excluded from active discovery. Replaced by SSP DBT.
schemes.application_window: Closed / Discontinued

name.en: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
name.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಆವಾಸ್ ಯೋಜನೆ - ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ
name.hi: प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना - ग्रामीण

schemes.department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India

summary.en: Grant assistance of ₹1,20,000 for rural homeless and kutcha-house dwelling families for pucca house construction, plus 90 days MGNREGA wages.
summary.kn: ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಭಾಗದ ವಸತಿ ರಹಿತ ಮತ್ತು ಶಿಥಿಲ ಮನೆಯ ಬಡ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಪಕ್ಕಾ ಮನೆ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ₹1,20,000 ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಅನುದಾನ ಮತ್ತು 90 ದಿನಗಳ ನರೇಗಾ ವೇತನ.
summary.hi: ग्रामीण बेघर एवं कच्चे घरों में रहने वाले परिवारों को पक्का मकान बनाने हेतु ₹1,20,000 की वित्तीय सहायता तथा 90 दिन की मनरेगा मजदूरी।

description.en: PMAY-G provides financial grant assistance to rural families who are homeless or living in kutcha/dilapidated houses, identified via SECC/Awaas+ priority lists.
description.kn: ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಬಡ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಮೂಲಸೌಕರ್ಯಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸ್ವಂತ ಪಕ್ಕಾ ಮನೆ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೇಂದ್ರ-ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ವಸತಿ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: ग्रामीण गरीबों को बुनियादी सुविधाओं से युक्त पक्के मकान उपलब्ध कराने की राष्ट्रीय योजना।

benefit.description: ₹1,20,000 financial grant in instalments directly into bank account, plus ₹27,000 approx (90 days) MGNREGA unskilled labor wages and ₹12,000 for toilet construction under SBM-G.

eligibility_criteria: Houseless families or families living in zero, one or two-room houses with kutcha wall and kutcha roof in rural areas
Must be listed in SECC 2011 / Awaas+ verified priority list

eligibility_rules.description: Beneficiary must have an active bank account.

exclusions.description: Households owning motorized 2/3/4 wheelers, mechanized agricultural equipment, or with government employees are excluded.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Rural resident in kutcha house.
process: Grama Sabha verifies priority ranking from Awaas+ survey list.
Beneficiary registers bank account and Aadhaar.
Geo-tagged photos of foundation, lintel, and roof levels taken via AwaasApp; funds released in 3 tranches directly via DBT.
important_current_notes: Geo-tagging at each construction milestone is mandatory before fund release.
schemes.application_window: Continuous selection via Gram Sabha Awaas+ list
schemes.geographic_applicability: All India Rural Areas (Active across Karnataka)

name.en: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
name.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಮುದ್ರಾ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಪಿಎಂಎಂವೈ)
name.hi: प्रधानमंत्री मुद्रा योजना (पीएमएमवाई)

schemes.department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India

summary.en: Collateral-free micro enterprise loans up to ₹20 Lakhs across Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakhs), and Tarun (₹5 Lakhs to ₹20 Lakhs) categories for small businesses and allied farm enterprises.
summary.kn: ಸಣ್ಣ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಳು, ಕೃಷಿ ಪೂರಕ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಮಹಿಳಾ ಉದ್ಯಮಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಯಾವುದೇ ಮೇಲಾಧಾರವಿಲ್ಲದೆ (ಕೊಲ್ಯಾಟರಲ್-ಮುಕ್ತ) ₹20 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗೆ ಮುದ್ರಾ ಸಾಲ (ಶಿಶು, ಕಿಶೋರ, ತರುಣ್).
summary.hi: लघु व्यवसायों और कृषि संबद्ध गतिविधियों हेतु बिना किसी गारंटी (कोलैटरल-फ्री) ₹20 लाख तक का मुद्रा ऋण (शिशु, किशोर, तरुण)।

description.en: PMMY funds the unfunded by providing collateral-free credit to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises and allied agricultural activities (dairy, poultry, fisheries, agro-processing).
description.kn: ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಮತ್ತು ಅರೆ-ನಗರ ಭಾಗದ ಸಣ್ಣ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳು, ಪಶುಪಾಲಕರು ಹಾಗೂ ಸ್ವಸಹಾಯ ಸಂಘಗಳ ಸದಸ್ಯರಿಗೆ ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯ ಸಾಲ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: लघु उद्यमियों एवं ग्रामीण कामगारों को औपचारिक बैंकिंग प्रणाली से जोड़ने हेतु मुद्रा ऋण योजना।

benefit.description: Collateral-free business loan: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakhs), Tarun (₹5 Lakhs to ₹10 Lakhs, enhanced to ₹20 Lakhs for repeat borrowers).

eligibility_criteria: Any Indian citizen having a viable business plan for non-farm income-generating activity or agricultural allied activity
Good credit history without default with any bank or financial institution

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must possess an active bank account.

schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Micro entrepreneur, self-employed, artisan, or allied farm business.

required_documents.item: Quotation of Machinery / Items to be purchased

process: Apply online through Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any commercial, RRB, or cooperative bank branch.
Submit Mudra application form with quotation of items to be purchased.
Bank sanctions loan without demanding third-party guarantee or collateral security; issues Mudra RuPay card.

important_dates.annual_cycle: Continuous application through all commercial banks

important_current_notes: No collateral security or processing fee charged for Shishu loans up to ₹50,000.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round across all bank branches

name.en: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY & Arogya Karnataka
name.kn: ಆಯುಷ್ಮಾನ್ ಭಾರತ್ - ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ (ಪಿಎಂ-ಜೆಎವೈ)
name.hi: आयुष्मान भारत - पीएम-जय एवं आरोग्य कर्नाटक

schemes.department: National Health Authority (NHA) & Suvarna Arogya Suraksha Trust (SAST), Government of Karnataka

summary.en: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization across 1,900+ empanelled hospitals in Karnataka.
summary.kn: ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ತೃತೀಯ ಹಂತದ ತುರ್ತು ಶಸ್ತ್ರಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆ ದಾಖಲಾತಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹5,00,000 ವರೆಗೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ನಗದು ರಹಿತ ಉಚಿತ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ.
summary.hi: गंभीर बीमारियों एवं अस्पताल में भर्ती होने पर प्रत्येक पात्र परिवार को प्रति वर्ष ₹5,00,000 तक का पूर्णतः निःशुल्क कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य बीमा।

description.en: In Karnataka, PM-JAY is co-branded with Arogya Karnataka administered by Suvarna Arogya Suraksha Trust (SAST). BPL cardholders receive 100% cashless treatment up to ₹5 Lakhs, and APL cardholders receive 30% co-payment support.
description.kn: ಬಡ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳು ಆಕಸ್ಮಿಕ ಅನಾರೋಗ್ಯದ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸಾ ವೆಚ್ಚದಿಂದ ಸಾಲದ ಸುಳಿಗೆ ಸಿಲುಕದಂತೆ ರಕ್ಷಿಸುವ ದೇಶದ ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ವಿಮಾ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: गरीब और वंचित परिवारों को गंभीर स्वास्थ्य समस्याओं के निःशुल्क गुणवत्तापूर्ण उपचार की गारंटी देने वाली योजना।

benefit.description: Cashless health cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year covering pre-hospitalization, medicines, ICU, surgeries, and post-hospitalization care.

eligibility_criteria: All BPL / Antyodaya ration cardholder families in Karnataka (Eligible Category A)
Families listed in SECC 2011 occupational and deprivation criteria
APL cardholder families covered under co-payment scheme (Category B)

eligibility_rules.description: Beneficiary must have verified identity details.

schemes.income_criteria: Priority to BPL / AAY ration cardholders.
schemes.age_criteria: No age limit. Covers all family members from infants to senior citizens.
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Citizen resident of Karnataka.
process: Verify eligibility online on Beneficiary Portal (beneficiary.nha.gov.in) or visit nearest Village BangaloreOne / GramaOne / CSC.
Complete Aadhaar e-KYC and download Ayushman Bharat Card immediately.
Present Ayushman Card at any empaneled government or private hospital for cashless treatment.
important_current_notes: Karnataka residents can get co-branded Ayushman Arogya Karnataka card generated at any GramaOne centre.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round on national portal and at all GramaOne centres
schemes.geographic_applicability: All India (Active in Karnataka across 1,900+ hospitals)

name.en: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
name.kn: ಅಟಲ್ ಪಿಂಚಣಿ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಎಪಿವೈ)
name.hi: अटल पेंशन योजना (एपीवाई)

schemes.department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), Ministry of Finance, GoI

summary.en: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 for unorganized workers, farmers, and self-employed citizens starting from 60 years of age, based on chosen monthly contribution from age 18 to 40.
summary.kn: ಅಸಂಘಟಿತ ವಲಯದ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರು, ರೈತರು ಮತ್ತು ಯುವಜನರಿಗೆ 60 ವರ್ಷ ತುಂಬಿದ ನಂತರ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ₹1,000 ದಿಂದ ₹5,000 ವರೆಗೆ ಖಾತರಿಯ ಮಾಸಾಶನ (ಪಿಂಚಣಿ).
summary.hi: असंगठित क्षेत्र के कामगारों, किसानों एवं युवाओं को 60 वर्ष की आयु के बाद ₹1,000 से ₹5,000 तक की गारंटीकृत मासिक पेंशन।

description.en: APY is a government-backed pension scheme focused on workers in the unorganized sector. Subscribers contribute a fixed monthly amount from age 18-40 and receive a guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 from age 60.
description.kn: ವೃದ್ಧಾಪ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಶ್ಚಿತ ಆದಾಯ ಹೊಂದಲು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಆಶ್ರಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಾರಿಗೆ ತರಲಾದ ಭದ್ರತಾ ಪಿಂಚಣಿ ಯೋಜನೆ.
description.hi: असंगठित क्षेत्र के नागरिकों को वृद्धावस्था में आर्थिक सुरक्षा देने हेतु सरकार द्वारा गारंटीकृत पेंशन योजना।

benefit.description: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 for life after age 60. Same pension continues to spouse on subscriber's death, and full accumulated pension wealth returned to nominee.

eligibility_criteria: Any Indian citizen aged between 18 and 40 years
Must possess a savings bank account with auto-debit facility
Must not be an income-tax payer (effective October 2022 amendment)

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must have a savings bank account.

exclusions.description: Persons who are income tax payers as per Income Tax Act are not eligible to join APY.

schemes.age_criteria: 18 to 40 years at entry; pension starts at age 60.
schemes.education_occupation_criteria: Unorganized worker, farmer, artisan, or self-employed.
process: Visit bank or post office branch where savings account is maintained, or apply online via internet banking.
Fill APY subscriber registration form and provide Aadhaar and nominee details.
Monthly auto-debit set up; PRAN (Permanent Retirement Account Number) card issued.
important_current_notes: Guaranteed return backed by Government of India.
schemes.application_window: Open year-round at all bank and post office branches
